jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As Principal Product Manager, you'll own the vision, product strategy and roadmap for our product portfolio across physical, digital and blended learning experiences.

You'll work closely with senior employees across Product, Technology, Learning, Commercial, Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience to ensure we're focused on the opportunities that deliver the greatest value for our customers, learners and business.

This role is about far more than roadmap delivery.

You'll influence strategic investment choices, elevate product management capability across the organisation, help shape our approach to AI and emerging technologies, and build the frameworks, governance and operating rhythms that enable high-performing product teams to thrive.

You'll also play a key role in developing product management capability across Insights, helping to establish the standards, frameworks and ways of working that enable teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Defining and delivering the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for our learner product portfolio.
  • Steering product investment and prioritisation choices across a diverse product landscape.
  • Identifying opportunities to innovate, scale, simplify or retire products.
  • Driving measurable improvements in customer, learner and commercial outcomes.
  • Partnering with Product, Technology, Learning and Design teams to bring innovative ideas to market.
  • Using insight, data and evidence to inform product choices and portfolio direction.
  • Coaching and developing Product Managers while contributing to product leadership across the organisation.
  • Influencing senior stakeholders and helping shape wider business product strategy.
  • Exploring how emerging technologies, including AI, can enhance product experiences and business value.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in hearing from experienced product evangelists who have successfully shaped product strategy, influenced investment outcomes and led teams, portfolios or product functions in complex organisations.

Your background may come from SaaS, technology, professional services, learning, HR technology, consultancy or another environment where you've delivered meaningful customer and commercial outcomes. What's most important is your ability to think strategically, make evidence-based conclusions and bring people together around a shared product vision.

What matters most is your ability to demonstrate:

  • Experience managing complex product portfolios or multiple interconnected products.
  • A track record of creating and executing product strategies linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience making investment and prioritisation choices.
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing product teams.
  • Confidence influencing senior stakeholders across complex organisations.
  • Strong technology fluency and an understanding of modern product development approaches.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery.
  • An evidence-led approach to decision making.

Experience within SaaS, HR Technology, Learning Technology, Professional Services, Digital Products or Product Transformation environments would be particularly valuable, although not essential.

Why Join Insights?

This is an opportunity to:

  • Shape a global portfolio of learning products that help organisations unlock the potential of their people.
  • Influence strategic investment and product choices at organisational level.
  • Play a visible senior role within Product & Innovation.
  • Help define the future of learning experiences through technology, innovation and AI.
  • Work within a values-led organisation committed to growth, curiosity and continuous learning.
  • Join a business where people genuinely care about making a positive impact.

Benefits:

• 37 days holidays

• Discretionary Annual Bonus

• Private Medical Insurance

• Income Protection
• Pension Plan
• Health Cash Plan
• Life Assurance
• Electric Car Scheme
• Gymflex
• Employee Giving
• My Advantage – Employee Discounts
• Critical Illness cover
• Employee Assistance Program
• Holiday purchase option

• Flexible working

Everyone is welcome at Insights. We’re dedicated to creating a space where you belong — that means accepting you for who you are now and supporting you on your journey towards whoever you want to become.

Our colourful solutions help people see themselves and others in a new light and we love encouraging our diverse global community to experience the transformational power of Insights Discovery. Through listening and learning, we will continue to foster the connections that matter to build a more inclusive culture.

It is in our nature to nurture. We have developed an organisation which puts care for our people, inclusion, belonging and wellbeing at the heart of our approach. We’re strengthened by a community where we work together to co-create a culture that celebrates difference and welcomes everybody.

We love learning. We want to be better tomorrow than we are today and we’re up for the journey. Unapologetically human, undoubtedly individual. Colourful to our core.

Read more about inclusivity at Insights via the vacancy page on our website:

Help shape the next generation of product and learning experiences at one of the world's leading people development organisations.

At Insights, we believe people thrive when they better understand themselves and others. Our learning solutions help organisations across the globe build stronger relationships, develop leaders and create lasting positive change.

We're now looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Product Leadership Team and play a key role in shaping the future of our product portfolio.

This is a rare opportunity to influence the product strategy, performance and evolution of a global portfolio of learning products and experiences used by organisations around the world. Reporting directly to our Head of Product, you'll play a key role in determining where we invest, what we evolve, what we scale and where we innovate next.

If you're an experienced product leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of customer value, commercial outcomes and innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic investment outcomes, influence organisational priorities and leave a lasting impact on how products are developed and delivered across Insights.

Flexible Working

We believe people do their best work when they can balance their professional and personal commitments. That's why we're open to discussing flexible working arrangements and will consider requests that help you thrive both at work and at home. If there's something we can do to support you, please let us know.

jobs.title: AI Voice Recording Contributor - Mandarin Chinese (Taiwan)
jobs.description:
We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Mandarin Chinesevoice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 18 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Women Donors Network (WDN; 501(c)(3) organization) and Women Donors Action (WDA; 501(c)(4) organization) are hiring a proactive and collaborative Program Manager to advance our learning, member engagement, and donor organizing initiatives. We are looking for a skilled program manager, relationship-builder, and creative problem-solver who is energized by designing meaningful experiences that help members connect, learn, and organize for collective action. The ideal Program Manager is an expert at turning ideas into action, bringing thoughtful perspectives and solutions to the table, and taking pride in seeing projects through from start to finish, all while approaching their work with curiosity and care.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States with occasional travel 6-12 times per year within the United States. The Program Manager reports to the Senior Manager, Learning & Impact and works closely with the Community & Development, Communications, and Politics & Advocacy Teams. Grounded in a deep commitment to social justice, this role helps strengthen the relationships, leadership, and collective power of WDN’s multigenerational, multiracial community of donor activists.

ABOUT US

Women Donors Network (WDN) is a national network of women donors (cis and trans), nonbinary, and gender-expansive individuals committed to protecting and advancing gender, racial, economic, and climate justice. As a growing multiracial and multigenerational community of donor organizers, we connect, grow, fund, and mobilize together in solidarity with movements to transform people, culture, and systems rooted in justice. Through Women Donors Action (WDA), our c4 affiliate organization, we work to transform policies, political infrastructure, and political possibilities by investing in advocacy and electoral strategies that center the leadership of historically excluded communities. Together, we envision a just and sustainable world where everyone can safely and freely determine their own futures.

This is an exciting time at WDN and WDA as we move into the fourth year of our bold strategic plan. We have a growing team passionate about social justice and motivated to amplify our impact. Our values are rooted in a culture of courage, commitment, curiosity, accountability, hope, and joy. You can read more about our path forward here.

We are a geographically distributed, remote team of 28 from a range of intersectional identities, including cisgender, BIPOC, and nonbinary people. We have a shared staffing structure across WDN and WDA, where our team dedicates a portion of their time to each organizational entity. We believe that a diverse team is integral to our work and strongly encourage applications from people of color, people with disabilities, women, LGBTQIA+, and all other applicants from historically excluded identities in the United States.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an exciting moment to join WDN/WDA as we deepen our commitment to building a multigenerational, multiracial community of donor organizers who connect, grow, fund, and mobilize together. As our learning and organizing initiatives evolve, we are looking for a Program Manager on the Learning & Impact Team who can help turn ambitious ideas into engaging experiences that strengthen relationships, deepen learning, and build the capacity of our members for collective action.

As Program Manager, you’ll lead the planning and execution of virtual and in-person programs, including webinars, workshops, and regional gatherings. You’ll partner closely with the Senior Manager, Learning & Impact to design thoughtful, community-centered learning experiences that deepen our members' understanding of critical social justice issues and strengthen their skills as donor activists. You will bring creativity to program design and take pride in program management, managing the details from end-to-end that make high-quality, meaningful programs possible.

You will also help nurture the relationships and member leadership that make WDN’s community thrive. By engaging in member spaces, listening for emerging needs and interests, and connecting the dots to WDN/WDA’s strategic priorities, you will identify opportunities to deepen member engagement and support donor organizing. You will bring these insights, along with your own ideas and perspectives, to help shape programs that respond to the political moment, reflect the priorities of social justice movements, and connect our members to opportunities for action.

During your first six months as Program Manager, you will:

  • Develop a strong understanding of WDN/WDA’s strategic plan, member community, systems, programs and how our learning, engagement, grantmaking, and organizing work connects to advance our mission.
  • Build strong relationships with WDN’s 250+ members and help cultivate member leadership and donor organizing opportunities.
  • Collaborate and partner with team members across the Community & Development, Communications, and Politics & Advocacy Teams.
  • Design engaging learning experiences for WDN’s members with different program content, formats and opportunities for engagement, in partnership with the Senior Manager, Learning & Impact.
  • Manage a full portfolio of virtual and in-person programs end-to-end (from planning through implementation, follow-up, and evaluation), ensuring high-quality experiences for WDN’s members.
  • Share insights from member feedback, participation trends, and evaluations, including recommendations to strengthen programs and member engagement.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for members about the Learning & Impact Team.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States. Candidates must be available during weekday business hours across U.S. time zones and able to travel occasionally within the United States for meetings, team retreats, and member programs. Candidates must have at least 5 years of program management experience. We are not accepting applications from outside the United States or from staffing agencies.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

As WDN and WDA continues to operationalize our strategic plan, the Program Manager on the Learning & Impact Team will support a dynamic portfolio of learning, member engagement, and donor organizing initiatives, including:

PROGRAM MANAGEMENT

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of WDN’s virtual and in-person programs, including webinars, workshops, regional gatherings, and other learning and engagement opportunities.
  • Develop and implement clear project management plans, timelines, and workflows, proactively tracking deliverables, anticipating challenges, and ensuring timely execution and follow-through.
  • Design high quality, engaging learning experiences for WDN’s members in partnership with the Senior Manager, Learning & Impact.
  • Coordinate program logistics and materials, including scheduling, speaker and facilitator preparation, event materials, and timely participant communications.
  • Manage program follow-up and evaluation, including gathering feedback, tracking participation, and identifying opportunities to strengthen program quality and member experience.

MEMBER ENGAGEMENT

  • Manage WDN’s donor organizing initiatives, partnering with member leaders to strengthen relationships, develop learning and action opportunities, coordinate activities, and ensure follow-through on next steps.
  • Build and maintain relationships with WDN’s members to foster meaningful participation, trust, and connection across our multigenerational, multiracial community.
  • Analyze and synthesize insights and recommendations to inform learning and organizing strategies after listening to emerging member interests and needs across programs and member feedback.
  • Develop member-facing communications and stories that highlight programmatic learning and impact, in collaboration with the Communications Team.

TEAM ENGAGEMENT

  • Collaborate with teams across WDN/WDA to manage and coordinate cross-functional projects and ensure alignment on program goals and deliverables.
  • Participate in team meetings and projects, sharing insights, providing thoughtful feedback, and collaborating with colleagues to achieve shared goals.
  • Develop and improve systems, workflows, and practices that strengthen program management, accountability, and the membership experience.
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members and consultants.
  • Seek opportunities for professional growth through training, workshops, and self-directed learning.
  • Contribute to organizational success by continuously learning about industry trends and best practices, updating practices and approaches.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

As the Program Manager on the Learning & Impact team, you must bring:

  • Program management expertise. You have at least five years of experience in program management. You’ve independently managed concurrent programs end-to-end, managing multiple groups of diverse stakeholders and delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience managing programs in philanthropy, a membership based organization or association, or in a participatory community context is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional project management skills. You translate ideas into detailed, actionable project management plans with clear owners, responsibilities, and timelines. You balance competing priorities, track progress, anticipate challenges, and communicate early when something is at risk. You follow through on commitments and take responsibility for seeing work through to completion.
  • Proven track record designing and delivering meaningful learning or community experiences. You’ve helped develop and implement programs, workshops, learning experiences, or community gatherings that foster connection, learning, and action. You understand how to translate program goals and participant needs into engaging, inclusive, and purposeful experiences.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and public speaking skills. You communicate clearly and thoughtfully, are comfortable facilitating programs, and enjoy presenting to diverse audiences.
  • Strong data analysis and storytelling skills. You turn feedback and data into actionable insights and clear recommendations, and you can present them to senior leaders in ways that inform decisions.
  • Comfort engaging with wealth, identity, power, and privilege. You can thoughtfully facilitate and engage in conversations about wealth, philanthropy, race, identity, and social justice. You approach differences in lived experiences and perspectives with curiosity, care, and cultural humility.
  • Digital fluency and adaptability. You have an expert level of proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and MacOS. You have previous experience with technology platforms and AI tools like Claude, ClickUp, and Circle. You learn new systems quickly and identify opportunities to strengthen workflows, coordination, and efficiency.

CANDIDATE CHARACTERISTICS

The ideal Program Manager on the Learning & Impact Team is:

  • Deeply committed to equity and social justice. You’re energized by WDN/WDA’s mission and believe in the importance of building collective power to advance gender, racial, economic, and climate justice. You approach members, colleagues, and movement partners with care, respect, and integrity.
  • Proactive, accountable, and self-directed. You take initiative without waiting for direction at every step, follow through on commitments, and communicate early when priorities shift or challenges emerge. You take ownership of your work while knowing when to seek guidance or elevate decisions.
  • A strategic listener and community builder. You build authentic relationships and engage with others, especially our members, with curiosity and care. You listen for emerging interests, needs, and opportunities, connect the dots across conversations, and translate what you’re hearing into thoughtful recommendations that strengthen programs and member engagement.
  • A creative and collaborative thought partner. You bring ideas, ask thoughtful questions, and offer your own perspective. You enjoy developing programs and experiences alongside colleagues, welcome constructive feedback, and contribute to a culture of shared learning, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Adaptable, resourceful, and solutions-oriented. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities with sound judgment and flexibility. When challenges arise, you identify practical solutions and keep work moving forward.
  • Grounded in curiosity and joy. You bring a growth mindset, an openness to experimentation, and a sense of possibility to your work. You believe that joy is an essential part of social justice work.

To be considered for the Program Manager role, please submit an application and resume through the WDN Careers Page. We will continue to accept applications for this opportunity until this role is filled, prioritizing applications received prior to November 30, 2026 when we will begin an initial application review.

To protect the integrity of our structured candidacy process, we kindly ask that all applicants do not call, email or message our office or any member of the WDN Team or Board of Directors about the Program Manager role.

Benefits

The base salary for the Program Manager starts at $110K/year. This role is also eligible to receive WDN's Employee Benefits Package which includes:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (paid by WDN at 100% for employees and 80% for dependents)
  • 401K Contribution (4% of your gross pay contributed by WDN and an additional 3% match of your gross pay)
  • 20 Vacation Days, 14 Sick Days, and 14 Company Holidays
  • Partial Reimbursement of Your Internet and Phone Expenses for your home office
  • Financial Support for Learning and Professional Development Opportunities

WDN is an equal opportunity employer that values a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture. WDN encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, and veteran status. WDN does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, country of origin, citizenship, ancestry, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, political affiliation, exercising one’s right to family care and medical leave, medical condition, including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions, or any other category protected by local, state, or federal laws. WDN is not offering US visa sponsorship at this time. Upon request, WDN offers accommodations for candidates with disabilities during the application, interview, and hiring process, such as additional time on hiring exercises, interview questions in advance, or closed captioning on Zoom.

SE Ranking is an AI first company, and we are looking for a Customer Success Associate who works that way too. You will help agencies and small businesses get real value from our SEO and SMM tools, from their first login through their first renewal and beyond.

This is a digital first role. Most of your impact will come from scalable, one to many engagement: automated journeys, webinars, open hours, and targeted outreach driven by customer data. When an account needs a personal touch, you will step in confidently and meet with them 1x1.

Our current focus for the CSA team is early onboarding, adoption, and 12 month renewals. Every member of our CS team guides customers through the full lifecycle, so you will also run check ins and spot upsell and cross sell opportunities as accounts grow.

What you'll do:

Onboarding and early adoption (your primary focus)

  • Guide new customers through onboarding so they reach their first value moment quickly.
  • Track early usage signals and step in when an account stalls, using digital nudges first and a 1x1 session when needed.
  • Build and improve onboarding resources: email journeys, short videos, help content, and group onboarding sessions.

Lifecycle management and 12 month renewals

  • Own a book of accounts through the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding to adoption, check ins, and renewal.
  • Run proactive renewal motions for 12 month customers, flagging risk early and building save plans with data.
  • Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities across our product suite and partner with Sales to close them.

Digital, one to many engagement

  • Maximize digital touch: design lifecycle and risk based campaigns that reach many accounts at once.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, open hours, and product update sessions for your segment.
  • Meet 1x1 with accounts when the situation calls for it, such as complex setups, renewal risk, or expansion conversations.

Cross functional partnership

  • Work with Support, Product, and Sales to resolve customer needs quickly and smoothly.
  • Share customer feedback and patterns to inform the product roadmap.

How we work - AI first:

AI is part of how our CS team works every day, not a side experiment. Claude is our primary tool, and we expect you to use AI to work faster and serve more customers well.

  • Use AI skills, projects, and agents to streamline research, account prep, follow ups, and reporting.
  • Build reusable workflows, such as onboarding check ins or renewal prep, that save time for you and the team.
  • Combine AI with customer data from our CRM and analytics tools to prioritize the right accounts at the right time.
  • Share what works so the whole team gets better at it.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Working knowledge of AI tools in daily work. You have used skills, projects, or agents in Claude (or a similar tool like ChatGPT or Gemini) to streamline real tasks, and you can show us examples.
  • 2+ years in a customer facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS or digital marketing.
  • Onboarding and renewal experience, helping customers adopt a product and renew with confidence.
  • A digital first mindset, with experience running scalable, one to many programs such as webinars, email journeys, or group sessions.
  • Confidence in 1x1 conversations, including check ins, renewal discussions, and upsell or cross sell conversations.
  • A data driven approach, using usage data and customer signals to decide where to spend your time.
  • Strong communication and organization, able to manage a large book of accounts without dropping the ball.
  • Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with SEO, social media management, or agency workflows.
  • Experience building automations or AI agents for customer success work.
  • Fluency in additional languages, such as Spanish, French, or German.

How we'll measure success:

Performance and bonuses are measured against net revenue retention (NRR), gross revenue retention (GRR), and the upsell and expansion deals you create. Day to day, we also look at:

  • Onboarding completion and early adoption across new accounts
  • Reduction in early (infant) churn
  • 12 month renewal rate across your book
  • Expansion from upsell and cross sell opportunities you surface
  • Reach and engagement of your one to many programs

What we offer:

  • Flexible work hours and a culture that trusts you to manage your time

jobs.title: Enterprise AI Architecture Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An Enterprise AI Architecture leader who is ready to shape how our clients' customer service ecosystems scale with AI. You lead teams of architects and Forward Deployed Engineers, designing AI components and cooperating AI agents connect with the platforms service runs on (CRM, contact center, knowledge, telephony, and data) and setting the reusable patterns that govern how AI is deployed. You bring a clear point of view on what good looks like when many agents, models, and systems have to work as one.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams include Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), hybrid practitioners who embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You may have been one yourself; now your job is to also lead them, set the standard for how they work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee multiple AI integration architecture programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across architects and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as containment, resolution, and cost-to-serve.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Own future-state architectures for AI-enabled service: how virtual agents, agent-assist copilots, and analytics agents integrate with CRM, contact center, knowledge management, ticketing, and enterprise data platforms through APIs, events, and tool-use patterns such as MCP.
  • Set the agentic design standards your FDEs build to, including agent roles, memory, tool-use, and orchestration logic across cloud agent platforms, and how agents are grounded in client data through RAG, vector search, and knowledge graphs.
  • Set the reusable patterns that govern AI deployment across the enterprise, including multi-agent orchestration, human handoff and escalation, context and identity across channels, and the right balance of build, buy, and platform-native AI.
  • Act as the decisive voice on high-stakes engagements, guiding architecture tradeoffs across cost, latency, accuracy, compliance, and vendor dependency.
  • Ground service journeys and conversation designs in what the architecture can support from day one, shaping feasibility early and translating design recommendations into integration specifications and working builds.
  • Build security, MLOps, and responsible AI guardrails into every architecture, working with specialists across Accenture.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships, proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, and shaping architecture-led roadmaps and proposals that turn one project into a lasting partnership.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on agentic service architecture and how enterprises should scale AI across their service ecosystems, positioning Song as a credible and compelling voice in the industry.
  • Strengthen relationships with ecosystem partners across contact center, CRM, cloud, and data platforms to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow Forward Deployed Engineers and architects, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: hire the right hybrid profiles, define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify reference architectures, integration patterns, and accelerators that make delivery repeatable across clients.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders. Experience leading Forward Deployed Engineers or similar client-embedded technical teams, such as solutions architects, sales engineers, or technical consultants; a hands-on FDE or engineering background yourself is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Deep experience in solution and integration architecture for enterprise systems, including API design and management, event-driven and microservices architectures, and integration platforms.
  • Architecture experience with GenAI and agentic systems in production, including RAG, agent orchestration, tool-use and MCP integration, on at least one enterprise agent platform such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, or Databricks Mosaic AI.
  • Experience architecting across customer service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect.
  • Experience designing conversational AI and agentic solutions across voice and digital channels, including IVR modernization, chat and messaging, intelligent routing, and seamless handoff between AI and human agents with full customer context.
  • Experience integrating AI into the service agent desktop and knowledge ecosystem, including CRM case management, knowledge bases, and workforce and quality management systems.
  • A track record of leading business development by shaping proposals, scoping programs, and presenting to clients in a way that builds confidence and closes deals.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to hold difficult conversations with senior client stakeholders, guiding them to outcomes that strengthen the relationship while setting expectations that protect our delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and influence cross-functional decision making.
  • Professional-level cloud architect certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Experience establishing architecture governance or a design authority across a multi-vendor enterprise estate.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams spanning design, advisory, and technology, turning research insights and design recommendations into engineered solutions.
  • Experience working in management consulting or a professional services environment.
  • You contribute to external thought leadership, such as publishing POVs, speaking at events, or representing the practice in the broader AI community.

jobs.title: Manager or Director of AI
jobs.description:
About NRG

NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology. We stay ahead of what’s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. We’re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges—in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

  • Do what you love. With conviction.
  • Where discovery lives. And impact drives.
  • Celebrate difference. Cultivate belonging.
  • Big thinking. Collectively inspired.
  • Embrace the journey. Be human.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AI Manager or Director to help people across NRG use AI confidently and build better ways of working. You’ll turn deep, current AI knowledge into practical capabilities that improve our research, client service and operations.

You’ll work across the organization with all our teams and senior leaders to introduce shared tools and coach colleagues. This will be a highly visible role that combines experimentation, communication and collaboration to help the whole firm learn about, use and build with AI.

We welcome people with different backgrounds and career paths. We’re interested in the AI knowledge, relevant experience and practical contribution you can bring to NRG.

Your Impact

  • Stay current with AI. Explore new models, tools, techniques and open-source projects, test and benchmark their performance and usefulness, and bring practical recommendations and examples to NRG.
  • Work with colleagues to understand their needs and spot useful opportunities to use AI. Contribute AI expertise to prioritizing requests and turn leadership priorities into clear plans with agreed measures of success.
  • Lead initiatives that give teams shared AI building blocks: reusable Skills, agents, workflows, apps and connections between tools, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Partner with Engineering to define needs, test solutions and clarify support responsibilities before launch.
  • Assess third-party tools, help choose suitable solutions, and guide their introduction. Bring together documentation, demonstrations and training support so people can use them confidently and build on them.
  • Partner with the lead for company-wide AI learning and adoption. Share discoveries, help shape learning content and contribute practical demonstrations of the latest useful capabilities.
  • Coach leaders one to one on how to use AI in their work. Understand the problems they want to solve and help them work more effectively.
  • Be a visible, trusted voice for AI across NRG. Lead the AI Exchange, our company-wide forum for sharing AI ideas, examples and lessons, and present developments and progress to senior leaders across business areas.
  • Own the story and preparation for AI meetings, presentations and updates you lead. Produce clear agendas, polished decks, useful documentation and timely communications that meet the standards of client work.
  • Follow through on agreed commitments, keep people informed and raise obstacles early. Learn how colleagues use tools and shared capabilities, and show what is improving and where help is needed.

Who We're Looking For

  • Curious and proactive, with a deep interest in AI.
  • Strong consultative and relationship-building skills.
  • Clear communicator, comfortable coaching and presenting to senior leaders.
  • Thoughtful problem-solver with sound judgment.
  • Organized and reliable, with strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborative, with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep, current AI knowledge, demonstrated through hands-on experimentation and practical use.
  • Hands-on experience configuring reusable AI workflows with prompts, instructions, context, Skills, agents or approved connectors.
  • Hands-on use of platforms such as ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, Gemini or comparable AI tools.
  • A background in designing realistic tests, assessing outputs against agreed standards, and explaining limitations and failure cases.
  • Experience leading initiatives from understanding user needs through evaluation, introduction and adoption, in partnership with Engineering and other specialists.
  • Ability to turn technical documentation, research and open-source projects into practical recommendations.
  • Strong consultative and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach colleagues and create clear guidance, presentations and recommendations.
  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A background in market research, media, analytics consulting or another field requiring strong research and professional judgment.
  • Practical Python skills and working knowledge of SQL.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools, MCP integrations and API-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.
  • Exposure to business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • An understanding of DevOps/MLOps and data security standards such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, including deployment, monitoring and support.

Position Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

  • Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City and New York
  • Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 401K with company match

  • Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases
  • Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities

Our Commitment

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

jobs.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being. Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Computational Designer, you will contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, a generative design tool focused on site viability and masterplanning. The role combines computational design, geometry development and software engineering, with a predominantly back-end focus.

You will work directly with a product team member and may collaborate with an AI research and development specialist on initiatives involving AI agents and machine learning-based optimisation. The precise balance of responsibilities will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as product priorities change.

You will contribute to a standalone product that does not depend on third-party computational design tools. The role requires independent ownership of sub-projects, thoughtful problem-solving and an understanding of how individual technical decisions contribute to the wider product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain computational geometry algorithms for a standalone generative design product.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of SiteSolve, supporting site viability analysis and masterplanning.
  • Design, implement and refine computational optimisation solutions.
  • Build and maintain internal tools supporting product development.
  • Contribute to cloud infrastructure and back-end development.
  • Work across front-end and back-end development, with a predominant focus on back-end functionality.
  • Undertake primarily C# development, which accounts for approximately 99% of the role.
  • Develop code that interacts with the product's 3D engine as its interface transitions from Unity to Unreal, with dedicated Unreal specialists leading the rendering work.
  • Collaborate with product team members on computational design and software development.
  • Potentially contribute to AI-focused research and development, including connecting SiteSolve to AI agents and exploring machine learning-based optimisation approaches.
  • Independently take ownership of assigned sub-projects.
  • Apply a detail-oriented approach while considering the wider context in which the code operates.
  • Demonstrate flexibility, problem-solving ability and thoroughness in technical development.

Requirements

  • C# – 3+ years: Expert or advanced proficiency in C#, with hands-on experience developing software applications. C# is the primary language used throughout the product, and no substitute programming language is accepted.
  • AEC Computational Design / Geometry – 3+ years: Solid understanding and practical experience in AEC computational design or geometry. Relevant computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains, including manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games, is also acceptable.
  • Rhino / Grasshopper – 3+ years: Working knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper or equivalent 3D CAD and parametric design tools.
  • Computational Optimisation – 2–3 years: Applied experience in computational optimisation. A strong applied mathematics or algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience is also acceptable.
  • Ability to independently own and deliver assigned sub-projects.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a thorough and detail-oriented approach to development.
  • Ability to understand the broader product context and use that understanding to inform technical decisions.
  • Flexibility to work across different development areas as product priorities evolve.

Nice to Have

  • AWS – 2+ years: Working knowledge of AWS. Experience with another major cloud provider, such as Azure or GCP, combined with a willingness to learn AWS, is also acceptable.
  • Unity / Unreal / 3D Game Engines – 1–2 years: Basic familiarity with Unity, Unreal or other 3D game engines. Alternatively, an understanding of 3D vector mathematics, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders is valuable, even without direct game engine experience.
  • AI / Machine Learning – 1+ years: Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts, including integrating code with large language models (LLMs) or ML-based optimisation. Python experience combined with strong applied mathematics knowledge, or a demonstrated interest in AI through side projects, is also acceptable.

jobs.title: Manager, Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Manager of Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & Revenue Growth) to build and lead a new function within our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team. This team will focus on improving the experience of paying subscribers, increasing engagement, growing customer lifetime value, and strengthening retention through data-driven lifecycle marketing programs.

In this role, you'll lead a team of three marketers and shape how our Retention & Revenue Growth function operates. You'll translate business objectives into a cohesive approach to post-purchase engagement and revenue growth, establish priorities and ways of working, and guide the team in developing programs that drive measurable improvements in subscriber behavior. You'll navigate competing opportunities, make informed trade-offs, and work across teams to build solutions that scale.

This is an opportunity to build a new function while developing a high-performing team. You'll establish a strong foundation for experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement, while advancing thoughtful AI adoption and helping your team develop the capabilities to work more effectively and independently. As the business evolves, the function may also expand into emerging opportunities such as community-driven growth and sharing.

ABOUT THE GROWTH LIFECYCLE MARKETING TEAM

Our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team operates with a high degree of end-to-end ownership. We use customer behavior and data to identify opportunities, develop strategies, build and launch lifecycle experiences, measure performance, and turn what we learn into the next experiment. Rather than routinely handing work from one function to another, our lifecycle marketers have the tools and autonomy to move work forward themselves while partnering with teams across onX where their expertise is needed.

We move quickly, experiment often, and stay close to both the customer experience and the results of our work. That means being strategic and hands-on aren't separate parts of the job—they go together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Team Leadership & Development: Build and lead a team of three marketers, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, performance expectations, and operating practices for a new function. Develop team members through coaching, feedback, and meaningful ownership, strengthening their ability to independently navigate complex work, make sound decisions, and deliver measurable results. Foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Functional Strategy & Prioritization: Translate broader business objectives and customer insights into a cohesive retention and revenue growth approach. Establish the team's roadmap, identify and evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions about priorities, resources, and trade-offs. Balance near-term performance with longer-term improvements while adapting plans as business needs and customer behaviors evolve.
  • Post-Purchase Lifecycle: Lead the development and ongoing improvement of lifecycle marketing programs that strengthen the paying subscriber experience. Guide the team in identifying customer needs, designing relevant experiences, and optimizing programs across email, push, and in-app messaging to drive meaningful behavior change.
  • Revenue Growth: Lead a coordinated approach to growing revenue from existing subscribers, including upsell, churn prevention, add-on attachment, cross-sell, and bundling. Evaluate opportunities across these interconnected programs, make deliberate trade-offs, and ensure initiatives work together to improve customer value and business outcomes.
  • Experimentation, Measurement & Optimization: Establish a disciplined experimentation and measurement approach that enables the team to test hypotheses, evaluate incremental impact, and make evidence-based decisions. Guide the development of meaningful success measures, strengthen the team's analytical capabilities, and use insights to prioritize improvements, scale successful programs, and retire ineffective approaches.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Build effective partnerships with vertical marketing, Product, Analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders to connect lifecycle initiatives to shared business priorities. Influence program direction, navigate competing needs, and help teams align around customer behavior and measurable outcomes. Identify opportunities to extend successful approaches across verticals while accounting for differences in business maturity and customer needs.
  • AI Fluency & Team Enablement: Advance responsible and effective AI adoption by establishing shared practices, developing team fluency, and helping marketers apply AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. Evaluate opportunities based on stakeholder value, effort, risk, and readiness, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows. Collaborate with peer managers and senior individual contributors to share learning, support consistent evaluation of AI capabilities, and connect specialists with broader expertise and resources. Balance adoption goals with team capacity, workload, and change readiness to ensure improvements are sustainable.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Seven (7) or more years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, retention, or growth marketing within consumer subscription or mobile app businesses, including a minimum of two (2) or more years of people management experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing marketers, building team capabilities, establishing accountability, and empowering individuals to independently own complex work.
  • Experience building or evolving lifecycle marketing programs or functions, including defining priorities, establishing operating practices, and developing scalable approaches to achieving business objectives.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to evaluate competing opportunities, make informed trade-offs, and translate strategic objectives into actionable team priorities.
  • Deep understanding of post-purchase lifecycle marketing, including onboarding, engagement, feature adoption, churn prevention, and expansion revenue.
  • Strong experimentation and analytical capabilities, including experience designing and evaluating A/B and holdout tests, interpreting customer behavior data, and applying insights to improve retention or revenue outcomes.
  • Experience using lifecycle marketing platforms such as Braze and product analytics tools such as Amplitude to guide program development, experimentation, and performance measurement.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment around shared priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Applied experience using AI tools to improve workflows, analysis, or marketing effectiveness, along with the ability to evaluate appropriate use cases, exercise sound judgment over outputs, and help others adopt effective and responsible practices.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX's Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience standing up or scaling expansion revenue motions (upsell, cross-sell, bundling) on a subscription base.
  • Experience partnering with data science teams to deploy propensity or churn models in production campaigns.
  • Experience with referral, sharing, or community-driven growth programs.
  • Experience with SQL/BigQuery for deeper self-serve analysis.
  • Experience with Liquid templating (or similar) for dynamic personalization in Braze.
  • Experience establishing shared AI workflows, evaluating AI-enabled improvements, or supporting adoption across marketing teams.
  • A personal passion for hunting, offroading, backcountry, or fishing, and time spent using the outdoors the way our customers do.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 and $164,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. jobs.description:
Why this role and why now?

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and every North American customer deserves a steady, predictable experience from contract signature to go‑live. That’s why we’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to give each implementation a single, accountable owner.

This is not a status-reporting role. You understand the work well enough to judge whether a project is really on track, and you catch issues while they are still small.

If you enjoy ownership, bringing structure to fast-moving projects, and shaping how a growing team delivers, this is your moment.

Your impact

As Project Manager, Technical & Functional, you own the plan, budget, risks, and communication for Ultimo implementations across North America. A customer’s maintenance director and IT lead should each see you as someone who understands their side of the project, from work orders and preventive maintenance to data, integrations, and cutover.

You are trusted to lead the project, not just to track it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own scope, plan, budget, resourcing, risks, and issues for North American implementations, from sales handover through go‑live and transition to support
  • Receive the sales-to-delivery handover, confirm nothing promised is undocumented, and run the customer kickoff
  • Run a consistent communication cadence for customers, internal teams, and subcontractors: weekly status, a shared risk and issue log, steering committees, and clear escalation paths
  • Own the change order process, identifying scope change early and securing customer approval before work proceeds
  • Act as the single point of contact for support tickets raised on active projects and track each one to resolution
  • Coordinate consultants, the Solution Architect, the data migration lead, and internal Ultimo services such as our European practice and product specialists as one team
  • Plan and run cutover, go/no‑go decisions, hypercare, and the formal handover to support
  • Help build the North American delivery playbook, and use AI tools to reduce administrative effort
  • Close projects in a way that turns customers into references

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of experience managing EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations for asset-intensive organizations (IBM Maximo, IFS, SAP PM, MainSaver, or similar)
  • Have strong domain knowledge in maintenance work processes, preventive maintenance, inventory, and reliability, and can discuss them with plant and maintenance leaders
  • Understand data migration, integrations, and cutover well enough to plan them, judge progress, and ask the right questions
  • Have managed fixed-price and time-and-materials projects, raised change orders, and protected margin without damaging the relationship
  • Stay calm under pressure, have stabilized a strained project, and deliver difficult messages clearly
  • Enjoy turning ad hoc ways of working into simple, repeatable standards that a growing team will actually use
  • Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and use AI tools in your daily work
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders
  • Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

Ready to step up?

If you’re looking for a role where customers rely on you to keep their implementation on course, and where you can shape how a growing team delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites for kickoffs, steering committees, and go‑live.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.

jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. How will you make an impact?


We are seeking a highly skilled, technically proficient and detail-oriented Sr.Principal Technical Program Manager within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead the architecture, integration, and delivery of advanced air and liquid‑cooled server rack solutions for large-scale deployments.


This role is critical in translating hyperscale data center requirements into robust, scalable, and manufacturable systems for next-gen AI/ML (GPU/CPU), cloud infrastructure, and network deployments. This person will oversee end‑to‑end rack development – from scoping and initial architecture review of customer requirements, through validation and deployment.


This person will also drive cross‑functional collaboration, technical innovation, and continuous improvement across multiple datacenter programs.

What will you do?

  • Provides regular updates to senior leadership, external partners, and internal teams on the status of infrastructure programs, including risks, blockers, and dependencies

  • Proficiency in Agile, Scrum, and/or Waterfall methodologies
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented
  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight
  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides
  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries
  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices
  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones
  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLCM)
  • Able to coach and mentor less experienced engineers
  • Ability to travel both domestically and internationally up to 25%

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree
  • PMP Certification
  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing; experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers (CM) a plus.

  • Support CI/CD practices and contribute to efficient release processes.
  • Develop and maintain unit testing frameworks and quality practices.

  • Bring a consulting mindset, strong client communication, and effective presentation skills to technical discussions and delivery engagements.

  • 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring Developers and Senior Developers.

  • Advanced knowledge of command line build utilities and task runners such as npm, webpack, grunt, and gulp.
  • Advanced knowledge of accessibility standards.
  • Real-time working experience with asynchronous requests, API integrations, partial page updates, SEO optimization, SSR, and page performance troubleshooting and optimization.

  • Proven experience with CI/CD practices.
  • Track record developing unit testing frameworks.

  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud Functions.

  • Strong documentation discipline, commitment to consistency and reusability, and the ability to see the big picture.

How will you make an impact?


  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer, you will build AI-assisted platforms for manufacturing tests and debug automation software with direct, real-world consequences on the factory floor.
  • You will own end-to-end features across event-driven platforms, from cloud infrastructure and backend microservices, up through an agentic LLM pipeline, out to a modern web frontend.
  • LLMs are a core building block of what we build, and AI coding agents are a core part of how we build it but we treat them as power tools operated by strong engineers, not autopilots.
  • This role requires someone who can define work with precision, critically evaluate agent-generated output, and write code themselves when needed.

How We Work with AI

Spec-Driven Development

Correctness Discipline

What will you do?

(LLM reasoning + embeddings):

Python

jobs.title: Tele Supporter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Noora Health Bangladesh is part of Noora Health’s broader mission to improve health outcomes and strengthen health systems by equipping family caregivers with essential skills to care for their loved ones.

Founded in 2014, Noora Health turns hospital hallways and waiting rooms into classrooms by tapping into the most compassionate resources available for the patient’s care: their own family.

With support from governments and partners in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal, Noora Health has trained more than 51.4 million caregivers and patients across 16,000+ facilities using their flagship caregiver education and training curriculum, the Care Companion Program (CCP).

In a cohort of patients, the CCP reduced post-surgical cardiac complications by 71%, maternal complications by 12%, newborn complications by 16%, and newborn mortality by 18%.

Noora Health is an Audacious Project Grantee and received the Skoll Foundation Award for Social Innovation. To learn more, watch our TED Talk, Skoll feature, or read about our partnership with the World Health Organization.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tele-supporter is responsible for engaging with patients and their family members through phone calls to onboard them to Noora Health’s mobile Care Companion health education service. The role involves collecting user information, facilitating access to medically reviewed health education on maternal, newborn, and other relevant health conditions, and addressing user queries through coordination with the Medical Team.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

User Onboarding & Health Communication

  • Conduct scheduled outbound calls to assigned patients and caregivers to introduce the Noora Health mobile Care Companion health education service and complete the onboarding process.
  • Collect relevant user information, document responses and call notes, and submit the required data through SurveyCTO.
  • Communicate health education information reviewed by the Medical Team, addressing topics relevant to antenatal and postnatal care, high-risk newborns, hypertension, diabetes, and surgical recovery.

Question Collection & Follow-up

  • Actively listen to patients' and caregivers' questions, concerns, and feedback during calls, and accurately document them for follow-up.
  • Coordinate with the Medical Support Executive (MSE) team to obtain appropriate responses to health-related queries and communicate the responses to the respective users.

Campaign Monitoring & User Feedback

  • Conduct mid-campaign follow-up calls seven days after onboarding to assess message delivery, user engagement, and any questions or concerns.
  • Conduct post-campaign feedback calls to understand users' experience and satisfaction with the service and collect feedback to identify areas for improvement.

Call Documentation & Operational Support

  • Record all calls, upload recordings to the designated Google Drive folders, and maintain accurate call statuses, notes, and follow-up records in the assigned Tracker.
  • Support supervisors with daily call tracking, workflow coordination, reporting, and other administrative or operational tasks as required.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Public Health, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Psychology, or Nutrition. Candidates with a Bachelor/Master’s of Science (BSc/MSc) in Nursing are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 0-2 years prior experience in tele-calling, call center operations, customer support, counselling, public health interventions, or healthcare delivery is highly preferred.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in standard Bangla with clear pronunciation and articulation. English mixing during calls is not permitted. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Telecommunication Skills: Ability to manage high-volume outbound calls and meet daily call targets, with approximately 90% of working time dedicated to phone-based interactions.
  • Digital Literacy: Proficiency in MS Office (Word and Excel) and digital communication tools such as WhatsApp, Google Drive, Google Meet, and Zoom is required.
  • Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal, active listening, communication, and organisational skills. Demonstrated empathy, adaptability, integrity, and attention to detail, particularly when handling sensitive patient information. Familiarity with basic medical terminology will be an added advantage.

Technical Setup: Must have reliable, high-speed home internet, a personal computer/laptop, and a smartphone in good working condition.

Work Details: Full-time position with a six-day workweek (Saturday to Thursday) and eight-hour daily shifts, including approximately 6.5 hours of active talk time. Flexibility to accommodate program requirements is essential.

WHAT WE VALUE

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we understand the value of developing a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We prioritize diversity within our team, and we welcome candidates from all gender identities, castes, religious practices, sexual orientations, and abilities — among many others.

We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.
