jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, highly technical role responsible for securing JLL’s global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a security-first mindset, a bias towards action, and deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies alongside broad command of API security, WAF/CDN platforms, and complex troubleshooting across network and application layers. You’ll work collaboratively with global engineering, application, and security teams to ensure security controls are intelligence-driven, optimized, and aligned to industry best practices.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks technologies (NGFWs, Cloud NGFW, Panorama), Web Application Firewall, Content Delivery Network, API Security, IDS/IPS, and DDoS prevention
  • Own onboarding, policy tuning, and lifecycle management for WAF and CDN platforms; lead firewall ruleset optimization, IDS/IPS tuning, and DDoS protection configuration
  • Partner with internal teams to drive the global rollout, tuning, and operational management of URL filtering and TLS decryption across the network estate
  • Lead API security efforts — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, identifying vulnerabilities, and working with application teams on fixes
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex, multi-layer global network and application issues — from packet captures on inter-continental BGP topologies to WAF false-positive triage
  • Partner with business and application teams to produce clear, actionable security documentation, change proposals, and executive-ready findings
  • Analyze existing network security architectures, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive meaningful improvements
  • Configure and report on defensive measures against advanced threat actor tactics; maintain current awareness of the evolving threat landscape and the effectiveness of our defenses against them
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both global engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders
  • Champion the broader Security team’s initiatives, not just Network Security Engineering
  • Participate in the maintenance and tuning of all network security technologies including WAFs, CDNs, VPNs, and application-aware firewalls
  • Leverage and contribute to automation pipelines for global firewall rule deployment and policy management across the network estate
  • Utilize security tooling telemetry and data collection automations to produce actionable reporting and metrics for internal teams and executive stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale security solutions
  • Expert-level proficiency in Palo AltoNetworks — NGFWs, Panorama policy management, and PAN-OS; PCNSE or PCNSC certification strongly preferred
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, including packet capture analysis on complex, dynamically routed architectures
  • Deep understanding of layer 7 web application technologies and WAF/CDN platforms (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, Imperva, F5) — onboarding, policy tuning, break/fix troubleshooting, and operational management
  • Solid grounding in API security — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, evaluating identified vulnerabilities, and partnering with application teams to drive remediation
  • Strong HTTP/application security knowledge: TLS interception, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, command injection, LFI/RFI, rate limiting, bot detection, geo-blocking, and sinkholing
  • Intermediate to advanced network routing and switching knowledge with focus on DNS, TCP/IP, IPsec, TLS, GRE, OSPF, and BGP
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) and familiarity with Linux/CLI tooling
  • Working knowledge of public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform for log analysis, behavioral analytics, and rule tuning
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of taking ownership in unstructured environments — cutting through ambiguity, making sound decisions with incomplete information, building stakeholder consensus, and delivering security improvements without waiting for top-down direction

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications: PCNSE, PCNSC, CCNP/CCIE Security, GIAC (GWAPT, GPEN, or similar)
  • Experience building metrics pipelines and KPI reporting for security operations
  • Familiarity with interconnecting disparate security technologies to solve unique application and security challenges

jobs.title: Narrative Writer
jobs.description:
About us

At Longdue, we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.

We focus on creating games with real depth—whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality—everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.

Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.

With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new—a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.

We’re Longdue, and we’re finally here.

The role

We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.

Responsibilities

  • Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.
  • Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.
  • Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.
  • Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.
  • Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.
  • Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.
  • An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.
  • Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.
  • Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.
  • Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.
  • Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits

Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Technical Marketing Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Lead Technical Marketing Manager to shape how Lumen brings its cybersecurity capabilities to market. This role translates complex security technologies, architectures, and threat intelligence into credible technical narratives, demonstrable solutions, seller-ready guidance, and customer experiences that accelerate adoption and revenue.

As a senior individual contributor, you will consult on and lead initiatives in partnership with many functions—Product Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Partners, and our threat research team, Black Lotus Labs. You will own high-impact technical marketing programs across the cybersecurity portfolio and influence product and go-to-market decisions through customer insight, market evidence, technical depth, and commercial judgment.

Location and Schedule

This is a work-from-home position in the United States. Occasional travel is expected for customer engagements, industry events, demonstrations, sales enablement, and team planning sessions.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the technical marketing strategy: Define and execute technical marketing priorities for Lumen cybersecurity solutions, connecting portfolio strategy to customer use cases, architectures, adoption motions, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Create differentiated technical positioning: Develop clear, defensible messaging and value propositions for technical buyers and practitioners, including CISOs, security architects, SOC leaders, network leaders, and cloud security teams.
  • Build solution narratives and architectures: Translate cybersecurity capabilities into end-to-end reference architectures, validated use cases, solution blueprints, integration patterns, and deployment guidance across network, cloud, edge, and security operations environments.
  • Demonstrate the technology: Design and deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical workshops, webinars, videos, labs, and proof-of-value experiences that show how Lumen and its partners solve priority customer problems.
  • Lead technical content development: Create and govern high-value assets such as white papers, technical briefs, solution guides, blogs, FAQs, architecture diagrams, competitive guides, and technical launch materials.
  • Enable sellers and technical teams: Develop role-based training, discovery guidance, objection handling, battlecards, demo scripts, technical FAQs, and field playbooks that improve seller confidence, solution quality, and conversion.
  • Launch and support growth motions: Serve as the technical marketing lead for attach, cross-sell, and expansion motions. Ensure product, marketing, sales, and partner readiness before market activation.
  • Bring market and customer insight into decisions: Use customer conversations, competitive intelligence, analyst research, win-loss findings, field feedback, and performance data to identify gaps and recommend changes to product strategy, positioning, packaging, and activation.
  • Advance partner-led solutions: Collaborate with strategic cybersecurity partners to create integrated technical narratives, validated architectures, joint demonstrations, content, enablement, and go-to-market programs.
  • Represent Lumen as a technical authority: Engage customers, analysts, partners, and industry audiences as a cybersecurity subject-matter expert while maintaining accurate, evidence-based, and brand-safe claims.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Lead complex workstreams without direct authority, establish clear outcomes and ownership, resolve dependencies, and create repeatable methods that improve the quality and speed of technical marketing execution.
  • Measure and optimize impact: Define success metrics and use adoption, pipeline, content, enablement, demonstration, and customer-feedback data to improve programs and prioritize investment.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, engineering, marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree or relevant security certifications are a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in technical marketing, product marketing, product management, solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, cybersecurity consulting, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated cybersecurity depth across several domains such as network security, DDoS mitigation, SASE/SSE, firewalls, cloud security, threat intelligence, or security operations (SIEM/XDR/MDR).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, cloud and hybrid architectures, security controls, telemetry, APIs, integrations, and operational workflows.
  • Proven ability to convert complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, credible proof points, and actionable field guidance.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, reference architectures, workshops, white papers, solution guides, or comparable practitioner-focused content.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively from hands-on practitioners through executive audiences.
  • Ability to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives across multiple functions without direct authority, while maintaining clear decisions, accountability, and momentum.
  • Commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to connect technical marketing investments to adoption, pipeline, revenue, attach, retention, or expansion outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple priorities, high visibility, and a strong expectation for quality and execution.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience marketing managed security, network-embedded security, threat intelligence, or integrated networking and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Experience working with global telecommunications, cloud, networking, or managed security providers and their technology ecosystems.
  • Hands-on familiarity with security platforms, product labs, demonstration environments, scripting, APIs, or data visualization.
  • Established credibility with customers, analysts, technical communities, or industry events through presentations, publications, workshops, or thought leadership.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Genesys Cloud Access Management supports the design, implementation, administration, and optimization of the Genesys contact center platform in support of the Humana Military organization. This role contributes to the development and execution of contact center and customer experience strategies while ensuring seamless integration with existing IT and telecommunications infrastructure. Work assignments are varied and frequently require the interpretation of business and technical requirements, independent judgment, and the determination of appropriate solutions.

This Genesys Cloud Access Management position supports Humana Military's customer engagement and contact center technologies by administering, securing, and optimizing the Genesys Cloud platform with a primary focus on access management, user lifecycle administration, and platform governance. The associate is responsible for provisioning and deprovisioning user accounts, managing roles, permissions, groups, queues, and authentication controls, and ensuring compliance with organizational security and regulatory requirements.

This role partners closely with business, operations, security, and technology teams to ensure associates have appropriate access to Genesys resources while maintaining the integrity, security, and performance of the platform. The Genesys Engineer 2 supports identity and access management processes, audits, reporting, and remediation activities, and assists with implementing role-based access controls, single sign-on integrations, and governance best practices.

In addition to access administration responsibilities, the associate contributes to the ongoing maintenance, enhancement, and support of Genesys Cloud solutions that enable service excellence for military members, providers, and internal associates. Work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation of business and technical requirements, independent judgment, and the determination of appropriate courses of action to resolve complex issues, improve operational efficiency, and support Humana Military's strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and govern access within the Genesys Cloud platform.
  • Manage user provisioning, deprovisioning, role assignments, and permission sets.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, audits, and compliance reporting.
  • Support integration with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including SSO and MFA.
  • Maintain queue, division, group, and organizational access structures.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve access-related issues impacting agents, supervisors, and administrators.
  • Collaborate with Security, Compliance, and Operational teams to enforce access governance standards.
  • Support Genesys platform enhancements, upgrades, and operational initiatives.
  • Document access management processes, standards, and technical procedures.

Use your skills to make an impact

  • Knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege principles, single sign-on (SSO), and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving user access, authentication, and authorization issues.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM Analytics
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity.

The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes.
  • Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions.
  • KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards.
  • Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms.
  • AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation.
  • Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines.
  • Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.
  • Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
  • Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth.
  • Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses.
  • Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics.
  • 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization.
  • Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization.
  • Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation.
  • Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance.
  • Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management.
  • Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation.
  • Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

Additional information

jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity and privacy expertise, solutions, and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach to evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources, and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

We are looking for a motivated and engaging Principal Consultant, Data Governance, to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, individual contributor role with occasional travel to support client consulting engagements. The focus of this role is to deliver GuidePoint’s Data Security Governance and AI Governance services, helping organizations develop their data security and AI governance strategy and build the programs that operationalize it, in alignment with industry leading practices. The successful candidate is a hard-working, self-motivated professional who mentors and shares learnings with colleagues to foster a learning culture.

About the Governance Practice

GuidePoint's Governance and Risk Practice delivers advisory, assessment, strategy, and program development services that help organizations build governance frameworks balancing security requirements with business innovation. While this role focuses on our data-related services, the practice spans a broader portfolio including cyber maturity and risk.

Our consultants and analysts partner with clients across industries to build sustainable governance and risk programs, including:

  • Data security and AI governance (primary focus): Maturity and readiness assessment, strategy, and program development across data security governance (DSMM), AI governance (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), and privacy (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, NIST-P, AICPA PMF)
  • Cyber maturity: NIST CSF-based maturity assessments, advisory, and program development and remediation
  • Cyber risk: Qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, third-party risk, and ongoing risk management services

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Deliver successful Data Security Governance and AI Governance engagements, from maturity and readiness assessments through strategy and program build, while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Help clients develop data security and AI governance strategy and build the supporting program, including target-state roadmaps, operating models, roles, and lifecycle governance, assessed against the DSMM, ISO 42001, and the NIST AI RMF.
  • Develop and present strategic roadmaps, program recommendations, and senior-level summaries to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Advise clients how data security and AI governance tooling technologies map to their data governance, data security governance, and AI governance objectives, including but not limited to Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), data classification and discovery, encryption/tokenization, and data governance/cataloging platforms.
  • Assist with sales by supporting SOWs, proposals, pricing, and RFP responses, and by routing cross-sell opportunities (for example, data security tooling) to adjacent GuidePoint teams.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and mentor, sharing knowledge and developing the skills of colleagues to foster a learning culture across the Governance team.
  • Stay current on evolving data security and AI governance regulations, standards, and best practices, and advise clients on the implications for their programs.
  • Represent GuidePoint as a thought leader in data security and AI governance and contribute to the growth and maturation of the consulting practice.
  • Build strong customer relationships and work with other GuidePoint practices as part of a cohesive cross-functional team.

Required Experience and Education:

  • Minimum of 7+ years in cybersecurity or data governance roles, including 5+ in a client-facing consultant role.
  • Strong understanding of data security governance concepts, controls, and frameworks, including data discovery, classification, and data-centric protection and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience building or assessing AI governance programs, with working knowledge of ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, and the EU AI Act.
  • Proven ability to translate assessment findings into strategy, operating models, roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Strong familiarity with modern AI/ML and automation tooling and concepts (for example, LLMs and Python).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to convey complex concepts to technical and executive audiences and prepare clear, actionable deliverables.
  • Collaborative team player with a growth mindset, able to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to simplify complex issues and provide pragmatic advice and practical solutions that can be operationalized.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Expertise in data privacy is an optional and nice-to-have skill, including familiarity with frameworks such as NIST Privacy, ISO 27701, AICPA PMF, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA and the ability to deliver privacy gap and program assessments.
  • Strong preference for candidates who can deliver data security governance and AI governance assessment and strategy engagements and extend across the broader data governance portfolio.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CDPSE, AIGP, CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPT, or CIPM.
  • Thought leadership through white papers, webinars, published content, and conference speaking on data security governance, AI governance, and other GRC trends.

  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

The Program Manager, Engineering Services is the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients and owns their success end to end: delivery quality, client satisfaction and commercial growth. You will lead multidisciplinary teams delivering utility design and subsurface engineering scopes, keep contracts on schedule and on margin, and turn strong delivery into follow-on work.

This is a true seller-doer role that sits between delivery and growth. You run the work, you own the relationship, and you help win what comes next.

What You'll Do

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients, from contract award through closeout and renewal.
  • Own client satisfaction: set expectations, report status, resolve issues quickly and escalate early on scope, schedule or budget risk.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across owner and prime-consultant organizations, from project engineers to program directors.
  • Lead regular project and business reviews covering performance, outcomes and value delivered.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on engineering design processes, adoption of AI technologies, and management of project risk.

Deliver engineering-services contracts

  • Take overall accountability for the quality of engineering-services deliverables, including utility design, conflict analysis and subsurface utility engineering scopes.
  • Establish the work plan, fee estimate, schedule and staffing for each phase, and lead the kickoff with client stakeholders.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams of engineers, designers, and data specialists to produce on-time, on-budget deliverables.
  • Confirm deliverables meet client, agency and industry standards at conceptual and final design levels.
  • Drive the QA/QC plan, assign qualified technical reviewers and ensure sealed or certified deliverables meet professional standards.
  • Manage subconsultants and teaming partners against scope, schedule, quality and contract requirements.

Control scope, schedule and margin

  • Own project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs; track hours, expenses and earned value.
  • Maintain the project management plan, risk register, decision log and change documentation.
  • Identify scope changes early and manage change requests and contract amendments with the client.
  • Lead recovery planning on troubled projects and run lessons-learned at closeout.

Win future work with key clients

  • Join pursuit teams for future work with key clients, contributing to go/no-go decisions, win strategy, pricing and risk reviews.
  • Lead or support technical approach, staffing and scope sections of proposals, and present in interviews.
  • Track upcoming client programs, solicitations and contract vehicles (IDIQ, on-call, task-order and design-build teaming).

Grow key accounts

  • Own commercial growth of assigned key accounts, with targets for retention, expansion and follow-on contract value.
  • Build and execute account plans aligned to each client's capital program, project pipeline and digital-delivery goals.
  • Identify expansion opportunities: new task orders, additional programs and divisions, and cross-sell of Exodigo mapping and digital-twin services.
  • Partner with Sales on handoffs into long-term account ownership and on new opportunities you surface.
  • Keep CRM records current for account health, pipeline and forecast.

Lead and collaborate

  • Mentor and develop project staff; provide performance input to their managers.
  • Work with Engineering, Operations, Product and Sales to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Feed client insight back into Exodigo's service offerings, AI-assisted design tools and product roadmap.
  • Represent Exodigo at client meetings, industry events and professional organizations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Electrical or a related engineering discipline.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in at least one US state, with the ability to obtain comity licenses as needed.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years managing design or engineering-services contracts for clients.
  • Public-sector client experience (state DOTs, transit agencies, airports, public utilities or municipalities) is required.
  • Proven record of growing and retaining large, complex client accounts, with follow-on work you helped win.
  • Working knowledge of utility design and coordination, and of subsurface utility engineering.
  • Strong command of project controls: work plans, fee estimates, budgets, schedules, earned value, change management and risk registers.
  • Experience preparing proposals and presenting in client interviews.
  • Understanding of public-sector procurement and contract types, including QBS, IDIQ / on-call, task-order and design-build delivery.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% and work effectively in a remote, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Engineering.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), DBIA or CCM certification.
  • Experience in transportation, rail, aviation, power or water infrastructure programs.
  • Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build or alliance delivery, including bridging documents.
  • Experience working for or teaming with large AEC/EPC firms as prime or subconsultant.
  • Familiarity with geophysical methods (GPR, EM, magnetics) and ASCE 75 utility as-built data standards.
  • Proficiency with design and BIM tools (MicroStation/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, Revit) and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Interest in applying AI-assisted design to engineering production.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations (ASCE, ACEC, ARTBA, APTA, ACI-NA or similar).

Key strengths

jobs.title: Java Developer-AML
jobs.description:
Description

Java Developer – Data Adapters (AML Platform)

Position Overview

Matrix is seeking experienced Java Developers to design, develop, and support data adapters that integrate banking source systems with an enterprise anti-money-laundering (AML) platform powered by NICE Actimize.

Data adapters are responsible for extracting data from upstream banking systems, validating and transforming it into the required target format, and loading it into the AML platform. These feeds include transactions, trades, accounts, customer and party information, and reference data. The accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of this data are critical to effective AML transaction monitoring, alert generation, and case management.

The ideal candidates will have strong backend Java development experience, hands-on expertise in ETL or data integration, and the ability to manage data adapters throughout the development lifecycle—from source-to-target mapping and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Java-based data adapters to ingest data from batch files, database extracts, message queues, and REST APIs.
  • Analyze source-system specifications and translate source-to-target mapping requirements into reliable transformation, enrichment, and validation logic.
  • Integrate data from banking systems into the AML platform, ensuring alignment with the platform's data model and interface requirements.
  • Implement data-quality and reconciliation controls, including schema validation, null checks, duplicate detection, record counts, control totals, and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • Develop robust error-handling and recovery mechanisms, including reject and error queues, restart and reprocessing capabilities, idempotent processing, logging, and alerting.
  • Optimize adapter performance to process high-volume data efficiently and meet defined batch windows and service-level agreements.
  • Apply bulk loading, partitioning, parallel processing, and SQL optimization techniques to improve throughput and processing efficiency.
  • Develop and execute unit and integration tests, and support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production deployments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement fixes across source, adapter, and target systems.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, Actimize implementation teams, and client source-system teams to onboard new data feeds and manage upstream changes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, data lineage, and operational runbooks to support auditability and ongoing maintenance.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow established coding, security, testing, and release-management standards.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Java: 5+ years of backend Java development experience, with strong knowledge of Core Java, including collections, concurrency, streams, I/O, and exception handling. Java 11 or 17 preferred; Java 8 or later required.
  • Data Integration: At least 2 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting production ETL, data ingestion, or data integration solutions.
  • Frameworks: Strong experience with Spring and Spring Boot; hands-on experience with Spring Batch or an equivalent batch-processing framework.
  • SQL and Databases: Strong SQL skills with Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including complex queries, stored procedures, indexing, execution plans, JDBC, and bulk-loading techniques.
  • Data Formats and Integration: Experience working with delimited and fixed-width files, XML, JSON, SFTP, REST APIs, and messaging technologies such as Kafka or IBM MQ.
  • Data Mapping: Ability to interpret source specifications and target schemas and develop accurate, documented source-to-target mappings.

Company Overview

Job Purpose and Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Architect to design and manage the data infrastructure that supports reporting, advanced analytics, and AI applications across WRS Health. This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.

  • Define data models, storage strategies, and integration patterns for structured and unstructured healthcare data.

  • Build and maintain pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and validate data from clinical, financial, operational, and marketing systems.

  • Partner with AI Engineers to define data requirements and prepare datasets for model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Design the data foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, vector storage, and retrieval.

  • Establish shared data interfaces and APIs that enable AI Engineers to integrate LLM capabilities into EHR applications.

  • Manage data storage and retrieval for patient records, IoT, genomic, microbiome, and government datasets.

  • Support healthcare interoperability using FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, C-CDA, NCPDP, and X12 standards.

  • Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.

  • Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.

  • Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.

  • Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.

  • Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.

  • Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.

  • Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.

  • Working knowledge of LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex to collaborate effectively with AI Engineers.

  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls for sensitive healthcare information.

  • Experience with FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, X12, and healthcare data exchange is highly preferred.

  • Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

  • AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.

  • Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.

  • Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.

About the Role

Scorpion is hiring a Product Marketing Manager to drive revenue growth and product adoption by supporting go-to-market execution. Working across product, marketing, and sales, this role helps turn product value into compelling positioning, content, and enablement that support commercial success. You'll help ensure Scorpion's products reach the right clients with the right message, contributing to product performance, cross-functional alignment, and overall company impact.

You're right for this role if you're a clear, curious communicator who enjoys turning complex product details into messaging people understand and connect with. You like being close to both the product and the field, talking to sales, digging into data, understanding how to tell a good story, and building the content that supports a deal. You're organized, collaborative, and eager to grow your craft alongside more senior product marketers. You are curious, you understand how to use data to simplify a story and create a differentiated message, and you have a proven track record of driving revenue growth for a business.

You should be deeply committed about understanding our clients' pain points and how they actually use our products, and you'll treat client and prospect interviews as a core, recurring part of the job, not an occasional check-in.

What Your Success Will Look Like

  • Support Go-to-Market Execution: Support execution of go-to-market plans by coordinating timelines, assets, and cross-functional check-ins to help ensure on-time, high-quality delivery.
  • Contribute to Messaging & Positioning: Help develop differentiated messaging and positioning based on client research, product insights, and competitive analysis.
  • Build Full-Funnel Content: Develop content and messaging across the full customer journey to support awareness, adoption, and retention. This team should deliver an ongoing and consistent drumbeat externally that showcases our products, our customers benefiting from our products, and their value to the market.
  • Assist with Win/Loss Analysis: Participate in win and loss analysis and help document insights for product, campaign, and market teams.
  • Support Client & Prospect Research: Support ongoing client and prospect interviews to understand pain points, adoption and engagement opportunities, and feed those insights directly into positioning and messaging.
  • Partner with Client Experience: Work with the Client Experience team to surface client sentiment, usage trends, and recurring pain points that should inform messaging and go-to-market strategy and support sales enablement materials.
  • Build Trust with Product Management: Build strong, trusted relationships with Product Management, partnering closely to translate product direction and client needs into go-to-market plans.
  • Support alignment of Messaging with Sales: Work closely with Sales to understand which messages are resonating in the field and which aren't, using that feedback to continuously sharpen positioning.
  • Support Account Management on Upsell and Feedback: Partner with Account Management to understand how messaging can support upsell and expansion motions, and to capture ongoing feedback from existing clients.

Who You Are And What You Bring

  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience
    • 2-4 years of experience in product marketing or B2B marketing, with hands-on exposure to go-to-market execution and messaging.
    • Content Creation: Experience creating content and assets that support awareness, adoption, and retention across the customer journey.
    • Project Management: Experience managing multiple campaigns, launches, or enablement projects simultaneously, with accountability for timelines and quality.
    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with sales, demand generation, and product teams to align on messaging and campaign needs.
    • Nice to Have:
      • Relevant Background: Background in B2B digital marketing services, SaaS, or Martech.
      • SMB Familiarity: Familiarity with SMB or local-business buyer journeys.
  • Skills
    • Messaging & Positioning: Ability to develop and refine messaging and positioning based on research, product input, and competitive context.
    • Emerging Trends & Tools: Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging GTM tools and formats, including AI-driven content, and proactively share ideas with the team.
    • Analytical Skills: Proficiency with tools such as Salesforce, Seismic, ClickUp, and basic reporting dashboards to track content and campaign performance.
    • B2B Marketing Knowledge: Understanding of B2B buying cycles and how product marketing supports pipeline and revenue goals.
    • Communication Skills: Ability to translate product details and campaign results into clear, actionable content for sales and marketing partners.
    • Initiative & Independence: Ability to manage assigned responsibilities independently, take initiative, and proactively communicate when additional support is needed.
    • Nice to Have:
      • Content Skills: Copywriting or content creation experience.
      • Data Skills: Comfort working with data in Excel, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Travel: Minimal - occasional travel for team off-sites or company events, as needed.

Our Scorpion Values

  • Winning Mindset: When our clients win, we win.
  • Genuine Care: We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
  • Unmatched Results: We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
  • Constant Improvement: We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask “What if?” we build and then do it again.
  • Unbeatable Teamwork: We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

Compensation

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

  • The base salary range is $120,000 (entry-level) - $150,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth.
  • The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

Our Benefits

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits
  • Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work

Work Location & Flexibility

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. About the Role:

Product Marketing at Ordergroove sits at the intersection of market insight and product momentum. You'll develop a sharp understanding of our products, our customers and the industry then use that intelligence to shape product stories, enablement playbooks, and competitive positioning that drive new bookings and merchant growth.

This is a deeply cross-functional role, partnering across Product and Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and beyond. You'll work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery through Early Access and GA to post-launch adoption.

We're looking for product marketers who are creative, analytical, and detail-oriented, with strong communication, cross functional alignment, AI knowledge, and project management chops. You'll be one of two PMMs, which means high ownership and scope with significant impact.

  • Bring a storyteller's instinct to everything you touch, flexing your communication to land with any audience, from an enterprise buying committee and CDO to an ecomm manager, and distilling complex products into value propositions people actually remember.
  • Own the voice of the customer, win/loss analysis, ICP, and market signals, and bring ARR-weighted customer and competitive insight into each roadmap planning cycle. You hunt for non-obvious insights and pair them with genuine passion for users, producing balanced, thoughtful points of view on how to take products to market.

This role is deeply collaborative and async-first; sometimes you're driving the bus, sometimes you're along for the ride, either way you work well across disciplines to get things shipped.

  • Executive presence and judgment. A trusted advisor to senior leaders. Steady under pressure and sound in sensitive or high-stakes situations.

jobs.title: Senior Modeling & Simulation Engineer: Power Systems
jobs.description:
Overview

    The technology that powers Mainspring’s linear generator is unlike any other generator technology on the market. The linear generator relies on innovative power electronics and control systems to achieve its best-in-class efficiency while meeting the world’s strictest emissions requirements. Our generators are being deployed in both front-of-the-meter and behind-the-meter applications, as blackstart-capable backup power and prime-power applications, and in microgrids, datacenters, and utility installations. Before a single unit is energized, our customers and suppliers need to know exactly how it will behave on their electrical systems.

    We have a high impact opportunity for a Modeling and Simulation Engineer to own the electromagnetic transient (EMT) models that Mainspring delivers to customers and suppliers. On the system modeling and simulation team, you will turn our product specifications and control system behavior into professional, versioned, customer-facing simulation models: an executable version of what Mainspring commits to. This role requires a quantitative understanding of power systems combined with a passion and aptitude for software, and the ability to bridge controls, electrical engineering, and product teams.
    Your success in this role will be instrumental in helping customers confidently integrate Mainspring linear generators into their electrical systems, shortening the path from proposal to interconnection to deployment. As the steward of how our generator appears to the outside world, you will collaborate across technical domains, frequently working with leaders in controls, electrical engineering, product development, and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the EMT models (e.g. PSCAD) of Mainspring linear generators that we deliver to customers and suppliers. These models cover DC power generation, startup, load steps and sheds, voltage and frequency disturbance, and IEEE 1547/2800 or NERC PRC-029 ride through scenarios
  • Identify the salient electrical behavior of the generator and its control system, and capture it in reduced-order and behavioral models that integrate with supplier inverter models and customer interconnection studies
  • Partner with product management and leadership to make sure every delivered model faithfully represents the contractual specified generator capabilities and maintain requirements for the simulation system based on input from customers and product management
  • Work with suppliers, such as inverter manufacturers, to integrate their models with ours, and support customers in grid integration and system studies
  • Manage models as a software product: maintain the git repository, version each release, write release notes and user documentation, and package deliverables professionally for external audiences
  • Generate test plans to validate model behavior against measured data from Mainspring linear generators. Oversee the execution of those plans with support from the test team
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers and suppliers using Mainspring models. Troubleshoot integration issues and feed what you learn back into the models
  • Contribute power systems expertise to the team's model-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop environments and to system simulations
  • Participate in peer review of code written in support of modeling, control, and software work throughout the team.
  • Generate written documentation (presentations, reports, etc.) of model design and simulation results for audiences both inside and outside Mainspring

Qualifications

  • Engineering degree (Electrical preferred, or another discipline with a strong electrical background) with a strong foundation in applied mathematics
  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with 5+ years of practical experience in power systems or power electronics: grid integration, inverter-based resources, electrical machines, DC systems, etc.
  • Familiarity with numerical techniques for simulating electrical systems and their use within commercial packages (e.g. PSCAD, EMTP, PowerFactory, Simulink/Simscape Electrical, PLECS, etc.)
  • Experience designing, building, and validating dynamic system models in a simulation environment or high-level programming language
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical behavior to external audiences
  • A power systems or power electronics background is the key filter. DevOps skills can be learned on the job. Previous PSCAD experience is a very strong nice to have, and should be achievable

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
RedSeal, a pioneer in preemptive exposure management and winner of the SC Award for Best CTEM Solution, helps organizations see, understand, and secure their hybrid digital environments across IT (on-prem, cloud, and remote workers), OT, and IoT. By dynamically modeling the entire environment, RedSeal uncovers hidden assets, misconfigurations, and lateral attack paths, prioritizes exposures based on business-critical impact with Risk Radius™, and continuously validates compliance with internal policies and industry standards. Trusted by hundreds of Fortune 1000 companies and more than 75 U.S. government agencies, including all five branches of the U.S. military, RedSeal strengthens resilience, streamlines operations, and reduces business risk. Learn more at www.redseal.net.

Overview
As a Sales Engineer, you will establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with customers as you communicate to understand their hybrid environment, security architecture, and operations, and help them define their exposure management objectives while mapping them to RedSeal capabilities. This role requires hands-on leadership to resolution of technical/integration problems effectively escalating critical issues of both technical and operational natures. You will provide standard and customized training on the RedSeal platform while providing accurate, complete and timely written documentation for all project phases. You must have demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with customer representatives at all levels of the organization, from highly technical to senior management.


Performance Objectives
A RedSeal Sales Engineer performs a wide variety of technical sales activities including:
  • Partnering with Sales Directors to plan and execute technical sales strategies for each account, including briefings, demonstrations, proposals, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical issue resolution.
  • Establishing and proactively maintaining value-added relationships with customers and partners.
  • Conducting technical discovery to identify customer requirements, use cases, success criteria, and potential obstacles to a successful evaluation.
  • Assessing the customer's IT, OT, IoT, cloud, and hybrid environments, including their security architecture, existing technologies, and operational processes.
  • Understanding the customer's cybersecurity and exposure management objectives and mapping them to RedSeal capabilities and measurable business outcomes.
  • Delivering standard and tailored demonstrations that illustrate attack paths, exploitable exposures, segmentation gaps, security control effectiveness, and risk-based prioritization.
  • Planning, executing, and documenting PoCs in accordance with RedSeal’s PoC methodology, including defining success criteria, validating technical requirements, and coordinating the transition to Professional Services.
  • Defining practical integration strategies that align RedSeal with the customer's existing technology ecosystem, supported data sources, security tools, and operational workflows.
  • Providing technical guidance on RedSeal's integration capabilities, data requirements, interoperability, and deployment considerations.
  • Translating technical findings into actionable business risk insights for technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Leading hands-on troubleshooting and resolution of technical and integration challenges.
  • Effectively escalating critical technical and operational issues.
  • Providing standard and customized training on the RedSeal platform.
  • Responding to technical sections of RFIs, RFPs, and security questionnaires.
  • Identifying opportunities for additional use cases, integrations, and expansion of RedSeal's value within customer environments.
  • Providing ongoing technical engagement with existing customers to support platform adoption, identify additional use cases, and help customers maximize the value of their RedSeal investment.
  • Collaborating with Professional Services, Support, and account teams on post-sales technical initiatives, including integration enhancements, complex technical challenges, and expansion opportunities.
  • Collaborating with Product Management and Engineering to communicate customer requirements, product feedback, technical limitations, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Contributing to internal technical enablement through knowledge sharing, demonstration development, best practices, and reusable technical resources.
  • Maintaining awareness of competing technologies and effectively communicating RedSeal's technical differentiation and value.
  • Effectively communicating project status, technical findings, risks, and issues to customers and RedSeal stakeholders.

A successful RedSeal Sales Engineer is an effective team player who collaborates across the organization and with external partners, including:
  • Sales Directors, to align technical activities with account strategies, qualify opportunities, and effectively position RedSeal within customer environments.
  • Professional Services, to coordinate technical requirements, architecture and deployment considerations, and ensure a smooth transition from technical evaluation to implementation.
  • Support Team, to troubleshoot, escalate, and resolve product issues encountered during customer engagements.
  • Product Management, to communicate customer requirements, product feedback, technical limitations, and opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Engineering, to collaborate on complex technical challenges, integration requirements, product capabilities, and issue resolution.
  • Marketing, to align technical messaging, demonstrations, collateral, and competitive positioning with RedSeal's exposure management strategy.
  • Partners and Resellers, to support joint technical engagements, solution positioning, integrations, and partner enablement.

Through your work with customers and partners, you will identify new techniques, best practices, methodologies, and exposure management use cases, as well as opportunities to improve the RedSeal platform. Sharing this knowledge through internal and external training materials, technical documentation, demonstrations, webinars, and other enablement resources is an important part of this role.

Required Qualifications/Skills

jobs.description:
ABOUT WORLDWIDE MISSION CRITICAL
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will play a critical role in guiding the planning, coordination, and execution of advanced electrical systems on large-scale infrastructure projects. You will work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners to ensure that all designs are technically robust, code-compliant, and aligned with project objectives. Your focus will be on delivering reliable, efficient, and scalable electrical solutions while upholding safety, quality, cost, and schedule commitments.

Primary Responsibilities

  • You will serve as a key liaison between internal departments, external consultants, contractors, and the Engineer of Record (EoR) to troubleshoot and resolve electrical design challenges.

  • You will lead the development and review of electrical documents, including one-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, submittals, technical studies, and RFIs.

  • You will research and develop emerging trends and new technologies to optimize electrical systems and infrastructure in data centers, enhancing efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

  • You will be responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of design packages by identifying bottlenecks, introducing efficiencies, and proactively managing evolving project requirements.

  • You will ensure electrical systems meet all applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IEC) while maintaining design quality and mitigating technical risk.

  • You will contribute to budget management by evaluating the cost impact of design changes, tracking electrical expenditures, and analyzing contractual obligations tied to the EoR.

  • You will participate in risk assessment and commissioning efforts, including factory and site acceptance testing, milestone inspections, and integration verification.

  • You will coordinate closely with mechanical, controls, and architectural teams to ensure the electrical systems are fully integrated into the broader design framework.

  • You will mentor and support junior engineers, reinforcing consistent design practices and ensuring knowledge continuity across the team.

  • You will help capture lessons learned and apply them to improve future design processes, standards, and project outcomes.

  • You will support construction activities in the field, resolving installation issues, conducting walkthroughs, and ensuring a successful handoff to operations.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Engineering with electrical building systems emphasis.

  • Revit BIM design experience required.

  • Proficiency in power distribution and lighting design, including controls implementation.

  • Experience with short circuit analysis and utilization of analytical modeling software such as SKM or similar tools.

  • Strong background in the design, construction, and commissioning of medium and low voltage electrical distribution systems, and power management or SCADA tools.

  • Preferred qualifications include a Professional Engineering (PE) license.

  • Experience in mission-critical facilities and their electrical/mechanical infrastructure.

  • Knowledge and experience in estimating, electrical design, operation, and commissioning of substations, switchgear, and power monitoring.

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in A/E industry preferred.

  • Comprehensive understanding of professional services from conceptual design through project close-out.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, organizational skills, and ability to motivate and mentor staff.

  • Familiarity with sustainable design approaches and related project impacts.

  • Passion for improving workflows and mentoring team members.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Productivity Suite products.

If you're ready to bring your expertise to a team that's redefining how data centers get built, we'd love to hear from you. At Worldwide Mission Critical, you'll find the support, trust, and room to grow that helped us become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country — and we're just getting started.

Abbott Medical Devices, with revenue of $21B in 2025, is a global leader in providing life changing technology for the management and treatment of people living with chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease, chronic pain, and movement disorders.


The Opportunity

The Senior Clinical Monitoring Lead (CML) serves as the regional subject matter expert for clinical monitoring quality, oversight, and execution. This role partners with Clinical Site Management Leadership to drive monitoring excellence through report quality review, monitoring performance oversight, training, mentoring, compliance support, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

The Senior CML provides leadership and support to Clinical Site Leads across the region, helping ensure consistent execution of monitoring plans, regulatory compliance, timely issue resolution, and adherence to company standards. As a recognized monitoring expert, the Senior CML acts as a key liaison among field monitoring teams, study teams, and quality functions to support operational effectiveness and inspection readiness.


As a recognized subject matter expert in Site Quality Monitoring, KCI process, SIV, PMV, and COV, the Senior CML will exhibit fluency on monitoring-related clinical data systems and study-specific Monitoring Plans. Along with monitoring their own assigned sites, the Senior CML will provide direct mentorship on monitoring training, execution, and best practices for all Clinical Site Lead’s throughout the region and also serve as a liaison to Field Clinical Quality Managers.


May be consulted in the following areas: study design, site payments, site audits, local document review, study documents preparation, and submission to site or competent authority/ethics committee. Beyond monitoring assigned sites, the Senior CML is a nationally recognized leader/expert in monitoring who provides support, mentoring and guidance to other clinical site management colleagues and consistently delivers prolific contributions to Global Clinical Operations and/or Business Units.

Strategic Contributions
