jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Product Designer

Remote (US) | Full-time | Salary + Equity

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help define how people interact with our product in an AI-native world.

This is not a traditional design role where you receive fully scoped tickets and produce polished mockups in isolation. You’ll work directly with engineering, product, and customers to shape the core product experience from first principles. You’ll design workflows where AI is not a bolt-on feature, but a fundamental part of how users think, decide, create, automate, and get work done.

You should be excited by ambiguity, fast iteration, and the opportunity to help build product experiences that feel dramatically better than the SaaS tools people are used to today. We care about taste, speed, craft, product thinking, and your ability to turn messy product ideas into simple, useful, elegant experiences.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help shape and execute design across our core product experience, from early discovery through shipped products. This includes:

  • Designing AI-native workflows that help users move faster, reduce manual work, and trust the system

  • Translating complex product, data, and automation concepts into intuitive user experiences

  • Partnering closely with engineering and product to rapidly prototype, test, and ship new ideas

  • Creating flows, wireframes, prototypes, interaction models, and high-fidelity product designs

  • Defining UX patterns for AI-assisted experiences, including agents, copilots, approvals, suggestions, generated outputs, human-in-the-loop review, and automation transparency

  • Talking to users, watching how they work, and using those insights to improve the product

  • Building and maintaining a lightweight design system that helps us move quickly without sacrificing quality

  • Improving onboarding, activation, navigation, information architecture, and product clarity

  • Using AI tools as part of your own design workflow to move faster and explore more options

  • Raising the product bar by bringing strong taste, clear thinking, and a deep care for usability

What Makes This Role Different

We are building for a world where software is no longer just forms, dashboards, filters, and static workflows. The best products will increasingly feel like intelligent systems that understand context, anticipate work, and help users accomplish outcomes with less friction.

That creates new design challenges:

  • How should users understand what the AI knows and does not know?

  • When should the product act automatically versus ask for approval?

  • How do we make AI-generated work trustworthy, editable, and explainable?

  • How do we help users feel in control without making them do unnecessary manual work?

  • How do we design interfaces that combine deterministic software, probabilistic AI, and human judgment?

You’ll help answer these questions through real product work.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have 3–5 years of product design experience working on complex software, ideally B2B, SaaS, developer tools, data products, productivity tools, or AI products

  • Have excellent UX and product instincts, with the ability to translate customer problems into clear requirements and simplify complicated workflows without losing power or flexibility.

  • Are comfortable working from rough ideas, customer problems, or technical concepts rather than polished product specs

  • Can move quickly from low-fidelity exploration to high-quality shipped design

  • Have strong visual design taste and care about details, hierarchy, spacing, interaction, and clarity

  • Are comfortable working directly with engineers and product leaders

  • Can explain your design decisions clearly and invite critique without becoming defensive

  • Are curious about AI and actively use AI tools in your own work

  • Have a bias toward shipping and learning rather than perfecting work in a vacuum

  • Are ambitious, take ownership of your work, and are eager to develop stronger product thinking and strategic design skills over time

AI-Native Design Experience

You do not need to have spent years designing AI products, but you should be deeply interested in them. We want someone who is actively experimenting with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, Midjourney, Runway, or similar tools to accelerate research, prototyping, ideation, writing, and production.

We’re especially excited about designers who think AI changes the product design process itself. You should be interested in using AI to generate concepts, test flows, analyze user feedback, write microcopy, prototype faster, and explore product directions that would have previously taken much longer.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing AI copilots, agents, automation tools, workflow builders, or data-heavy interfaces

  • Experience designing for operations teams, product teams, engineering teams, or internal tools

  • Experience with front-end implementation, design engineering, or prototyping in code

Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking a highly experienced Senior AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect to support the design, planning, and implementation of advanced artificial intelligence computing environments for enterprise organizations.

This position requires a technical leader with extensive experience in GPU-accelerated infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), enterprise networking, storage architecture, and AI platform integration.

The ideal candidate will combine deep infrastructure engineering expertise with the ability to advise customers on complex technology investments, develop scalable solutions, and translate business requirements into practical architecture designs.

This individual will collaborate with engineering teams, technical stakeholders, and business leadership to develop infrastructure solutions capable of supporting demanding AI workloads, including large language models (LLMs), machine learning, model training, and enterprise inference applications.

The role requires both hands-on technical knowledge and the ability to lead architectural discussions with senior IT executives.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Infrastructure Architecture

  • Design enterprise-scale infrastructure environments supporting AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads.

  • Develop architecture solutions integrating GPU compute platforms, high-throughput networking, enterprise storage, and workload orchestration technologies.

  • Evaluate infrastructure requirements based on application performance, scalability, resource utilization, and operational costs.

  • Produce technical architecture documentation, infrastructure diagrams, hardware specifications, and implementation plans.

  • Lead infrastructure discovery sessions and technical workshops to identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Design solutions supporting on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid AI computing environments.

  • Assess existing data center infrastructure and recommend upgrades necessary to support GPU-intensive computing.

GPU Computing and Accelerated Infrastructure

  • Architect solutions utilizing NVIDIA accelerated computing technologies and alternative GPU platforms.

  • Provide technical guidance on NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing environments.

  • Evaluate NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell architectures for AI training and inference requirements.

  • Design scalable GPU clusters supporting distributed computing and resource-intensive AI applications.

  • Support GPU platform sizing, performance analysis, capacity planning, and infrastructure optimization.

  • Evaluate AMD Instinct and Intel accelerator technologies when appropriate for customer workloads.

  • Assess infrastructure dependencies including rack density, power distribution, cooling, and physical data center capacity.

High-Performance Networking and Storage

  • Develop high-bandwidth network architectures designed for distributed GPU processing and AI applications.

  • Design and evaluate InfiniBand, RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet connectivity solutions.

  • Integrate high-performance storage platforms supporting large-scale data processing and model training.

  • Evaluate NVMe-based storage, parallel file systems, and distributed storage technologies.

  • Identify network and storage bottlenecks that could affect AI workload performance.

  • Collaborate with network, storage, and data center engineering teams to ensure infrastructure interoperability.

AI Platforms, Automation, and Workload Management

  • Design infrastructure platforms supporting containerized AI applications and distributed computing workloads.

  • Implement architectural solutions involving Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift AI, and Linux-based computing environments.

  • Evaluate workload management platforms including NVIDIA Run:ai, Slurm, and other GPU scheduling technologies.

  • Provide architectural guidance for NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related AI infrastructure software.

  • Support integration of MLOps platforms used for model development, training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Develop infrastructure automation strategies to improve deployment consistency, operational efficiency, and resource utilization.

  • Assist with capacity planning and performance optimization for AI training and inference workloads.

Infrastructure Security and Governance

  • Incorporate enterprise security requirements into AI infrastructure architecture.

  • Design secure environments supporting sensitive datasets, proprietary AI models, and regulated workloads.

  • Implement architectural controls supporting workload isolation, identity management, access control, and infrastructure monitoring.

  • Evaluate security considerations associated with shared GPU resources and multi-tenant computing environments.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to align infrastructure solutions with applicable organizational and regulatory requirements.

  • Provide guidance on infrastructure logging, observability, auditability, and operational resilience.

Technical Consulting and Solution Development

  • Serve as a senior technical advisor during customer discovery, solution planning, and architecture engagements.

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into actionable infrastructure recommendations.

  • Work with technical sales and delivery teams to develop solution designs, equipment requirements, implementation strategies, and project estimates.

  • Present proposed architectures to technical teams, IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.

  • Evaluate competing technology solutions and provide objective recommendations based on performance, cost, and business requirements.

  • Develop reusable technical documentation, architecture standards, and solution frameworks.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects.

  • Maintain awareness of emerging AI infrastructure technologies and evolving industry architecture practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or related disciplines.

  • Significant experience designing complex data center or high-performance computing environments.

  • Strong knowledge of NVIDIA GPU computing technologies and enterprise AI infrastructure.

  • Experience with accelerated computing platforms, GPU cluster architecture, and infrastructure sizing.

  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure software, GPU orchestration, and workload scheduling technologies.

  • Experience producing high-level designs, detailed technical specifications, and infrastructure implementation documentation.

jobs.description:
Claims Counsel

Location: Preference for New York, NY, Philadelphia, Chicago, or Austin, but open to Remote

About WithCoverage:

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound). We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us:

  • Grow Faster – We’re scaling quickly, giving you significant opportunities to learn, lead, and shape your career and the company's future.
  • Work That Matters – We protect the world’s most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.
  • Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.
  • Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. That means competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own complex claims end-to-end across GL, Cyber, D&O, Property, and Marine/Cargo lines—triaging new matters, confirming coverage, coordinating carrier notices, and driving resolution strategies through to closure.
  • Serve as the primary client advocate, translating coverage and litigation issues into clear guidance, managing expectations, and aligning carriers, counsel, and vendors around the client’s best outcome.
  • Analyze and negotiate coverage positions, drafting demand and rebuttal letters, challenging denials, and securing optimal defense and indemnity contributions from insurers.
  • Oversee litigation and recovery efforts, ensuring defense and coverage counsel strategies align with policy recovery, and leading loss quantification for property, cyber, and other first-party claims.
  • Manage external partners and internal team members, setting standards for claims handling, mentoring analysts, and maintaining high-quality, audit-ready files and documentation.
  • Deliver insights and reporting through claims data, dashboards, and renewal narratives—identifying trends, coverage gaps, and opportunities to improve client programs and outcomes.
  • Continuously improve processes and tools, partnering with Operations and Product to streamline claims workflows, automate documentation, and enhance the client experience.

What success looks like:

  • Shortened claim cycle times and increased recovery/indemnity percentages (especially in the first‑party).
  • Fewer coverage disputes/denials through early positioning and escalations that stick.
  • High client satisfaction (clear communication, predictable updates, strong outcomes).

Who You Are:

  • Experienced claims professional with 5–10 years managing complex commercial insurance claims—ideally across GL, Cyber, D&O, Property, and Marine/Cargo—within a carrier, law firm, or brokerage environment.
  • Coverage-driven mindset with a J.D. and active bar membership; skilled in analyzing policy wording, drafting coverage positions, and advocating for insureds in high-stakes matters.
    Full-lifecycle operator comfortable owning claims from first notice through resolution, including coverage analysis, litigation oversight, negotiation, and first-party recovery.
  • Client-focused communicator who can translate complex coverage and litigation issues into clear business guidance, maintaining calm and credibility with executives during live incidents and negotiations.
  • Hands-on leader and mentor able to review and elevate team output, establish standards, and help build playbooks, templates, and scalable claims processes.
  • Analytical and process-minded, leveraging data, metrics, and technology to manage performance, improve consistency, and drive efficiency.
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial, thriving in a fast-moving startup setting with strong judgment, humility, and a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected pay range for this position at the start of employment is $150,000 – $190,000/year. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as market location, job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for additional variable compensation, including quota-based incentives where applicable. WithCoverage offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package for full-time employees, which includes equity grants and a robust suite of benefits.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, technically proficient GTM Engineer to own the data, AI workflows, systems and operating processes that move demand from targeting and lead creation through qualified early-stage pipeline. This is a hands-on builder role at the intersection of GTM Operations, analytics and GTM Engineering. The successful candidate will establish trusted reporting infrastructure, turn funnel data into decisions, and build governed AI-enabled workflows that materially improve lead quality, conversion, speed and SDR productivity.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities):

    Analytics, Data and Decision Infrastructure:

    • Own the analytical foundation for the lead-to-opportunity funnel, including the data model, metric definitions, source-of-truth logic, transformations and dashboard architecture.
    • Build reliable reporting for volume, conversion, velocity, acceptance, aging, leakage, pipeline value and target-account penetration across source, campaign, segment, persona, account tier, channel and owner.
    • Evaluate lead-scoring efficacy, routing performance, outreach productivity and handoff quality using cohort, trend and root-cause analysis; translate findings into prioritized actions.
    • Create data-quality monitoring, reconciliation and reporting QA so leaders can trust funnel insights and understand metric lineage.
    • Develop recurring early-pipeline outlooks and decision-ready performance narratives that clearly identify risks, opportunities and recommended interventions.

      • AI, Automation and GTM Engineering:

      • Design, build and operate production-ready AI workflows for account and contact research, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, qualification, routing QA, SDR preparation, next-best action and performance diagnosis.
      • Connect AI capabilities to GTM systems and structured data using low-code tools, integrations, APIs and agent-based platforms; design for repeatability rather than one-off experimentation.
      • Define prompts, structured outputs, evaluation criteria, exception handling, human-in-the-loop controls and monitoring for accuracy, adoption and business impact.
      • Apply appropriate governance for data security, permissions, transparency and responsible use while continuously testing and improving workflow performance.
      • Identify high-value automation opportunities, quantify expected benefit and measure realized gains in conversion, speed, quality and team capacity.

        • Lead Lifecycle, Scoring and Routing:

        • Own the operational design for lead capture, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, grading, prioritization, routing, acceptance, recycling and disqualification.
        • Translate GTM policy into scalable Salesforce fields, validation rules, ownership logic, queues, automations and service-level agreements.
        • Continuously improve scoring and routing using observed conversion outcomes, fit and intent signals, rep capacity and territory rules.
        • Define qualification and handoff standards across Marketing, SDRs and Account Executives, with clear ownership, required context and closed-loop feedback.

          • Targeting and SDR Operating Systems:

          • Operationalize ICP, segmentation, territory and target-account strategies into measurable account and contact universes, coverage plans and activation workflows.
          • Administer and optimize Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha, Clay, Nooks, Qualified and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, including integrations, cadences, task logic, data flows and operating standards.
          • Partner with SDR leadership to define capacity, activity, quality and pipeline goals and provide analytical coaching insights by rep, channel, cadence, segment and persona.
          • Ensure automated, inbound and outbound interactions enter the funnel with accurate ownership, context, qualification and attribution.

            • Cross-Functional Leadership and Governance:

            • Serve as the operational and analytical partner to Marketing, Sales Development, Sales and GTM Systems for lead-to-pipeline performance.
            • Lead requirements gathering, process design, solution configuration, testing, release management, documentation, enablement and adoption measurement.
            • Drive alignment on lifecycle definitions, service levels, data standards and prioritization, balancing near-term commercial needs with scalable architecture.

What You'll Need (Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

    • 4+ years of experience in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, GTM Engineering, Revenue Systems or an equivalent technical GTM role in a B2B technology or SaaS environment.
    • Advanced analytical ability, including experience designing data models, metric definitions, dashboard architecture and scalable reporting infrastructure for operational and executive decision-making.
    • Strong Salesforce proficiency across data modelling, process design, automation, reports, dashboards, permissions and data-quality governance.
    • Demonstrated success building and operationalising AI-enabled workflows using low-code tools, integrations, APIs or agent-based platforms.
    • Working knowledge of AI workflow design, including prompt design, structured outputs, testing and evaluation, monitoring, exception handling and human oversight.
    • Hands-on experience administering or optimising a sales engagement platform such as Salesloft or Outreach.
    • Experience designing lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, qualification, SDR and early-stage pipeline processes.
    • Ability to combine quantitative analysis with commercial judgement, communicate clear recommendations and influence cross-functional leaders.
    • Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, solution design, testing, documentation and change-management skills.

What Would Be Nice (Preferred Experience):

    • Experience with Lusha, Clay, Nooks, Qualified and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
    • Experience with SQL, BI tools, data transformation, reverse ETL or warehouse-based reporting.
    • Experience building GTM applications, internal tools or agents in a GTM Engineer capacity.
    • Experience supporting enterprise account-based or target-account motions, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity or financial services technology.

jobs.title: VP, People Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

The Role

Pindrop is looking for an exceptional VP of People Operations who knows what great looks like because they've helped build it. We are seeking a proven People leader who has successfully built, scaled, and transformed People functions and is excited by the opportunity to do it again, better.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, you will serve as a trusted strategic partner and play a critical role in shaping the future of our People organization. We are looking for someone who brings the experience and judgment to lead today, along with the ambition and curiosity to continue growing toward broader enterprise leadership and, potentially, a future Chief People Officer role.

This is a role for someone who sees what needs to be done before being asked. You can identify opportunities across the business, develop a thoughtful strategy, build a comprehensive execution plan, align stakeholders, and lead initiatives from concept through implementation and measurable results. You bring structure to ambiguity, take ownership of outcomes, and set a high standard for execution excellence.

Just as importantly, you genuinely care about people and understand that building a strong culture and delivering business results go hand in hand. You balance empathy with accountability, are comfortable making difficult decisions, and believe that developing others is one of your most important responsibilities as a leader.

You will lead through coaching, empowerment, and clear expectations rather than micromanagement. You will operate comfortably at every altitude, influencing executive decisions while building the capabilities, systems, and team needed to execute exceptionally well.

This is an opportunity for an ambitious, accomplished People executive who wants to make a meaningful impact, build an exceptional organization, and continue growing toward the next chapter of their leadership career.

What You'll Do

1. People Strategy & Executive Partnership

  • Partner closely with the CPO to translate business priorities into actionable People strategies that strengthen organizational effectiveness, talent capabilities, and business performance.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive and functional leaders, bringing informed perspectives, sound judgment, and data-driven recommendations on workforce planning, talent, organizational effectiveness, and people-related business challenges.

  • Lead the Quarterly ELT Talent and Organizational Business Review, partnering with Talent Acquisition and HRBP leadership to deliver meaningful insights, identify organizational risks, and recommend actions.
  • Proactively identify emerging talent and organizational challenges, bringing forward clear recommendations, business implications, risks, and proposed solutions rather than simply reporting on activity.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence decisions across the organization, balancing employee needs, business priorities, and long-term organizational health.

2. Strategic Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Own the People Operations strategy and operating model, establishing scalable systems, processes, governance, and operating rhythms that enable the function to deliver consistently and effectively.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness, operational efficiency, and employee experience, translating insights into actionable initiatives.
  • Lead complex strategic initiatives from concept through execution, including business case development, comprehensive project planning, stakeholder alignment, implementation, change management, and measurement of results.
  • Lead continuous improvement and AI transformation across the organization, bringing demonstrated AI fluency and a passion for championing its adoption. Drive AI education, training, and upskilling initiatives across the organization while leveraging AI, automation, and data to modernize processes, improve efficiency, and increase business impact.
  • Build a disciplined operating cadence with clear priorities, accountability, executive checkpoints, and measurable outcomes, moving the People organization from reactive execution to proactive, strategic delivery.
  • Lead continuous improvement across People Operations, challenging existing processes and leveraging AI, automation, data, and technology to simplify work, improve quality, and increase organizational impact.

  • Establish performance measures and accountability across People Operations, ensuring initiatives deliver meaningful outcomes, sustainable adoption, and continuous improvement.

3. People Operations, Talent & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Provide strategic leadership and accountability for HR Operations, HR Business Partners, employee lifecycle programs, People systems, data governance, and operational compliance, empowering functional leaders and team members to own day-to-day execution.

  • Build and scale a strategic HRBP operating model that positions HR Business Partners as proactive advisors to business leaders, connecting talent strategy to organizational priorities and business outcomes.
  • Lead through the team to deliver effective performance management, talent calibration, succession planning, leadership development, and employee experience programs.
  • Partner with the CPO and Finance on compensation strategy, workforce planning, and organizational design, bringing forward insights, recommendations, and implementation plans that support business priorities.
  • Ensure the People organization delivers accurate, actionable workforce data and analytics, using insights to identify trends, anticipate risks, and inform decisions.
  • Partner with leaders to identify and address systemic barriers to organizational effectiveness, including leadership capability, accountability, communication, and employee engagement.

  • Provide senior-level guidance on complex employee relations matters and organizational changes, ensuring decisions reflect sound judgment, consistency, legal considerations, and Pindrop's values.

4. People Leadership, Culture & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing People team, establishing a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and exceptional service to the business.

  • Make the development of direct reports a leadership priority, investing in coaching, meaningful feedback, stretch opportunities, and intentional career development.
  • Lead through empowerment rather than micromanagement, providing clear expectations, decision-making authority, and accountability while giving team members the autonomy and support to succeed.
  • Build leadership capability and succession strength within the People organization, developing individuals who can operate independently, think strategically, and take on increasingly complex responsibilities.
  • Set a high bar for quality, execution, and accountability, ensuring the team understands both what needs to be accomplished and the business impact of their work.
  • Create an environment where individuals are encouraged to challenge ideas, bring forward recommendations, learn from mistakes, and take ownership of outcomes.
  • Model a people-centered, business-minded leadership approach, demonstrating empathy, integrity, resilience, sound judgment, and the courage to make difficult decisions when necessary.

Who You Are

  • A proven builder and operator. You have successfully built, scaled, and transformed People functions. You know what great looks like because you've personally delivered it.
  • A strategic thinker and exceptional executor. You connect the dots across the organization, anticipate what's needed, and translate complex opportunities into thoughtful plans and measurable results.
  • An independent, proactive leader. You bring recommendations, not just problems. You exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and know when to act, collaborate, or escalate.
  • A developer of people. You genuinely enjoy coaching and growing others, building strong teams through trust, empowerment, accountability, and meaningful development.
  • A people-first, business-minded executive. You care deeply about employees and culture while understanding the realities of running a business. You balance empathy with accountability and make difficult decisions with fairness and conviction.
  • A credible executive partner. You are comfortable engaging with senior leaders, bringing a strong point of view, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decisions with confidence and maturity.
  • An ambitious, continuous learner. You are motivated to keep growing as an executive, expand your capabilities, embrace new technologies, and develop toward broader enterprise leadership.
  • A collaborative, low-ego leader. You welcome feedback, value different perspectives, build strong relationships, and take accountability for your decisions and results.
  • A resilient change leader. You thrive in dynamic environments, bring clarity to ambiguity, and have the persistence to move complex initiatives forward.

Your Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive People/HR experience, including senior leadership across multiple HR disciplines. Prior VP-level experience or equivalent scope strongly preferred, with a demonstrated history of career stability and multiple examples of 3+ years of sustained tenure over the past decade.
  • Proven success building, scaling, and transforming People teams, operating models, and programs in high-growth technology or similarly dynamic environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency and hands-on experience applying AI to improve business outcomes, with a proven ability to champion adoption, build organizational capabilities, and lead AI training and upskilling initiatives.
  • Proven ability to build high-performing teams, develop future leaders, and empower direct reports through coaching, delegation, and accountability.
  • Strong executive presence, business acumen, and organizational judgment, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, and translate People insights into actionable business strategies.
  • Experience leveraging People technology, workforce analytics, AI, and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and organizational effectiveness.

The Opportunity

This is more than an opportunity to lead People Operations. It's an opportunity to help shape how the People function operates, scales, and delivers value across Pindrop.

You will work directly with the Chief People Officer, gain meaningful exposure to enterprise-level talent and organizational decisions, and have the opportunity to influence how we build and develop our organization.

You will have the ability to challenge the status quo, introduce new ideas, build scalable solutions, and develop a high-performing team. We are looking for someone who wants to make a lasting impact, not simply maintain what exists.

For the right leader, this role offers the opportunity to continue expanding strategic influence, executive leadership capabilities, and readiness for future leadership responsibilities.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics & Genomics Data System Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Bioinformatics & Genomics Data System Engineer of our Data Science Production Engineering (DSPE) department, you will be a key member in the DSPE DevOps team, to design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and update DSPE's software tools, data platforms, cloud platforms, automation systems, and analytics systems.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Technical

  • Ensure the timely and efficient delivery of software tools and systems with correct and robust functionality.
  • Contribute to key design, development, testing, deployment, validation, maintenance, and update activities for DSPE's software tools and data/cloud/automation systems.
  • Working with DSPE leadership teams, create suitable system architecture and infrastructure design documents that can be efficiently implemented and maintained.
  • Maintain and optimize software/system performance, by monitoring and studying different solutions' impacts on key system metrics, such as network I/O, disk I/O, RAM usage, CPU usage, disk space usage, etc.

Quality, Compliance, and Documentation

  • Contribute to technical documentation's creation, maintenance, and updates for the DSPE Software Engineering & DevOps-team owned software tools and systems.
  • Create training materials, and contribute to training activities, for the DSPE Software Engineering & DevOps team-owned software tools and systems.

Cross-Functional

  • Train and coach DSPE team members on new technologies, procedures, and guidelines/best practices.
  • Represent the DSPE Software Engineering & DevOps team in stakeholder meetings.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimal Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related field. Advanced degrees preferred.
  • Minimal 6 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with only a Bachelor's Degree. Minimal 3 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with a Master's Degree. Minimal 2 years of relevant industry experience for candidates with a Doctorate degree.
  • Minimal 3 years of working experience in a highly regulated environment, e.g., CLIA and/or FDA compliant settings.
  • Minimal 3 years of working experience in a Software Engineering, or a DevOps team.
  • Demonstrable experience in developing and maintaining custom-developed software tools or systems for production environments, preferable in high-throughput settings (e.g., heavy traffic and/or high computational load).
  • Demonstrable experience in creating software design specification documents, verification and validation documents, and user manuals.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Excellent understanding of key bioinformatics and genomics concepts, and NGS technologies.
  • Excellent Python programming skills, with demonstrable bioinformatics or genomics application and/or automation system development experience.
  • Excellent understanding of AWS services relevant to bioinformatics and genomics applications.
  • Working experience with key AWS services, such as Batch, ECS, S3, EC2, HealthOmics, etc., preferably in developing for-production software tools/systems.
  • Proficient with RDBMS systems such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, and demonstrable working experience in for-production database-based application development.
  • Working experience with bioinformatics and genomics-specific file types, such as BCL, FASTQ, BAM, VCF files.
  • Working knowledge in optimizing system architecture and individual components for performance, scalability, and/or reliability, especially for genomics-scale data.
  • Working knowledge in tool/system performance evaluation methods, and familiar with the key factors, such as RAM, Disk IO, Network IO's impact on system/tool's performance, especially for bioinformatics and genomics applications.
  • Working knowledge in SDLC and software development and testing methodologies.
  • Working knowledge in Linux command line skills, and past Linux application development experience.
  • Proficiency in Git workflow and version control systems like GitHub and/or GitLab.
  • Past experience in developing automation solutions.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$113,600—$142,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly.   • Ability to collaborate within a fast-paced, team-driven environment that demands flexibility, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a changing workflow
  • Highly flexible and team-oriented, with the ability to adapt to changing needs and priorities
  • Compassionate, patient-focused approach with a commitment to quality care
  • Ability to work independently and adapt to evolving technologies and processes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working remotely

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection required
  • Must maintain a distraction-free, professional background for video calls
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8am–5pm Central

Featured Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k with employer match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Employee Perks & Discounts

jobs.title: Lead Biostatistician (Oncology Clinical Studies)
jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a highly experienced, independent clinical biostatistician to advance adoption of Natera’s oncology portfolio of cutting-edge molecular diagnostic tests. As a Lead Biostatistician, you will independently lead the design, analysis, and reporting for multiple practice-changing oncology clinical trials. You will propose efficient, fit-for-purpose study designs with broad impact across the oncology portfolio.

The ideal candidate brings deep statistical expertise, strong scientific communication skills, and a proven track record of applying innovative methodologies to oncology clinical trial design in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Study Design and Statistical Strategy: Lead the statistical design and analytical planning for oncology clinical utility studies. Provide technical expertise in complex study design methodologies and data analyses. Propose and justify efficient study designs tailored to complex oncology use cases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as study statistician for multiple studies. Collaborate with clinical, medical, and translational partners to influence study planning, development, and execution. Identify risks, proactively communicate concerns, and champion solutions to interdisciplinary teams and executive leaders.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Author and review high-quality statistical deliverables, including statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and reports (TLFs, CSRs, publications) for cross-functional collaborators and stakeholders.
  • Innovation and Improvement: Recommend and apply novel statistical approaches where appropriate. Mentor early career statisticians and support continuous improvement of departmental processes, tools, and templates to enhance team efficiency and analytical rigor. Collaborate on manuscripts for publications.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (Ph.D. preferred).
  • 4+ years of experience in clinical trial biostatistics.
  • Strong expertise in time-to-event analysis, including handling of censoring, competing risks, and advanced survival modeling approaches commonly used in oncology.
  • Expertise with innovative study design (e.g. adaptive and biomarker-informed designs), power calculations, and endpoint evaluation.
  • Working knowledge of ICH and GCP guidelines as well as CDISC standards (e.g. SDTM, ADaM).
  • Proficient in R.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Expert-level ability to independently design clinical studies, grounded in deep domain knowledge and a nuanced understanding of complex, oncology-specific challenges.
  • Experience with biomarker enabled clinical study designs, sample size determination, and endpoint evaluation.
  • Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm for working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments with collaborators from diverse technical backgrounds.
  • Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred qualifications:
    • Working-knowledge of NGS-based diagnostics and ctDNA/MRD.
    • Experience with non-inferiority studies.

jobs.title: Agile Delivery Manager (contract outside of IR35)
jobs.description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:

  • 3-month (rolling) contract outside of IR35
  • £500 to £700 per day
  • Fully remote

About the role

TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.

Responsibilities

Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

  • Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.
  • Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.
  • Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.

Agile Delivery Management

  • Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.
  • Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.
  • Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.
  • Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.

Lightweight Governance & Reporting

  • Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.
  • Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.
  • Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.
  • Help define and mature TwinStream’s delivery governance model — ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.
  • Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.
  • Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.
  • Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.
  • Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience — technical or non-technical.
  • Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.
  • Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.

Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

  • Contribute to improving TwinStream’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.
  • Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.
  • Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.

Key Skills

  • Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams, not just single-project coordination.
  • Strong understanding of flow-based agile delivery and programme-level planning.
  • Proven ability to identify cross-cutting risks, large dependencies, and structural blockers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at all levels of the organisation.
  • Confidence operating in environments that value structure but avoid heavy process.
  • A pragmatic, solution-focused mindset and the ability to bring clarity in uncertainty

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’re here to support you

Further Information:

Due to the nature of the work and the sectors we support, any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of the relevant security screening and clearance process.

This role requires eligibility for [BPSS / SC / DV] clearance. As part of the vetting process, candidates must meet the UK Government's residency and right-to-work requirements associated with the required level of clearance.

We’re looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help make SpecterOps easier to recognize and understand, wherever people encounter us. This is a chance to shape the brand as the company scales and our work expands across identity and AI security.

You’ll work closely with our creative and marketing team, partnering with colleagues across Product, research, and web. You’ll bring ideas to the table, strengthen concepts together, and carry work from early exploration through polished, production-ready design.

Your work will show up across the SpecterOps experience: on our website and landing pages; in campaigns and advertising; in product launches and research stories; across presentations and pitch decks, reports, one-pagers, and other documents; on social and email; and at events through graphics, signage, and attendee materials. A big part of the job is making complex cybersecurity ideas clear and memorable. You’ll also help build the templates and shared patterns that keep the brand consistent without making every project look the same.

Salary Range: base salary annually, commensurate with experience.

  • $95,000 - $120,000

Location: This position is remote, based in the U.S. with frequent travel for events they are leading, conferences, quarterly for in-person company events and other ad hoc meetings.

  • Preferred candidate location: West United States
  • Candidate must be authorized to work and reside in the United States; we do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

Responsibilities

  • Take creative direction and make it stronger, developing visual options and carrying the selected idea through final design.
  • Create work across brand and marketing touchpoints, including websites and landing pages, campaign and advertising creative, product marketing, research and thought leadership, presentations and pitch decks, reports and other documents, social, email, sales collateral, and event graphics and signage.
  • Work with Marketing, Product, research partners, and subject matter experts to make complex cybersecurity topics easier to follow.
  • Develop and refine shared templates, patterns, and guidance that help the team create consistent work without making it feel generic.
  • Present your work, explain your choices, respond to feedback, and prepare polished, production-ready files.
  • Manage your projects and timelines, keeping teammates informed and raising risks early.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand design, visual design or related discipline, with experience owning brand projects from initial concept through final delivery
  • A portfolio showing strong brand design, concept development, and craft across more than one kind of work. Be ready to explain your role in the projects you share.
  • Experience taking design from an early idea through finished work, with the judgment to make the idea stronger along the way.
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, layout, hierarchy, composition, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience creating or improving brand systems, templates, or guidelines, and knowing when to follow them or when the work calls for something new.
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills, including comfort presenting work and responding to feedback.
  • Desire to embody our core values of passion curiosity, consistent improvement, empathy, sustainability, humility and empowerment through transparency
  • Authorization to work and reside in the United States without sponsorship

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for B2B technology, cybersecurity, or other technical audiences.
  • Experience with motion, web prototyping,event and environmental design.
  • Experience helping teammates use design templates or guidance effectively.

  • Health/Dental/Vision/life insurance: 100% covered for both the employee and their family

jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer & AI Specialist

About the Role

As Analytics Engineers you would combine insurance domain expertise with full-stack data and analytics engineering capabilities. You will help build the data foundations that power Snowflake's AI platform.

This role is focused on the layers that make AI reliable: clean, well-modeled data, governed pipelines, and semantic models that expose business meaning to natural language interfaces. You will design rigorous data models, build data pipelines, and construct the semantic layer that sits between raw data and AI agents. You will be responsible for setting up data that is structured, trusted, and agent-ready. The deployment patterns and data model gaps you surface feed directly back to LOB teams, making you both a practitioner and a source of signal for what gets built next.

What You'll Work On

Data Modeling and Architecture

  • Architect flexible, performant data models that drive LOB team toward single sources of truth across their LOB business domains
  • Use SQL, Python, dbt, and Snowflake to build and maintain data infrastructure for reporting, analysis, and automation
  • Perform data QA and develop automated testing procedures for Snowflake data models
  • Provide input into data governance strategies including permissions, data lineage, and data definitions
  • Design Data security so that the model only has access to the data

Semantic Layer and Agent Readiness

  • Build semantic data models that expose LOBs data to natural language queries via Cortex Analyst, turning complex schemas into something a business stakeholder and Clients can ask a question of
  • Define and validate the metrics, dimensions, and relationships that AI agents need to reason correctly over LOBs data
  • IMP
  • Identify and resolve gaps in data structure, naming, and coverage that would cause an agent to fail or produce incorrect results

Documentation

  • Documented playbooks, reusable data model templates, and semantic model libraries that can be maintained and extend
  • Run technical workshops to upskill other team members
  • Author semantic view configurations and skill files (YAML + Markdown) that a non-technical analyst can invoke in plain English

Hard Skills Required Must-Have

  • Advanced SQL: CTEs, window functions, incremental pipeline patterns. You can write complex queries without referencing documentation.
  • Analytics engineering and data modeling: Experience building data infrastructure involving large-scale relational datasets; strong instincts for pipeline design, QA, and testing across the full stack from ingestion through semantic layer.
  • dbt: Experience building and maintaining dbt projects with testing, documentation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Python: Modern, type-hinted, readable. You understand Python-based data pipelines and automation workflows.
  • AI-assisted development: You have used an LLM coding assistant (CoCo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development environment. Daily usage is the baseline.
  • Semantic modeling: You can write a semantic view configuration or structured skill file that handles edge cases and encodes enough domain knowledge that the model behaves like a subject matter expert.
  • Client-facing communication: You write code, but your output needs to make sense to a business leader who has never opened a terminal. You are the translation layer between what Snowflake's AI can do and what the customer actually needs.
  • Snowflake Cortex: Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, semantic views, Dynamic Tables.

Strong Plus

  • Experience with Airflow or other orchestration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with enterprise business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS, or similar).

Soft Skills Required

  • Owns the outcome: Tracks adoption after go-live, identifies stall points, and re-engages until the data product is reliable and can be handed over to run teams.
  • Codifies, doesn't customize: Instinct is to turn patterns into reusable templates and playbooks that the next engineer can deploy at the next customer, not to build bespoke every time.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: Engages with customers to derive requirements, prototypes fast, gathers feedback, and iterates.
  • Signal clarity: Distills messy deployments into clean, actionable feedback for Leaders, explaining root causes and suggesting fixes, not just reporting problems.

Minimum Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role, with at least a portion of it customer-facing or cross-functional
  • Daily use of an AI coding assistant as a primary development tool
  • Proficient in SQL; can write window functions and complex joins without referencing documentation
  • Experience with dbt
  • Has shipped production data model or pipeline that non-technical business users actually relied on
  • Comfortable in Git (PRs, branches, code review)
  • Demonstrable experience translating business requirements into technical specifications

Why This Role Is Different

Most analytics engineering roles stop at the data model. Most field roles stop at the recommendation. This role starts where both leave off. You own the full data stack from source ingestion to semantic layer, and you ensure every layer is clean, tested, and structured for AI agents to reason over reliably. You write the code. You build the semantic foundation. You make sure it runs in production and the run team can maintain it.

Why Join Nimble Gravity?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Brand Performance Marketer
jobs.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Marketing & AI Innovation

What You Will Be Doing

Brand without performance accountability is positioning. Performance without brand coherence is noise. This role exists at that intersection. You will design and orchestrate omnichannel campaigns across web, email, and social that build brand presence and move measurable business metrics, using agencies and freelancers as execution arms while you own the strategy, the brief, and the outcome. You will also serve as the brand intelligence layer for paid media, feeding creative direction and audience signal to the teams running paid so that owned and paid tell the same story and reinforce each other.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Design omnichannel campaigns with a defined performance thesis: what the campaign is supposed to move, how each channel contributes to that movement, and how the audience journey connects web, email, and social into a single arc rather than parallel activations.
  • Own AEO and SEO strategy as a performance lever, not a hygiene function. Define how the brand wins organic discovery, brief agencies to execute against that architecture, and hold them accountable to rankings, traffic quality, and content performance.
  • Conceive social media campaigns with measurable intent, then direct creative agencies to execute with fidelity to the original strategy. Organic social is the proof of brand voice; you own what it says and what it is trying to do.
  • Own always-on email as the highest-accountability channel in the mix: lifecycle architecture, segmentation logic, automation sequences, deliverability, and performance. This is where brand investment converts to relationship, and you treat it accordingly.
  • Brief web agencies on messaging hierarchy, page intent, and conversion narrative. The brief is your product; the agency executes it.
  • Quantify brand performance: share of voice, earned mentions, amplification rates, sentiment movement, and how those signals correlate with downstream pipeline or revenue metrics. Present brand health as a business argument, not a marketing report.
  • Supply paid media teams with creative strategy, audience insights, and messaging frameworks drawn from owned channel performance, so that paid amplification reflects what is actually working, not what looks good in a deck.

Requirements

  • 3 to 6 years in brand, content, or digital marketing with a clear throughline of performance accountability: roles where you were measured on outcomes, not output.
  • Proven ability to architect campaigns that operate across owned channels simultaneously, with the discipline to define how each channel's job is distinct and how they compound.
  • Strong AEO and SEO strategic fluency, including an understanding of how large language models and answer engines are reshaping organic brand discovery.
  • Agency management experience with evidence that your briefs produced sharp, on-strategy work, not just adequate work.
  • Deep operational ownership of email as a performance channel: you have built lifecycle programs, optimized sequences, and reported on email's contribution to business outcomes.
  • Ability to connect brand metrics to business metrics. You can explain why share of voice moved, what drove it, and what it is worth.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor's in Communication, Journalism, or related Marketing degrees

You Are Not the Right Fit If

  • You think brand and performance are different teams' problems.
  • You measure success by what you produced rather than what it moved.
  • You let agency interpretation substitute for strategic clarity in your briefs.

Location

US - Remote

About aiEDU

The AI Education Project (aiEDU) is a growing 501(c)(3) non-profit that creates equitable educational experiences to excite and empower learners everywhere with AI literacy. About the Role

We are looking for an experienced engineer to build the technical foundation for aiEDU's external-facing products.

Our programming is generally live and cohort-based, but we've begun prototyping web-based products to support the tens of thousands of educators and partners in our programs each year. Our goal is to build quickly using current AI-assisted development tools and processes, without compromising quality or security.

Working with our product managers, Senior Lead of Data and Impact, and VP of Operations, you'll define the quality standards our products must meet, develop our shared technical infrastructure, own the security and integrity of our systems and data, and serve as first responder when problems arise.

You'll also make the rest of the team more technically capable — advising on engineering and security best practices, setting practical guardrails that let colleagues keep experimenting responsibly, and strengthening the technical judgment of the people around you.

⭐ Role Details

  • Location: This part-time, non-exempt position can be done on a flexible schedule remotely from anywhere in the U.S. with access to high speed internet.
  • Compensation: This is a part-time role at $150 per hour, up to 25 hours per week.
  • Benefits: This position is part-time and not eligible for benefits.
  • Start date: We’d like a candidate to start as soon as possible after receiving an offer, though there is some flexibility.

✅ Your Responsibilities (percentages fluctuate during the year and over time):

Product quality & process

  • Working alongside our PMs, ensure all external-facing products meet quality standards for reliability, accessibility, error handling, performance and security.
  • Define the bar that new features/ products must clear before they go live, and review changes to production systems and externally facing products before release.
  • Build shared resources — e.g., templates, authentication patterns, environment setup — that PMs or other team members can reuse for new product or feature development. Set up the basic infrastructure for new launches, including monitoring, alerts and backups.
  • Advise our team on when something shouldn't ship or should be retired. Keep track of what we’ve launched and shut down what is no longer used.

Security & Data Management

  • Audit aiEDU’s externally facing products for security vulnerabilities; scope and implement remediations.
  • Harden backend configurations across our Supabase and Vercel environments, and own credential and secrets hygiene.
  • Establish and maintain our GitHub organization’s security posture.
  • Serve as first responder for security incidents, including triage, remediation and documentation.
  • With our Sr. Lead, Data & Impact, know and document where our data lives and design and enforce controls across our data systems, including audit logging and appropriate backup, retention and deletion practices.
  • Support our VP of Operations to evolve our compliance and data safeguards, and ensure appropriate documentation to meet partner requirements.

Technical mentorship

  • Establish lightweight, realistic guardrails for AI-assisted development that allow non-technical team members to build and experiment with AI tools without putting the organization at risk.

About the company:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

About the role

We are hiring a Sr. Director of Talent Acquisition to lead a small, high-performing global team that hires at high volume and high speed. You will set the strategy, own the metrics, and still roll up your sleeves when a critical search needs it. You will partner with business leaders across the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, and use AI to make recruiting faster, fairer, and measurably better.

What you'll do

  • Own the global TA strategy and operating plan, balancing speed, quality, and cost across a large volume of open requisitions.
  • Lead and develop a lean team of recruiters and sourcers across North America and India; set clear expectations, coach to performance, and make hard calls on capacity and prioritization.
  • Define and run a KPI framework (for example time to fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, quality of hire, hiring manager satisfaction, recruiter productivity). Review it on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.
  • Build and apply AI across the recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, outreach, reporting, and recruiter performance insights. Measure the efficiency and quality gains, and retire what does not work.
  • Run recruiting in the US, Canada, Mexico, and India, adapting to local market practices, compensation norms, employment regulations, and talent availability. Partner with Legal and People on compliance.
  • Manage and optimize agency and vendor relationships: when to use them, how to hold them accountable, and how to reduce reliance over time.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executives, hiring managers, and People leadership. Run intake and workforce planning conversations, push back with data, and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Move between strategy and execution: build the plan in the morning, close the candidate in the afternoon.
  • Partner with Finance, People Ops, and Talent Brand on headcount planning, forecasting, employer brand, DEI goals, and candidate experience.
  • Build the TA leadership bench: hire, develop, and promote recruiting managers, senior recruiters, and sourcers; define career paths and succession plans.
  • Run the team's operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, and regular reporting to the executive team.
  • Own the TA budget, including headcount, agency and vendor spend, tools, and job board and event costs. Forecast capacity against the hiring plan and make the case for investment.
  • Lead TA technology strategy: ATS configuration, sourcing and scheduling tools, analytics, and vendor selection and renewals.
  • Build scalable, consistent hiring practices, including structured interviewing, intake standards, interviewer training, offer approval, and candidate experience.
  • Lead through change: reorganizations, hiring surges and freezes, reprioritization, and integration of acquired teams.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years leading TA teams, ideally including a Director-level or higher role.
  • Experience in fast-paced, high-growth, or dynamic environments with high requisition volume and a small team.
  • Direct experience recruiting in North America (US, Canada, Mexico) and India, and an understanding of how each market differs.
  • A clear point of view on performance management and KPIs, with examples of setting goals, holding people accountable, and coaching up or out.
  • Experience in both agency and corporate recruiting.
  • Demonstrable examples of using AI to improve recruiting efficiency and performance management, with outcomes you can quantify.
  • Strong relationship management and stakeholder skills, including with senior leaders.
  • Fluency with an ATS and recruiting analytics.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with shifting priorities as the business changes.
  • A track record of building and leading TA teams through growth and change, including hiring, developing, and retaining recruiting managers and individual contributors.
  • Experience managing leaders and managers, plus a distributed team across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience owning a TA budget and a hiring plan, including capacity modeling and agency and vendor spend.
  • Experience building or rebuilding a recruiting operating model: team structure, process, tooling, and reporting.
  • Experience presenting TA strategy and results to executive and board-level audiences, and partnering with Finance on workforce planning.
  • Experience leading a team through a reorganization, hiring surge, or slowdown, and keeping morale and performance up.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or technology.
  • Experience scaling TA through growth, restructuring, or M&A.
  • Experience hiring across engineering, sales, and go-to-market roles.
  • Working knowledge of employment practices in Mexico and India.

  • Outstanding communication (both verbal and written) and relationship management skills
