jobs.title: Director of US Government Engagement
jobs.description:
About the team

At Q-CTRL, the Government Engagement team works at the intersection of policy, international engagement, and national security to influence how governments govern and fund the development and adoption of quantum technologies. As trusted and respected leaders in the sector, we build enduring relationships with politicians, policymakers, and defense forces around the world to secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to deliver cutting-edge sovereign capability. We empower all areas of the business to understand and navigate government decision-making.

About the role
Reporting to the Global Head of Government Engagement, you’ll lead Q-CTRL’s US government engagement activities, working closely with our business development, technical, product, and marketing teams. You’ll shape policy and funding initiatives, build trusted relationships, and secure opportunities for Q-CTRL to partner commercially and strategically with government to deliver quantum computing and quantum sensing capabilities that advance US defense and economic interests.

What you'll be doing:

  • Develop and execute Q-CTRL’s US government engagement strategy, setting clear priorities for policy, legislative, and funding outcomes that support our growth and the adoption of quantum technologies.
  • Build and maintain trusted, bipartisan relationships with congressional offices and committees, the Department of War, federal agencies and state governments.
  • Serve as a trusted representative of company interests in political and policy forums, including engagements supporting business development with the USG.
  • Shape policy, legislation, and funding decisions through targeted advocacy, including developing proposals for authorization and appropriations processes and building support among key decision-makers.
  • Work closely with business development and technical colleagues to identify, assess, and secure government funding and partnership opportunities, connecting Q-CTRL’s capabilities with government priorities and mission needs.
  • Monitor and anticipate policy, legislative, budget, and regulatory developments, translating them into timely advice and recommended actions for company leadership.
  • Represent Q-CTRL in industry associations, think tanks, and policy forums, building coalitions that advance shared priorities and establish Q-CTRL as a trusted voice on quantum technology.
  • Other duties within the Employee's skills and experience, or with reasonable training.

Ideally you'll have:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in government, congressional affairs, public policy, or government relations, for example as a congressional staffer, government official, military officer, or lobbyist.
  • A demonstrated track record of shaping government decisions, with tangible achievements in policy development, legislation, or public funding.
  • A strong understanding of US federal policymaking and the legislative, authorization, appropriations, and agency budget processes, including when and how to engage effectively.
  • An established network across Capitol Hill, the executive branch, key federal departments, and the ability to build trusted relationships across political affiliations and institutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, persuasive arguments tailored to government audiences.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work across business functions to raise Q-CTRL’s profile and secure commercial opportunities.

It would be fantastic if you have these skills/experience but not essential:

  • Experience working with the Department of War and congressional defense committees, including familiarity with defense budgets, acquisition pathways, and the transition of emerging technologies into operational use.
  • Experience working in a technology startup or scaleup, particularly in a role connecting government engagement with commercial growth.
  • Experience in the advanced technology, defense, or aerospace sectors.
  • Experience shaping policy or funding for quantum or other critical technologies, such as AI, semiconductors, space, or advanced sensing.
  • Experience with state government engagement, economic development initiatives, and allied technology cooperation through frameworks such as AUKUS.

Compensation

Additional Information

We take a multidisciplinary approach to quantum computing research, bringing together experts from diverse fields. We particularly value versatile and self-motivated problem solvers. If you are passionate about making quantum computers useful, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all of the requirements listed above.

Salary

The targeted base salary range for this position is between $210,000 - $260,000 and will ultimately be determined by specific job-related skills, experience, level, location and other contributing factors. This role will be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and the opportunity to equity and other forms of compensation outside of the targeted base salary range.

This position is eligible for Q-CTRL's U.S. health insurance benefits, subject to plan eligibility requirements, as well as HSA, FSA, PTO, Company paid parental leave, 401k with an employer match, and a Learning, Development and Wellness allowance. For more information on benefits at Q-CTRL, please visit our careers page at https://q-ctrl.com/careers.

Should you have any questions related to the compensation package, please speak directly with the Talent Acquisition representative.

About Q-CTRL
Q-CTRL is the global leader in AI-powered quantum control infrastructure software. We build the tools that make quantum technology useful, solving the hardest challenges in quantum computing and quantum sensing to deliver real-world impact. We’ve shown that the same enabling software which we’ve used to deliver GPS-free quantum navigation on real aircraft and drones is also able to stabilize quantum computers against errors and deliver true quantum advantage. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

The opportunity

Help Scout is building a sales-led outbound motion to win more mid-market customers. Most of our pipeline comes from inbound today & we are changing that mix. This role is the engine for it.

We're hiring our first Business Development Representative to join our sales team. In this role, you’ll open conversations with the companies that fit us best and drive pipeline for our Account Executives. You'll also help shape the outbound playbook: which accounts, which messages, and which channels work. As our first BDR, we’re not looking for someone to run an established playbook… we're looking for someone who is eager to help shape one.

Does that sound like you? If so, here’s more about the role:

What you’ll do

  • Research and personalize. Use an AI tech stack to find the right prospects, from Support/Success leaders to Operations management and company executives. You'll maximize engagement by tailoring outreach using our messaging frameworks and templates, and will check AI-generated drafts before sending.

  • Work defined target account lists. Prospect into a defined list of ideal-fit mid-market companies based on our ICP criteria & strategic campaigns, and flag accounts that are not the right fit.

  • Execute multi-channel outreach. Manage outreach across several channels, including email, phone, LinkedIn, and video.

  • Test and iterate. Run messaging, personas, and channels tests, track what converts at the highest rates, and recommend changes to drive continuous improvement.

  • Report on results. Maintain updated reports and dashboards that illustrate your success rates across campaigns and performance towards your targets. Regularly review results and thoughtful recommendations for improvement with your manager.

  • Hand off cleanly. Partner closely with Account Executives to brief them on sourced meetings with well documented details about the contacts, accounts and messaging that led to the booking. Use AE feedback to regularly improve your hand-offs.

About you

  • You’re relentless and resourceful. When a prospect doesn’t answer, you find another way in: a different channel, a different person, a different angle.

  • You take initiative. You’ve built or tested something in your outbound process without being asked, and you can tell us what happened.

  • You have 1 to 2+ years as an outbound BDR or SDR at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of meeting pipeline or opportunity targets.

  • You've prospected into companies with 250+ employees and know how to tailor messaging based on industry, job title and additional criteria.

  • You’re a great communicator, both with prospects and internal colleagues.

  • You actively use AI tools in your workflow for research, list building, or writing, and can recommend what works (experience with HubSpot & GTM platforms like Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator or similar solutions a plus).

  • You can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • You're coachable and want to grow into a closing role.

Compensation and benefits

We use a competency-based approach to pay, and pay is the same no matter where in the U.S. you live.

Base salary: $71,000 - $77,000

On-target earnings (OTE): $102,000 - $111,000

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

jobs.title: Senior GPU Infrastructure Engineer, Deployment
jobs.description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.

The role

You will own how new GPU servers become ready for customers: from racks at a datacenter to tested, production-ready nodes. You will define when a node is ready, build the automation that gets it there, and keep the fleet healthy once it is running.

This is a hands-on senior role on a small team. You will work with datacenter partners and their on-site staff, and closely with the engineers who own routing and the network.

The work

We bring up large GPU servers at datacenters we don't own. Each node has to be provisioned, tested hard and proven healthy before customers use it. Between customers it has to be wiped clean. Once in service, failing hardware has to be caught early and taken out of rotation. The hard part is doing this the same way, every time, across many sites, with a small team.

What you bring

  • You have brought up multi-GPU servers or clusters for production workloads, including acceptance testing and burn-in.

  • Experience with high-speed GPU networking such as InfiniBand or RoCE.

  • You have automated bare-metal provisioning and kept firmware and images consistent across a fleet.

  • You can diagnose GPU and server hardware faults and decide when to repair or replace.

  • You have run GPUs inside virtual machines or otherwise isolated customers on shared hardware.

  • You have worked with remote datacenter staff and been on call for a fleet.

  • You write scripts and tools in a language such as Python, Go or Bash.

  • You use AI tools well and check their work.

You do not need ML model experience. What matters is that you have put real GPU hardware into service for other people's workloads and kept it running.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer, Edge
jobs.description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.

The role

You will own the network that customer traffic enters through and the links that connect our sites. You will design it, build it and run it in production.

This is a hands-on senior role on a small team. You will work closely with the engineer who owns request routing, and with the people bringing new GPU sites online.

The work

Customers reach us through a set of points of presence on the public internet. Behind them, our GPU sites stay private and connect out to us. You will run that edge: the addresses customers connect to, the protection that keeps attacks away from our servers, and the private links back to each site. The hard part is doing this with a small team, so it has to be automated, observable and calm under attack.

What you bring

  • You have designed and run production networks across multiple locations.

  • Strong fundamentals in BGP, DNS, TCP and TLS, and load balancing.

  • You have handled DDoS attacks or built the protection against them.

  • You manage network configuration as code, not by hand.

  • You have been on call for a network and led incident response.

  • You can write tools and automation in a language such as Go, Rust or Python.

  • You write clearly.

  • You use AI tools well and check their work.

You do not need GPU or ML experience. What matters is that you have run networks people depend on and want to build one from the start.

Description

We’re growing and looking to hire a Product Support Engineer - SaaS who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity.

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

As a Product Support Engineer at Claroty, you will play a critical role in supporting enterprise customers who rely on our platform to protect their mission-critical environments. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, troubleshooting complex networking and system-related issues across SaaS and on-prem environments. This is a highly visible role that requires strong technical expertise, customer-facing experience, and the ability to navigate complex, high-impact cases independently.

You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Managers to ensure customers achieve maximum value from the Claroty platform.

As a Product Support Engineer, Your impact will be:

  • Work independently to investigate issues reported by enterprise customers, reproduce customer problems, and involve others on the team as necessary
  • Demonstrate critical thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop strategic ongoing customer relationships
  • Maintain excellent relationships with Claroty Enterprise Support customers, Technical Account Managers, Product Management, and local account teams

  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying and correcting customer satisfaction concerns and clearing any concerns or technical roadblocks
  • Escalate support cases and priority issues to management as needed
  • Identify and independently take on additional tasks

Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. jobs.title: Request for Proposal (RFP): Consultancy Service for Strategic Scoping of Governm
jobs.description:
Proposal No: UPGI-26-PR100

Consultancy Type: Short Term

Publication Date: 16/11/2026

Clarifications Deadline: 24/11/2026

Closing Date: 26/11/2026

Consultants Location: Philippines

Organisational Background

BRAC was established after the independence of Bangladesh by Sir Fazle Hasan Abed in 1972 and is currently working in 10 other countries in Asia and Africa. It is the largest non-governmental development organisation in the world in terms of number of employees. BRAC International is a leading nonprofit organisation with a mission to empower people and communities in situations of poverty, illiteracy, disease, and social injustice. Our approach is to identify innovative and holistic solutions toward sustainable livelihoods and socioeconomic resilience. We achieve large-scale, transformative change by empowering individuals, especially women, and their families and communities to overcome poverty and become self-reliant and resilient. We work with local communities to innovate demand-driven programmes that integrate social development with market-based solutions like microfinance and social entrepreneurship. With our origin and roots in the Global South and our commitment to continuous learning, we have a depth of experience and evidence that enables us to respond to the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage.

About the BRAC International’s Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (BI-UPGI)

BRAC’s Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (UPGI) is a global unit of BRAC that was founded in 2016 to build off the success of BRAC’s Ultra-Poor Graduation program in Bangladesh. BRAC UPGI aims to position the Graduation approach as a key driver to eradicate extreme poverty worldwide. It does this by:

  • Advocating for uptake of the Graduation approach by policymakers, national governments, multilateral institutions, and non-governmental organizations; and

  • Effective adaptation and implementation of the Graduation approach in countries around the world, supported through technical assistance and capacity strengthening for external stakeholders.

In 2002, BRAC pioneered the Ultra-Poor Graduation (“Graduation”) approach in Bangladesh - a holistic intervention to help people lift themselves from extreme poverty - after recognizing that existing poverty alleviation programs were not reaching the poorest people. Through the provision of livelihood assets, cash transfers, and continued mentoring and training, the Graduation approach addresses participants’ multidimensional needs within the local context and ‘graduates’ people from extreme poverty into sustainable livelihoods.

Graduation is an evidence-based, scalable intervention proven to break the poverty trap for the long term. So far, BRAC’s flagship Graduation program has impacted over 2 million Bangladeshi households—totaling over 9 million people. To help eradicate extreme poverty, BRAC UPGI is working to scale globally by integrating Graduation into existing government programs and help 21 million more people lift themselves from extreme poverty by 2026.

But BRAC UPGI cannot do it alone. This is beyond the means and capacity of a single organization- no matter how ambitious or innovative. Sustainability and scale demand change at the systems level with active government engagement. BRAC UPGI is committed to creating effective solutions that leverage the available resources and existing programming to achieve the long-term benefits demonstrated by Graduation. The organization is partnering with governments, as well as multilateral institutions, NGOs, and civil society, in countries where BRAC UPGI thinks it can have maximum impact and drive greater uptake for Graduation.

In the Philippines, UPGI works with key government stakeholders, particularly the Department of Economy, Planning, and Development (DEPDev), Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), and the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), to explore and advance opportunities for institutionalizing Graduation principles within national policies, programs, budgets, and delivery mechanisms.

1. Background and Strategic Context

The Philippine government has established policy and institutional mechanisms to reduce poverty, strengthen social protection, and improve access to sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.

These include the Philippine Development Plan (PDP) 2023-2028, and its 2025 Midterm Update, the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps), the 4Ps National AdvisoryCouncil (NAC), and the Program Convergence Budgeting (PCB) for Livelihood and Employment.

Recent government initiatives have also strengthened the policy framework for supporting households transitioning out of 4Ps, including the Pugay-Tagumpay Graduation Strategy and interagency convergence arrangements.

These developments provide potential opportunities for UPGI to contribute evidence and technical expertise to ongoing government-led efforts.

DEPDEv, as the government’s primary economic policy, planning, coordinating, and monitoring agency, plays an important role in aligning poverty reduction and economic inclusion priorities with national development planning, public investment programming, policy coordination, and monitoring frameworks.

At the same time, operational responsibilities for social protection, livelihood, employment, and 4Ps convergence reside across multiple agencies, particularly DSWD and DOLE.

For UPGI, the strategic opportunity is therefore not simply to promote recognition of the Graduation Approach, but to identify how its distinctive technical expertise can strengthen existing government frameworks, address implementation gaps, and contribute to more effective and sustainable poverty reduction outcomes.

As part of its Program Investment planning, UPGI seeks to identify focused, feasible, and government-owned opportunities where its technical and financial resources could make a catalytic contribution.

This requires a clearer understanding of DEPDev’s priorities, the institutional and policy processes through which Graduation-related support could be advanced, and the specific contribution UPGI could provide.

UPGI is therefore commissioning a rapid strategic scoping exercise to inform its partnership and investment decisions, including the potential need for an embedded technical resource within DEPDev.

For the purpose of this assignment, BRAC’s Graduation approach refers to an integrated, sequenced, and context-adapted approach that combines social protection, livelihood and economic inclusion support, coaching or mentoring, financial inclusion, and other services to build sustainable pathways out of extreme poverty. The consultant should distinguish this approach from existing government definitions and processes relating to 4Ps program graduation while identifying areas of alignment and complementarity.

2. Purpose of the Assignment

The primary purpose of this consultancy is to identify, assess, and prioritize strategic opportunities for BRAC UPGI to support DEPDev and relevant government partners in advancing the integration and operationalization of Graduation principles within Philippine poverty reduction, social protection, and economic inclusion systems.

The assignment is intended to inform UPGI’s program investment decisions by determining where its technical assistance and resources could generate the greatest strategic value, strengthen government ownership, and contribute to sustainable institutionalization and potential scale.

The consultancy should also assess whether an embedded UPGI-supported technical resource within DEPDev is an appropriate and effective modality for advancing identified priorities.

The assignment should result in practical recommendations rather than a broad institutional assessment or an open-ended mapping of potential partnerships.

3. Specific Objectives

The consultant will:

Objective 1: Identify strategic policy and institutional entry points

Assess DEPDev’s current and emerging priorities and identify specific policy, planning, investment programming, and coordination processes through which Graduation principles could be meaningfully advanced.

Objective 2: Assess alignment with existing government initiatives

Examine the alignment between BRAC’s Graduation approach and relevant Philippine government frameworks, particularly the PDP (specifically, the sections on economic inclusion, livelihoods, and poverty reduction), 4Ps, 4Ps NAC, PCB for Livelihood and Employment, and other social protection policies and programs..

Identify existing strengths, implementation gaps, and opportunities for UPGI to provide additional technical value without duplicating ongoing government efforts.

Objective 3: Determine government demand and UPGI’s potential contribution

Identify priority areas where relevant government counterparts demonstrate a need for, and interest in, UPGI’s expertise. Assess the institutional feasibility, political and policy environment, and potential for government leadership and ownership.

Objective 4: Prioritize investment and engagement opportunities

Develop a small set of practical support options and assess their strategic relevance, feasibility, resource implications, sustainability, and potential contribution to the institutionalization and scaling of Graduation-informed approaches.

Objective 5: Recommend an actionable engagement and resourcing arrangement

Recommend the most appropriate next steps and technical assistance modality for UPGI, including whether an embedded technical resource within DEPDev is justified. Where appropriate, develop a proposed position TOR and indicative 12-month work plan.

4. Scope of Work and Primary Responsibilities

The consultant will undertake the following activities:

Task 1: Inception and Targeted Policy and Institutional Review

Conduct a focused review of relevant government and UPGI documents to develop an initial understanding of the policy environment, government priorities, and potential entry points. Documents may include:

  1. The current PDP and relevant implementation and monitoring documents.

  2. DEPDev’s relevant policy priorities (Social Protection) and poverty reduction strategies.

  3. 4Ps programme documents and related economic inclusion initiatives.

  4. Available 4Ps NAC documents, including its mandate, membership, and relevant meeting or policy materials.

  5. PCB for Livelihood and Employment, including relevant DOLE coordination and budgeting processes

  6. Relevant Graduation evidence, evaluations, and UPGI strategy documents.

The document review should focus on identifying practical policy and institutional opportunities, not producing an exhaustive literature review.

The consultant will prepare a brief inception note outlining the proposed approach, priority questions, initial hypotheses, stakeholder consultations, and expected outputs.

Task 2: Conduct Strategic Stakeholder Consultations

Conduct approximately 6–8 key informant interviews and 2–3 small working meetings, subject to stakeholder availability and agreement with UPGI. Priority stakeholders should include appropriate representatives from:

  1. DEPDev officials and technical staff involved in national development planning, poverty reduction, social protection, public investment, and interagency coordination.

  2. Relevant 4Ps and Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) representatives.

  3. Selected 4Ps NAC representatives or member agencies.

  4. Relevant DOLE counterparts involved in livelihood and employment convergence and the associated PCB mechanism, in the Social Protection Floor, and in programs and policies related to child labor and informal workers.

  5. Other relevant government counterparts, where necessary to clarify specific policy or institutional issues.

Interviews and meetings will explore:

  1. What are DEPDev’s and relevant partner agencies’ current priorities concerning poverty reduction, social protection, and economic inclusion?

  2. Potential opportunities to integrate Graduation into the PDP and its implementation mechanisms.

  3. Possible complementarities between Graduation and 4Ps.

  4. Opportunities to advance Graduation-related policy dialogue or coordination through the 4Ps NAC.

  5. Institutional needs, constraints, decision-making processes, and potential policy windows.

  6. The type of technical assistance that would be most useful from UPGI.

  7. Potential functions, placement, and priorities of an embedded UPGI-supported staff member.

Meetings should be targeted and discussion-oriented, with no requirement for large-scale workshops or formal multi-stakeholder events. Existing meetings may be used where appropriate.

Task 3: Analysis and Prioritization of Support Opportunities

Synthesize findings from the document review, interviews, and working meetings to identify and prioritize potential areas for UPGI support. The consultant will distinguish between immediate actions, medium-term technical support, and longer-term opportunities requiring additional government decisions.

Task 4: Develop the Embedded Staff TOR and 12-Month Work Plan

Based on the scoping findings, assess the most suitable mechanism through which UPGI could provide support. Options may include:

  • An embedded UPGI-supported technical resource within DEPDev.

  • Time-bound technical assistance or technical specialist.

  • Targeted policy, research, o technical advisory support

  • A phased combination of these approaches.

The assessment should consider the advantages, limitations, expected costs, institutional requirements, and sustainability implications of each option.

If embedding is recommended, the consultant will prepare a proposed TOR specifying:

  • Position purpose an expected contribution to government priorities.

  • Key responsibilities and expected deliverables.

  • Required qualifications and competencies

  • Performance measures and review arrangements

  • Indicative duration and support requirements

The consultant should also prepare an indicative 12-month work plan with quarterly milestones, outputs, responsible counterparts, and review points.

Task 5. Develop a Strategic Investment Recommendation for UPGI

Prepare a concise recommendation for UPGI identifying the preferred area or areas of engagement. The recommendation should clearly explain:

  • What UPGI should prioritize: One or two most promising opportunities for strategic support

  • Why these are priorities: Evidence of government demand and strategic relevance.

  • What UPGI should invest: Indicative staffing, technical assistance, coordination, and other support requirements, with cost assumptions and gaps identified.

  • What results could be expected: realistic 12-month outputs and institutional milestones, and their potential contribution to longer-term scale.

The work plan should translate the proposed responsibilities into a sequenced set of activities, deliverables, milestones, and timelines. It should identify relevant counterparts, dependencies, and areas requiring additional technical support from UPGI.

Task 6: Validation and Finalization

Present the findings and draft deliverables to UPGI and designated government counterparts through a small validation meeting or focused discussions. Incorporate feedback and finalize the scoping report, proposed embedded staff TOR, and 12-month work plan.

5. Methodology

The assignment will use a rapid, qualitative, and consultative approach comprising:

  1. Document review: Focused review of relevant policy, programme, and institutional documents.

  2. Key informant interviews: Semi-structured interviews with selected government stakeholders.

  3. Small working meetings: Targeted discussions to clarify priorities, test emerging findings, and identify feasible support options.

  4. Synthesis and co-design: Analysis of findings and preparation of the proposed embedded staff TOR and work plan.

  5. Validation: Focused review with UPGI and designated DEPDev counterparts.

The consultant will coordinate with UPGI to agree on the final interview list, documents to be reviewed, and arrangements for meetings. UPGI will facilitate introductions where appropriate.

6. Expected Deliverables and Timeline

Deliverable 1: Inception Note and Scoping Framework (Week 1)

An inception note outlining the proposed methodology, initial hypotheses, interview guide, document review plan, and proposed list of stakeholders to be consulted.

Deliverable 2: Scoping Findings and Prioritized Support Options (Week 3)

A concise synthesis of findings from the document review, stakeholder interviews, and consultations. The findings should identify potential entry points through the PDP, 4Ps, and 4Ps NAC, highlight institutional constraints, and recommend prioritized areas for UPGI support.

Deliverable 3: Proposed Engagement Arrangement and 12-Month Work Plan (Week 3)

A proposed technical assistance arrangement outlining the recommended engagement modality, including a draft Terms of Reference for embedded staff where justified. The deliverable should also include a 12-month work plan detailing key milestones, expected outputs, institutional counterparts, and dependencies.

Deliverable 4: Final Scoping Report and Validation Discussion (Week 4)

A consolidated final scoping report incorporating findings, prioritized recommendations, a finalized draft TOR and 12-month work plan, and proposed next steps for UPGI and DEPDev. The consultant will also facilitate a validation discussion with relevant stakeholders.

Final outputs should be:

  • Evidence-informed and grounded in Philippine government context

  • Strategically focused rather than prescriptive

  • Explicit regarding UPGI’s additionality and potential value for money

  • Realistic about what can be achieved with a 12-month engagement

  • Useful for UPGI’s management decisions and subsequent discussions with government counterparts

7. Level of Effort

The assignment will require a maximum of 15 working days of consultant LOE, spread over approximately 3 months, depending on stakeholder availability. Adjustments may be agreed with UPGI within the maximum level of effort.

8. Coordination and Reporting

The consultant will report directly to the Programme Director, who will provide strategic guidance, review key deliverables, and coordinate internal feedback.

The consultant will maintain regular communication with UPGI, particularly at inception, following the initial consultations, and before finalizing the recommended investment options.

The consultant will not make commitments on behalf of UPGI regarding technical assistance, financing, staff deployment, or formal government partnerships.

9. Required Skills and Qualifications

Role Overview

The Staff Application Security Engineer leads application security strategy for Apollo’s Security department and delivers it through hands-on work and technical leadership. This role takes on the hardest AppSec problems across product, platform, and AI-powered features, including problems with no established playbook.

The role shapes the roadmaps of Engineering, Product, and Platform teams so secure patterns become the default, and sets the AppSec standard that helps many teams build securely without relying on any single person.

Key Responsibilities

AppSec strategy, standards, and influence

  • Lead Apollo’s multi-year AppSec strategy and turn it into multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives that move Security department KRs. Report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to Security leadership on a regular cadence.

Secure architecture and vulnerability depth

  • Lead security architecture reviews and threat modeling for ambiguous, high-scale, multi-team systems, including AI and agent features, and define the approach where no precedent exists.
  • Design and drive adoption of secure-by-default building blocks, such as shared authorization, safe OAuth and token handling, and SSRF-safe HTTP clients, so whole classes of issues stop appearing.
  • Shape vulnerability management across internal reviews, bug bounty, pentests, and SCA and runtime findings, with a focus on root causes, bug classes, and clear risk-based severity decisions.
  • Stay hands-on for the hardest cases: read code across teams, develop exploits, test bypasses, and lead variant analysis and staged remediation across teams.

Tooling, automation, and AI (AI-native by default)

  • Set the standard for AI-augmented AppSec in the department. Use AI and agents for code review, threat modeling, triage, and remediation, and build automation that teams outside Security adopt, with measured gains in speed, coverage, and signal quality.
  • Define how Apollo secures its AI systems and agent features, including input and output handling, AI-exposed APIs, prompt and response guardrails, tool permissions, and data-exfiltration paths.

  • Owns AppSec strategy across a multi-year horizon and gets it committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • Solves ambiguous, no-playbook problems and defines the approach for others to follow.
  • Makes hard risk calls under ambiguity and aligns technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.
  • Builds guardrails, standards, and people so AppSec scales beyond any one person.

Required Skills & Experience

  • A track record of leading AppSec strategy that changed how several engineering teams build, with measurable results, typically backed by 10+ years in software engineering or application security.
  • Expert code review, penetration testing, and exploit development skills, with the ability to find design flaws in unfamiliar codebases and land fixes that hold up against bypass attempts.
  • Strong software development skills and the ability to ship production code. Ruby and Ruby on Rails experience is highly valuable, and Python is a plus. Strong Linux and cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP and Kubernetes.
  • Deep experience with secure architecture and authentication and authorization patterns, and with building security building blocks that other teams adopt.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI-powered systems or agent features, and a clear point of view on how AI changes application security.
  • The judgment to make hard risk calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align technical and non-technical leaders without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading security for AI-native products, internal agents, or AI-assisted engineering workflows at scale.
  • Experience building or scaling a security champions or developer enablement program.
  • Public security work, such as CVEs, research, talks, or open-source tools, or certifications such as OSCP or OSWE.

Example Success Outcomes

  • An AppSec strategy tied to Security department KRs, with supporting work committed in other teams’ roadmaps.
  • A measurable drop in high-risk vulnerability classes, backed by shared guardrails or libraries.
  • AI-assisted AppSec workflows adopted by teams outside Security, with clear gains in speed or signal quality.

React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About Apollo

Apollo is the AI-powered go-to-market platform that helps revenue teams find, engage, and convert their best customers. We combine a database of more than 210 million contacts and 35 million companies with an agentic end-to-end GTM platform, and more than 500,000 companies rely on us to run their go-to-market motion. We are profitable, growing fast, and rebuilding the product around AI and agents.

About Builder Studio

Builder Studio is Apollo's new product for building custom GTM software in plain English. A RevOps lead, GTM engineer, or founder describes the tool they need, and Builder Studio plans it, generates real code, and turns it into a working app they can preview, refine through conversation, publish, and share with their team.

Every app is made of four building blocks: Pages for the interface, Databases for structured records, Workflows for visible backend logic and scheduled jobs, and Agents that reason over Apollo context and take action. What makes it different from a generic app builder is that Apollo's data, enrichment, sequences, deliverability, and CRM sync are native building blocks, not bolted-on third-party integrations.

It is one of Apollo's flagship AI bets. The product is in the hands of early design partners now and is heading toward broad launch, which means the next year is about taking a working product and making it reliable, secure, and loved at scale.

Your role and mission

You will own major slices of Builder Studio end to end, across the builder experience customers see and the systems that make generated apps actually run. You will work on problems most engineers have never touched: an agent that writes and edits software on a customer's behalf, a runtime that safely executes that code with the user's own Apollo permissions, and an interface that makes all of it understandable to someone who has never read a line of code.

What you will do

  • Build the core Studio experience: the chat-driven build loop, live preview, canvas, and the publish and share flow, so a non-technical user can go from an idea to a working tool in minutes
  • Shape how the agent turns a natural-language goal into a plan, a set of pages, databases, and workflows, and then safely applies follow-up edits without breaking what already works
  • Design the runtime and workflow layer for generated apps, including triggers, scheduled jobs, retries, logging, and the line between deterministic steps and agentic steps
  • Own delegated identity, permissions, secrets, and isolation so generated apps act with exactly the access the user has, and nothing more
  • Expand "connect once, use anywhere" integrations across Apollo data (contacts, companies, lists) and external systems like Google Sheets, Google Drive, CRMs, and MCP-based connectors
  • Make the relationships between pages, data, workflows, and agents legible in the UI, so customers trust what their app is doing
  • Work directly with design partners and customers, turn their feedback into shipped improvements quickly, and help define what the product becomes
  • Raise the quality bar on a fast-moving 0 to 1 team: set patterns, write the tests and evals that matter, and own reliability, performance, and cost of what you ship

How we work: AI-native by default

You treat AI-assisted development as a core part of how you work. You use agents to move faster on design, investigation, and implementation, with clear judgment about where to review closely, and you look for ways AI raises the leverage of the whole team. On Builder Studio this is doubly true: you are building an AI that writes software, so your own instincts for where AI-generated code succeeds and fails directly shape the product.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real depth on both the frontend and backend of the same product
  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, including complex, stateful UIs such as editors, canvases, builders, or real-time collaborative surfaces
  • Solid backend and API design experience, ideally including event-driven or workflow systems where retries, idempotency, and observability matter
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production: agent loops, tool calling, context management, code generation, or evals. You know where models break and how to design around it
  • Comfort making sound security calls on systems that run untrusted or generated code: sandboxing, delegated auth, scoped tokens, and secrets handling
  • A track record of taking an ambiguous 0 to 1 product from rough prototype to something customers rely on, and making the scope-versus-quality calls that requires
  • Product instinct and empathy for non-technical users. You care whether a RevOps lead can understand what their app is doing, not just whether the code is correct
  • Genuine, current fluency with AI-assisted development and a high bar for quality and ownership

Nice to have

  • Experience building low-code, no-code, or AI app-builder products, or developer tools
  • Experience with edge or serverless runtimes such as Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Background in GTM, sales, or marketing tech, or experience working closely with RevOps teams

Our tech stack

TypeScript and React on the front end; Ruby on Rails and Node.js on the backend; Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects for the Builder Studio runtime; Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch across the wider platform; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

What you will love about Apollo

You will help build a brand new product from the ground up at a company with the data, distribution, and customer base to make it matter on day one. You will work with a small, high-bar team, own real scope, and have the AI tooling and budget to work at the top of your leverage.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Appen’s Strategic Project Leads turn complex technical requirements into high-quality data and evaluation resources that help advance AI models.

As the Strategic Project Lead for Physical Engineering, you will bring deep engineering knowledge to projects involving the physical world and built environment. You will help translate real-world engineering work into structured tasks, expert-reviewed data and evaluations that support AI training and model assessment.

You will bring depth in at least one physical engineering discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, civil or structural engineering, while working with specialists across other areas as needed. You will partner with customers, Applied Researchers, Operations and technical experts to shape project requirements, establish quality standards and deliver technically credible results.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead through subject matter expertise and influence, rather than direct people management.

Your Impact

  • Translate customer requirements into realistic engineering tasks, data specifications and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Assess technical requirements, review source files and develop representative samples to establish project feasibility.
  • Shape the physical engineering domain strategy across areas such as CAD, BIM, CAE and electrical engineering.
  • Develop multi-step engineering tasks and reference solutions that reflect real-world technical challenges across models, drawings, calculations and specifications.
  • Lead pilots from sample development and expert onboarding through quality assurance and customer acceptance.
  • Partner with Operations to transition projects into production, maintaining technical standards and ownership of domain quality as delivery scales.
  • Build and qualify a network of specialist engineering contributors and reviewers.
  • Work with Applied Researchers and tooling teams to develop technical verification methods and improve the consistency of engineering evaluations.
  • Provide effort estimates and identify specialist requirements, tooling needs and delivery risks to support commercial proposals.
  • Turn successful projects into reusable engineering samples, task libraries and delivery methods.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in at least one physical engineering discipline, with a background in applied engineering work and technical problem-solving.
  • Practical experience with engineering tools and CAE workflows, including interpreting analyses and validating assumptions, constraints and results.
  • Experience working with technical artefacts such as CAD or BIM models, engineering drawings, schematics, calculations, simulations or specifications.
  • Experience leading technical projects from initial scoping and estimation through execution and delivery, with direct involvement in the technical work.
  • Ability to evaluate engineering outputs, identify technical inaccuracies and establish quality standards and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience assessing or guiding technical specialists, with the judgement to recognise when additional expertise is required.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear instructions and lead cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Master's or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience developing engineering data, technical tasks or evaluation resources for AI training, model evaluation or benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with CAD/BIM interoperability, open engineering formats or structured validation of engineering models and documentation.
  • Experience building specialist contributor networks or leading distributed technical delivery with external engineering experts.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

jobs.title: Compiler Engineer - Algorithmic Workloads Compilation
jobs.description:
About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Help push the boundaries of what can run on our accelerator. You’ll design compiler IRs and lowering strategies to support algorithmic workloads with irregular or dynamic control flow—loops, branches, and iterative methods—going beyond static neural networks. Working side by side with hardware engineers, you’ll influence ISA and execution model co-design to unlock new algorithm classes on analog and digital subsystems. The result: a compiler that makes complex algorithms practical to deploy while staying seamless for developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Extend compiler IRs to represent algorithms not easily captured in DNN graphs including control flow and iterative computation
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify analog compute with digital subsystems while maintaining performance and correctness
  • Prototype and optimize algorithms with irregular or dynamic control flow in compiler IRs, applying techniques such as vectorization, predication, and scheduling
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to co-design ISA and features that improve support for algorithmic workloads
  • Define a roadmap for higher-level programming abstractions that simplify prototyping and accelerate deployment

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of professional experience in compilers or high-performance systems software
  • Proficiency in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python
  • Familiarity with compiler IRs (e.g., MLIR, LLVM, or equivalent) and their use representing complex program structures
  • Solid foundation in program analysis and optimization techniques (e.g., SSA form, loop optimizations, vectorization)

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Hands-on experience developing MLIR or LLVM dialects for control flow (e.g. scf, cf) or affine/polyhedral representations.
  • Background in compiler-hardware co-design: working with hardware designers to refine ISA or execution models for efficiency
  • Proven ability to prototype irregular or control-flow algorithms in compiler IRs and optimize them for performance and resource constraints
  • Experience extending ML compiler stacks (ONNX, IREE, XLA, PyTorch, TVM) to support workloads beyond DNNs

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make algorithmic and control-flow-heavy workloads practical on novel accelerator hardware.
  • A role that bridges compiler design and hardware co-design, shaping both the IR and the accelerator architecture.
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

Strategic Account Leadership

jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description:
Elation Health exists to enable every patient to experience the highest quality care wherever they go in the healthcare system. We build technology for independent primary care practices and the physicians, clinicians, and teams who care for their patients every day.

Our platform brings together a clinical-first EHR, intelligent automation, billing, patient engagement, and the workflows that help primary care practices deliver excellent care and build sustainable businesses. The work is consequential: when our products are clear, trustworthy, and well designed, clinicians can spend more time focused on patients and less time fighting their tools.

Primary care is foundational to a healthy healthcare system, yet the technology supporting it is often fragmented, burdensome, and disconnected from the realities of clinical work. At Elation, Design has the opportunity to make the experience of practicing medicine meaningfully better—while helping independent primary care remain strong, sustainable, and human.

We are seeking a passionate Design leader to drive our design strategy, build a strongly capable Design organization, raise the quality and coherence of the product experience, and use AI-native ways of working to deliver more intuitive, trusted, and impactful experiences for clinicians and practices at scale. If you’re excited about shaping the next generation of AI-native primary care technology, this role is for you.

The opportunity

As Head of Design, you will set the vision, standards, and operating model for Design at Elation. You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

What you’ll do

  • Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.
  • Lead and shape an AI-native Design organization with a durable operating model for how designers, agents, and cross-functional teams work together to create higher-quality experiences at greater speed. Elation is already well on this journey, with AI-native product strategy, evolving design systems, and emerging AI-assisted design-review practices.
  • Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.
  • Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.
  • Raise the quality bar across the end-to-end user experience, including research, service design, product strategy, interaction design, visual design, content, accessibility, and customer enablement.
  • Strengthen the systems that allow design to scale: principles, patterns, documentation, design systems, research practices, reusable frameworks, and the connection between design artifacts and shipped product. Implement a practical design-review culture that improves decisions early, creates shared standards, protects team velocity, and makes quality everyone’s responsibility.
  • Foster deep empathy for clinicians and practice teams by embedding a rigorous culture of user research across product development—engaging directly with clinical and billing experts through co-design, workflow observation, and qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Help teams solve the right problems before they move quickly on the wrong ones. Create clarity in ambiguous spaces and make tradeoffs explicit.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure that design intent survives implementation and that the finished experience is reliable, coherent, accessible, and delightful to use.
  • Develop designers as leaders and active contributors to product direction—not simply as owners of screens or deliverables.
  • Represent the customer and the design perspective in senior leadership discussions, product prioritization, launch decisions, and company-wide conversations about quality.
  • Create an environment where designers can do their best work: one that is candid, collaborative, intellectually curious, and accountable for impact.

What success looks like

We will measure success through a combination of customer impact, product quality, organizational health, and operating leverage. In particular, we expect this leader to improve:

  • Clinician and practice-team experience, including usability, consistency, and confidence in Elation’s products.
  • Design quality and product coherence, with fewer late-stage design issues and less avoidable rework.
  • The quality and consistency of customer insight used in product decisions.
  • Design team health, retention, hiring, growth, and clarity of ownership.
  • Product Development velocity through stronger design systems, review practices, reusable patterns, and AI-native ways of working.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience leading product design in a complex, multi-surface, or highly regulated environment. Experience in healthcare, health technology, enterprise SaaS, or another domain where trust and workflow quality matter is especially valuable.
  • A track record of building, scaling, or materially strengthening a design organization, including hiring, coaching, org design, and talent development.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to connect design decisions to customer outcomes, business strategy, and technical realities.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Product and Engineering leaders and influencing decisions beyond the Design function.
  • Deep fluency across the UX stack: research, service design, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and design operations.
  • A strong point of view on design quality, paired with the humility and communication skills to develop that point of view with others.
  • The ability to make complex systems understandable and usable without flattening the nuance that matters.
  • A demonstrated commitment to customer-centered, evidence-informed decision making.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make design rationale clear to executives, cross-functional partners, and designers at every level.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, creating structure where it is needed, and making thoughtful decisions without waiting for perfect information.

Salary: $200,000 - $260,000k/yr + variable

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

jobs.title: Accounting Coordinator
jobs.description:
About this Role

In this role, you will be supporting the accounting team of a global company. You will play a significant role in maintaining the financial books and records and managing the accounting operations for vendors and suppliers. You will be preparing journal entries, drafting schedules, and completing reconciliations. You will contribute to ensuring that the business unit’s accounting operations are functioning smoothly.

You Will...

  • Manage the supplier bills process and ensure timely supplier payments
  • Complete bank reconciliations for various foreign bank accounts
  • Perform complex reconciliations of payment processor fees from multiple payment processors, including the management of those accounts
  • Review and enter vendor bills
  • Be responsible for inventory purchase accounting, reconciliations, and routine ledger entries
  • Prepare journal entry documentation, book routine accruals and adjustment entries, and perform month-end account reconciliations. Identify and resolve discrepancies across sub-ledgers and the general ledger
  • Produce routine and ad hoc reports as needed
  • Assist in maintaining financial records in full compliance with local Polish accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal control frameworks
  • Engage in other finance and accounting-related activities and special projects

You Have...

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
  • 2+ years of professional experience in a similar position
  • Advanced computer skills (including G Suite and Microsoft Office, especially Excel)
  • Solid understanding of core accounting principles under Polish GAAP
  • Accuracy, timeliness, and patience
  • Good analytical and numerical skills
  • Ability to identify discrepancies between POs, contracts, and invoices, ensuring precision in data entry and general ledger entries
  • Capability to troubleshoot transactional discrepancies, balance sub-ledgers, and propose workflow optimizations
  • Fluent Polish (written & spoken) – Required for maintaining Polish statutory books and ensuring compliance with local authorities
  • Advanced English (written & spoken) – Required for daily professional communication with international accounting teams and cross-functional partners
  • Professional communication skills with the ability to build collaborative working relationships across functions
  • Collaborative, proactive, and willing to participate in a variety of international financial projects

Bonus Points...

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or similar enterprise ERP software

Benefits & Perks

  • Entry Salary = 70,000 PLN
  • MacBook Pro and all the gear you need for work
  • Free access to a multitude of popular online courses and books sponsored by our company
  • Company stock options
  • Company swag packages
  • Cafeteria Benefit Program (including private medical care, gym membership, shopping/wellness bonus, etc.)
  • VTO (Voluntary Time Off) - a day off every quarter for volunteering with non-profits
  • Frequent team bonding events
  • Flexible work hours & time-off
  • Employee Interest and Hobby Groups supported by our company
  • Open, energetic, and fan-focused international work environment

About Fandom

Fandom is the world’s largest fan platform where fans immerse themselves in imagined worlds across entertainment and gaming. Reaching more than 350 million unique visitors per month and hosting more than 250,000 wikis, Fandom is the #1 source for in-depth information on pop culture, gaming, TV, and film, where fans learn about and celebrate their favorite fandoms. Fandom’s Gaming division manages the online video game retailer Fanatical. Fandom Productions, the content arm of Fandom, enhances the fan experience through curated editorial coverage and branded content from trusted and established publishing brands such as Gamespot, TV Guide, and Metacritic, along with its Emmy-nominated Honest Trailers and the weekly video news program The Loop. For more information, follow @getfandom or visit: www.fandom.com.

Fandom is an equal opportunity employer. Fandom values diversity, and all employment decisions are made on the basis of job requirements and individual qualifications.

jobs.title: Customer Support Coach - RMS
jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Customer Support Coach on our RMS support team, you will be the voice of and advocate for our standalone RMS customers. By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. You’ll support these customers using our standard methods, backed by additional training on how non-Cloudbeds PMS solutions and the tools around them operate. Your work will strengthen client relationships, promote software adoption, and shape the future of our platform through the feedback you share. You’ll also help create training materials, update support resources, and stay ahead of system updates.

Our Customer Support Team:

Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals delivering exceptional experiences across live chat, email and phone. We pride ourselves on a supportive, diverse and collaborative culture where continuous learning, growth and innovation drive everything we do. Be part of a team that values connection, celebrates success, and always strives to exceed expectations.

What You Bring to the Team:

• Support our standalone RMS customers (hotel properties) daily in the use of our software, using our standard support methods, and resolve inquiries via phone, email, chat or any other channel Cloudbeds uses.
• Troubleshoot escalated issues and make outbound calls when needed.
• Learn how non-Cloudbeds PMS customer solutions operate and connect, starting with Guestline, Opera and Mews, so you can troubleshoot for customers on external PMSs.
• Support customer email delivery through Brevo, including subaccounts and navigation, senders and domains, API key reactivation, and deliverability and policies.
• Build strong customer relationships with empathy to drive loyalty, retention and software adoption, and gather customer feedback and requirements for future releases.
• Create training materials and update support resources.
• Stay current on system updates by using training materials and attending company-wide online training sessions.

What Sets You Up for Success:

• 2+ years of experience using an enterprise RMS to manage and set rates, or working for an enterprise RMS provider (e.g., Duetto, IDeaS, Lighthouse)
• Native or fluent English, with excellent communication skills and a positive attitude
• Excellent problem-solving skills, emotional intelligence and learning agility
• A compatible degree, or more than 2 years of proven experience in the area
• Strong skills with computers and systems
• An excellent internet/WiFi connection

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

• Previous experience in customer service or similar roles

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

Cloudbeds Awards:

  • Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)

  • Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)

  • Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)

Discover our Benefits:

  • Remote First, Remote Always

  • PTO in accordance with local labor requirements

  • Fully Paid Parental Leave

  • Home office stipend based on country of residency

  • Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University

  • Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer

Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion

Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process or to perform essential job functions, please contact our HR team by phone at (858) 201-7832 or via email at accommodations@cloudbeds.com. Cloudbeds will provide an American Sign Language (ASL) interpreter where needed as a reasonable accommodation for the hiring process.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Cloudbeds. Staffing, recruiting agencies, and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit applications, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Cloudbeds does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Cloudbeds employees, or any other company location.
