jobs.title: Data Center Development Manager
jobs.description:
Worldwide Mission Critical is a global owner’s representation and project management company dedicated to the mission-critical industry, helping companies deliver their data centers on time and under budget. Founded on the principle that the right team of experienced data center professionals will deliver great projects, our ability to provide oversight for all aspects of a project sets us apart.

Summary

    As a Development Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in the transformation of data center campuses into cutting-edge solutions, driving value enhancement and expedited time-to-market. The Role will engage on data center projects in the early concept phase to align the correct development strategy, outline entitlement requirements, define preliminary budgets and schedules, and oversee the team of design consultants. Your expertise will ensure that projects align with industry standards, exceed client expectations, and uphold the highest ethical standards.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management or engineering field preferred.
  • Minimum of five years in construction project management, with at least two years' experience in mission-critical projects.
  • Strong grasp of construction practices, along with proficiency in Excel, MS Word, MS Project, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead project and design teams, building strong relationships and fostering collaboration.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively addressing complex issues and making impactful presentations.
  • Adept at problem-solving with limited information, navigating ambiguity, and prioritizing effectively.
  • Flexible, self-directed, and capable of thriving in diverse scenarios, including remote work, travel, and collaboration across multiple time zones.
  • Deep understanding of commercial metrics driving successful development.
  • High level of organization, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, work well under pressure, and prioritize tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to travel to client sites approximately once/month.

Skills, Knowledge, Education, and Experience

  • Serve as the Owner's representative, guiding data center construction projects to meet or surpass industry standards, upholding professionalism and ethical conduct throughout the process.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence on new project opportunities, evaluating their feasibility and alignment with client objectives.
  • Assist in identifying and acquiring potential sites, performing site assessments to ensure compatibility with client programs and goals.
  • Research and navigate complex land use and entitlement requirements.
  • Contribute to master planning, programming, and design coordination.
  • Lead scope, schedule, and budget decisions, managing internal and external teams, contractors, and vendors to successful project conclusions.
  • Facilitate vendor selection through robust RFP/bid processes and manage design vendors, fostering efficient communication and outcomes.
  • Oversee design, engineering, scheduling, and budgeting aspects of new projects, from conceptual design to construction document development.
  • Transition projects to Preconstruction and Construction Project Managers for seamless execution and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Maintain consistent travel to client sites, fostering strong relationships and ensuring project alignment with client vision.
If you're ready to bring your expertise to a team that's redefining how data centers get built, we'd love to hear from you. At Worldwide Mission Critical, you'll find the support, trust, and room to grow that helped us become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country — and we're just getting started.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, AI Evaluation
jobs.description:
About Syllo

Syllo is on a mission to transform litigation. Our product is a unified litigation platform that enables lawyers and paralegals to safely harness the power of language models and agentic AI throughout the litigation life cycle. Since going to market, we have gained a diverse group of enterprise customers, including some of the biggest law firms and corporations in the country, and we are quickly expanding. By reducing the expense of litigation industry-wide, we aim to improve access to high-quality representation and promote the alignment of legal outcomes with merit.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Data Scientist to help us evaluate and improve the quality and performance of our AI systems. You’ll develop rigorous approaches to measuring system behavior, run experiments, investigate issues, and turn complex data into actionable decisions.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data science, engineering, and applied AI. You’ll work directly with production data and systems and partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Analytics.

Responsibilites

  • AI Evaluation: Develop quantitative methods and tooling to evaluate AI system quality and performance.
  • Experimentation: Design and run experiments to compare approaches, understand tradeoffs, and measure the impact of changes.
  • Quality Monitoring: Build repeatable processes to identify regressions, anomalies, and changes in system performance.
  • Data Analysis: Extract, transform, and analyze production data to support technical and product investigations.
  • Technical Investigation: Diagnose complex issues involving data, models, and production systems, identifying root causes and potential solutions.
  • Measurement & Instrumentation: Partner with Engineering to improve how system quality, reliability, and performance are measured.
  • Internal Tooling: Build tools and dashboards that make system performance easier to understand and monitor.
  • Communication: Clearly communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in computer science, data science, machine learning, or a related field with substantial hands-on experience; or 2–4 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working directly with production data.
  • Comfortable navigating production code and data systems you did not build.
  • Strong foundation in applied statistics, experimentation, and quantitative analysis.
  • Practical experience working with and evaluating modern AI/ML systems.
  • Experience diagnosing complex issues involving data, models, or production systems.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous questions into structured investigations and clearly communicate the results.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience building AI/ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or monitoring systems.
  • Experience with information retrieval, search, or large-scale information systems.
  • Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms and production data infrastructure.
  • Experience building internal analytics or observability tooling.

Salary Range ($160K- $200K) plus health insurance and equity.

United States - Remote Pay Range
$160,000—$200,000 USD

jobs.title: Director, Information Security
jobs.description:
Overview

SSOE is seeking an experienced Director, Information Security to lead the company’s enterprise information security program. This senior technology leadership role is responsible for developing and executing the firm’s information security strategy, protecting client and firm information assets, and leading the Information Security team.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role partners closely with Technology, Compliance, Legal, HR, and business leaders to strengthen SSOE’s security posture while supporting the firm’s continued growth and regulatory obligations. The successful candidate combines strong technical expertise with practical leadership and is comfortable balancing security, operational efficiency, and business enablement.

AI and Innovation

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.

Responsibilities

Security Strategy, Governance, and Leadership

  • Develop and execute SSOE’s multi-year information security roadmap, aligned with the firm’s technology strategy and business priorities.
  • Maintain the firm’s Information Security Program, including security policies, standards, and governance processes.
  • Assess the current security environment and develop prioritized plans to strengthen the firm’s overall security posture.
  • Partner with the CTO, Compliance, Legal, HR, and business leaders to identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks.
  • Lead enterprise security architecture and security-related technology decisions supporting cloud, endpoint, network, identity, applications, and data protection capabilities, and participate in cross-domain architecture governance for decisions involving multiple Technology capabilities.
  • Develop and manage the Information Security budget, vendor relationships, and technology investments in partnership with Technology leadership.
  • Provide regular reporting on security initiatives, key risks, and program maturity to executive leadership.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Information Security organization, including leaders and professionals responsible for identity security & access governance, security operations, security architecture, and data protection.
  • Foster a collaborative, service-oriented security culture that enables the business while appropriately managing risk.
  • Establish clear operational processes, performance expectations, and accountability across the Information Security team.
  • Provide coaching and career development for security engineers and analysts.
  • Manage relationships with security vendors, managed service providers, and consulting partners.

Identity Security and Access Governance

  • Lead the firm's identity security and access governance, partnering with Infrastructure Operations to support the Identity & Access Management (IAM) program, including identity lifecycle management, privileged access management (PAM), single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and identity governance.
  • Partner with Infrastructure Operations in the evaluation of IAM technologies and define the security architecture, control requirements, and governance standards that guide their implementation and ongoing operation.
  • Establish security requirements and governance for user provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, privileged access, and role-based access management, and partner with Infrastructure Operations to ensure those requirements are effectively implemented.
  • Partner with IT, HR, and business leaders to improve onboarding, offboarding, and access governance processes.

Data Protection & Network Security Governance

  • Lead the firm's data protection and network security governance and control framework, partnering with Infrastructure Operations on implementation and operation of network security capabilities.
  • Oversee Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capabilities, including data classification, policy development, monitoring, and continuous optimization.
  • Partner across Technology to ensure security controls are effectively designed, integrated, implemented, operated, monitored, and continuously improved across enterprise platforms and services, with clear accountability aligned to the nature of each capability.
  • Monitor key security metrics and continuously improve detection, prevention, and response capabilities.

Security Architecture, AI, and Software Development Security

  • Lead the security architecture strategy for enterprise platforms, cloud services, AI solutions, and custom applications, ensuring alignment with the firm's Information Security Program and business objectives.
  • Establish security controls supporting SSOE’s responsible AI governance framework for AI-enabled technologies, including data protection, model access, identity management, monitoring, and compliance with emerging AI security and responsible AI practices.
  • Ensure AI platforms and integrations adhere to enterprise security standards, including role-based access controls, audit logging, vulnerability management, secure APIs, and zero-trust principles.
  • Oversee application and software development security practices across internally developed solutions, integrations, automation platforms, and custom applications.
  • Establish secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) standards, including secure design reviews, threat modeling, code scanning, vulnerability remediation, and security testing requirements.
  • Govern access management and security controls across application repositories, development platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud development environments.
  • Partner with the appropriate Technology teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with software development, automation, machine learning, and emerging technologies.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure the Information Security Program supports applicable regulatory requirements and other relevant cybersecurity and privacy standards.
  • Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and client cybersecurity due diligence activities.
  • Lead enterprise cyber risk assessments, security-related data classification and protection initiatives, and third-party cybersecurity risk management, partnering with Enterprise Data, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Records Management on broader information governance requirements.
  • Partner with firm leadership to evaluate cyber insurance coverage and overall cyber risk management strategies.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Lead the firm's cybersecurity incident response program, including preparation, detection, containment, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Coordinate incident response activities across Technology, Compliance, Legal, Communications, and business stakeholders.
  • Conduct periodic tabletop exercises and continuously improve incident response readiness.
  • Oversee vulnerability management, endpoint protection, logging and monitoring, penetration testing, and threat detection capabilities.
  • Partner with Technology leadership to support business continuity and disaster recovery planning.

Security Culture & Awareness

  • Lead the firm's security awareness and education program, including role-based training for employees.
  • Promote a culture of cybersecurity awareness throughout the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to the firm's overall security program.
  • Support client and prospect cybersecurity due diligence requests and represent the Information Security program during security assessments.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive information security experience.
  • 5+ years leading enterprise information security teams, preferably as Head of Information Security, Director of Information Security, Senior Director, or similar leadership role.
  • Experience building or significantly maturing an enterprise information security program within the architecture/engineering/construction (AEC) or other regulated professional services industry.
  • Demonstrated success developing high-performing teams and managing external vendors and strategic partners.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management, including authentication, authorization, RBAC, PAM, SSO, MFA, and identity governance.
  • Experience establishing security requirements, architecture, and governance for modern IAM platforms (such as SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, and other similar platforms).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security, data protection, DLP technologies, CASB/SSE platforms, SIEM, SOAR, and endpoint security.
  • Experience securing cloud-first, SaaS-centric environments.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity and privacy regulations, applicable to the AEC industry
  • Familiarity with AI governance, AI security frameworks, machine learning security risks, and responsible AI controls.

Leadership and Communication

  • Proven ability to develop security strategy, build consensus, and lead organizational change across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical risks into business terms for executive leadership and business partners.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk-based decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead trusted relationships across Technology, Compliance, Legal, and business functions.

Preferred Certifications

One of more of the following certifications is strongly preferred:

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CISA
  • CRISC
  • CCSP
  • Or equivalent industry certifications

Success Measures

The successful candidate will be measured by:

  • Improvement in SSOE's overall cybersecurity posture and security program maturity
  • Reduction in material cybersecurity risk and exposure
  • Effectiveness of security controls across enterprise platforms and services
  • Security incident preparedness, response effectiveness, and organizational resilience
  • Vulnerability identification, remediation, and risk reduction
  • Maturity of identity security and access governance
  • Effectiveness of data protection and security-related data classification controls
  • Compliance, audit readiness, and responsiveness to client security requirements
  • Security awareness, employee engagement, and reduction in human-related security risk
  • Effectiveness of security architecture and secure software development practices
  • Security readiness for AI, cloud, and emerging technologies
  • Budget performance and effectiveness of security investments
  • Security vendor and managed service provider performance
  • Development, engagement, and retention of Information Security talent
  • Effectiveness of collaboration across Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, HR, and other stakeholders

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary: Depending on location, education, experience, and certifications.
  • Bonus and Incentives: Eligibility for our annual target bonus/incentive program based on company and individual performance and goals.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience, plus minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree, plus minimum 3 years of relevant experience

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Department of Defense Secret security clearance is obtainable within a reasonable amount of time after hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

The ASTR3/4 and SWIS Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and day-to-day execution of ASTR3/4 and SWIS efforts within the Fire Control organization. This position integrates Earned Value Management, contract requirements, forecasting, baselining, risk and opportunity management, staffing coordination, and customer deliverables to achieve program objectives.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Program Manager (PM), Control Account Managers (CAMs), Engineering, Contracts, Finance, and other stakeholders to support ASTR3/4 and SWIS activities. Responsibilities include delegated reviews and approvals, leadership and customer presentations, and cross-functional coordination. This role requires demonstrated leadership experience or strong leadership potential, sound judgment, and the ability to drive actions to closure.

Key Responsibilities

Earned Value Management and Program Performance

  • Review preliminary monthly Earned Value metrics for applicable ASTR3/4 and SWIS work.
  • Lead monthly EV meetings, working with CAMs and stakeholders to understand the root causes of cost and schedule variances.
  • Verify that required updates are accurately captured and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
  • Review and approve Variance Analysis Reports (VARs), Baseline Change Requests (BCRs), and Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) within delegated PM authority.
  • Conduct driving-path reviews to identify schedule dependencies, execution risks, and potential impacts to program milestones.
  • Review and approve charge-number requests within delegated PM authority.

Forecasting and Baselining

  • Coordinate quarterly labor, material, and orders forecast updates with CAMs and the PM.

  • Support kickoff and planning activities for new efforts, as applicable.
  • Develop and maintain baseline schedules with Engineering and coordinate requirements, dependencies, resources, and commitments with affected stakeholders.
  • Review pricing runs, develop baseline review materials, and present findings and recommendations with the PM.

Risk and Opportunity Management

  • Manage branch- and DDT-level risks throughout their lifecycle, including identification, assessment, review, approval, mitigation tracking, and retirement.
  • Identify and track opportunities, including ownership, action plans, and forecast impacts.
  • Communicate risk and opportunity status through applicable program, technical, milestone, leadership, and customer reviews.
  • Coordinate with customers, prime organizations, and internal stakeholders, as applicable, to align risks, mitigation plans, and associated actions across ASTR3/4 and SWIS efforts.

Staffing and Resource Coordination

  • Work with DPME to gather, validate, and submit staffing scorecard inputs to the Program Office.
  • Identify and communicate staffing growth, resource gaps, staffing deltas, and required skill sets.
  • Coordinate resource needs and competing priorities across ASTR3/4 and SWIS activities.
  • Tailor staffing information to the audience and review forum, including YPRs, MMMs, PPRs, and customer one-on-one discussions.

Program Execution and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support day-to-day ASTR3/4 and SWIS execution by coordinating priorities, tracking commitments, resolving issues, and escalating concerns with recommended actions.
  • Support program execution practices, reporting processes, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Develop meeting materials, participate in reviews, and present program status as required.
  • Support ASTR3/4 and SWIS meetings and related program and customer forums through content preparation, presentation, and action tracking.
  • Communicate cost, schedule, technical, staffing, and contractual performance to leadership and customers.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities, manage dependencies, and drive accountability for decisions, deliverables, and action closure.

Contract, Proposal, and Deliverable Management

  • Apply working knowledge of contract scope, Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) structure, deliverables, modifications, and applicable requirements to program execution.
  • Support proposal analysis, development, and execution for ASTR3/4 and SWIS efforts, as applicable.
  • Perform CLIN lead responsibilities, coordinate quoting methodology and approach, support fact-finding actions, and assist with modifications and analysis through award and execution.
  • Manage the coordination, review, and timely delivery of Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) submissions, including the Integrated Program Management Data and Analysis Report (IPMDAR), as applicable.
  • Coordinate tracking and delivery of contractual incentive requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Earned Value certification or demonstrated clear understanding and practical application of Earned Value Management, including performance metrics, variance analysis, baseline control, forecasting, and corrective actions.
  • Working knowledge of contracts and their relationship to program scope, CLINs, deliverables, changes, and execution commitments.
  • Familiarity with Fire Control systems, programs, or the associated engineering and execution environment.
  • Experience managing project scope, schedule, cost, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Proficiency with project management tools used for scheduling, cost analysis, forecasting, reporting, and action tracking.
  • Experience applying a structured risk and opportunity management process.
  • Experience preparing and presenting information to leadership and customers, including communicating performance, issues, and recommended actions.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience or leadership potential, evidenced by initiative, accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive actions to completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ASTR3/4, SWIS, or related Fire Control efforts, particularly in project planning, execution, baselining, or cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience supporting Fire Control programs, with an understanding of their engineering, integration, and program execution environment.
  • Experience coordinating multiple concurrent efforts and managing shared resources, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Experience supporting program kickoff or transition activities, including establishing or updating schedules, baselines, reporting practices, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Experience working with CAMs and performing delegated PM reviews and approvals.
  • Experience with program baselining, pricing reviews, proposal development, and contract modifications.
  • Experience coordinating CDRLs, IPMDAR submissions, and contractual incentives.
  • Experience coordinating execution activities and risks with customers, prime organizations, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience leading program reviews and communicating staffing and resource requirements.

jobs.title: Technical Chief of Staff to the CTO
jobs.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring a Technical Chief of Staff with a background in software engineering who has expanded into product, consulting, or organizational leadership. You’ve shipped production software and still read code, investigate systems, and form independent technical opinions. You’ll spend about 10–20% of your time on hands-on technical work, using that experience to inform decisions across Clover’s technology organization.

You’ll help teams turn requests from across the business into practical next steps: understand the underlying need, assess existing capabilities, narrow the scope, and find the right owner. You’re outgoing and gregarious. You seek people out, build relationships, and earn trust by explaining priorities and constraints and following through.

You’ll lead and develop a small team of portfolio managers, technical program managers, and delegated intake owners. Working with product and engineering leaders, you’ll make decisions within agreed authority and bring consequential or unresolved choices to the CTO with a clear recommendation.

As a Technical Chief of Staff, you will:

  • Draw on your engineering experience to test assumptions: read code, inspect an API, trace a data flow, or build a prototype. Make decisions within agreed authority and bring consequential or unresolved choices to the CTO with evidence and a recommendation. Partner with the CEO’s office when business priorities affect technology commitments.
  • Work as the public face of technology. Help business partners, managers and directors turn requests into work worth doing. Understand the outcome they need, examine existing capabilities, and find the smallest useful solution. Combine, narrow, defer, or advance requests, giving people a clear owner and next step.
  • Seek out collaborators and stakeholders across the business, listen to their concerns, and build trust through candid conversations about priorities, capacity, and constraints. Offer practical options and follow up before they need to chase you.
  • Develop portfolio managers, TPMs, and delegated intake owners by giving them meaningful decisions to make, coaching their judgment, and helping them take ownership of their areas.
  • Work with engineering leaders and TPMs to keep commitments grounded in capacity, dependencies, and vendor readiness. Step in when a delivery needs help, resolve the immediate problem, and establish an owner who can carry it forward.
  • Connect engineers with the people who use their systems. Bring in Product for discovery, partner with Special Project Leads on business transformation, and work with other technical leaders on shared dependencies.
  • Use AI to pull together evidence from the work underway, helping leaders see progress, blockers, and decisions that need their attention. Check the conclusions against source material and automate repetitive reporting.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 30 days: You’ve resolved or advanced real requests and delivered an early improvement for a business partner. You and the CTO have agreed on decision boundaries, your team knows its responsibilities, and you’ve established a baseline for request turnaround and unresolved ownership.
  • First 90 days: You and your team handle agreed intake areas with less CTO intervention. You can point to improvements accepted by business owners, faster request resolution, and fewer requests stalled without an owner or decision. Partners know where their requests stand and what happens next.
  • Longer term: Your team makes more decisions independently, and recurring gaps have enduring owners. Delivery owners meet agreed commitments more consistently, stakeholders spend less time chasing updates, and the CTO spends less time reconstructing context or coordinating follow-through.

You should get in touch if:

  • You’ve shipped production software as an engineer and expanded into product, consulting, operations, or leadership. You still enjoy digging into unfamiliar systems and use that technical depth to make better decisions.
  • You’re outgoing and gregarious and known to collect allies and partners. You seek people out, listen to operators, and build relationships across teams and levels.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & AEO Manager
jobs.description:
What the Role Is

Babylist is seeking a leader for SEO, AEO, and GEO to guide how expecting and new parents discover us across traditional search and AI-powered platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Claude. As AI changes how parents research products, get advice, and decide what to buy, discoverability is a priority for Babylist. This role will define and execute that strategy end to end including the roadmap and measurement plan.

You will work at the intersection of technical SEO, content strategy, and structured data to make sure Babylist is accurately understood, cited, and recommended wherever parents look for answers. You will partner with the teams across Marketing, Tech, Merchandising and Partnerships to set direction, present to leaders and the executive team, and drive performance.

This is an opportunity for someone who understands where search is heading and wants to build discoverability for one of the most trusted brands in pregnancy and parenting. The role sits in Growth Marketing.

Who You Are

  • You have built and run an AEO program from first principles. You write question-based prompts and define the KPIs (citation share, visibility, share of voice). You pick a tracking tool and can say what is working, what is not, and what to do next.
  • You have deep technical SEO skills on a large, complex site. Rendering and prerendering, crawl behavior, structured data, internal linking, migrations, and recovery from Google algorithm updates. Babylist has XM+ registry URLs and XK guides, so scale problems are the normal case.
  • You measure results beyond clicks. You link AI visibility, citations, and brand search to signups and revenue, and you work with paid search on how to attribute them.
  • You build with AI.You have shipped AI-assisted workflows, programmatic pages, or internal tools that moved rankings or citations. You would rather build a system that compounds than ship one-off pages.
  • Applied AEO or GEO experience, paired with a proven track record owning organic growth results. Experience at a consumer brand, marketplace, or publisher with a large content library is a plus.
  • You set content standards that drive organic traffic. FAQ structure, freshness cadence, and formatting that earns citations, delivered to editors and freelance writers as guidance they can use.
  • You are hands-on. You pull the data, write the brief, and fix the markup yourself.Nice to have: experience driving discovery through Reddit, YouTube, or short-form video, and building partner or sponsored organic programs without hurting editorial trust.
  • You naturally reach for AI in your work — at Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next.
  • You understand agentic commerce, where AI assistants research and buy products for parents. You make sure Babylist’s product data, registry, and shop pages are structured so those agents can read, compare, and recommend them.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Own the organic search roadmap and its KPIs: SEO-driven activated registries against plan, clicks, top-3 rankings, and AEO citation share and visibility.
  • In your first 90 days, review our AEO tracking (two overlapping tools today), pick one, and lock the prompt framework and KPIs for Registry, Health and Shop.
  • Keep Google rankings stable and growing across the top categories of Babylist’s business. That covers the technical backlog, internal linking, and content freshness.
  • Move non-Registry visibility up in the categories where we trail the category leader today, with a thoughtful and actionable roadmap.
  • Build AI-driven systems with the internal AI Enablement team and Engineering. Replace vendor tools where an in-house build does the job, and articulate the tradeoffs.
  • Set the content playbook with Editorial: FAQ structure, update cadence, and what earns citations.
  • Partner with marketing to find new discovery channels like social and Reddit and measure whether they change AI citations and overall discoverability.
  • Co-own brand search strategy and attribution with Paid Search.
  • Publish a monthly and quarterly SEO and AEO reviews for the organization with information on performance vs. plan and key projects.
  • Be the company's source of SEO and AEO guidance across internal communications.
  • Tie organic discoverability to actual business impact including traffic that converts to registry signups and revenue.
  • Implement an agentic commerce roadmap for Babylist.

Why This Role

  • Babylist has the highest citation and visibility scores in its competitive set of registry queries. Holding that position as AI search changes takes a real roadmap, and you will build it.
  • Room to grow in Health. Health is a newer area for Babylist, and there is a real opportunity to expand our reach with strong content and a sharp roadmap.
  • You help define success. You co-build the 2027 goals with leadership and own the measurement behind them.

About Compensation

We use a market-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:

$143,788.00 to $191,730.00

Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.

Who We Are

Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

Our Ways of Working

Babylist is remote-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.

Why You Will Love Working At Babylist

Our Culture

  • We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge
  • We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues
  • We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives
  • AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts

Growth & Development

  • Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
  • We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
  • We're committed to career progression and performance-based advancement

Benefits

  • Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts
  • Generous paid parental leave and PTO
  • Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed
  • Remote work stipend to set up your office
  • Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Babylist. We expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

Connections at Babylist. If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone.

Protect Yourself from Scams. All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non-Babylist email, it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

We’ve built a profitable DTC business with category-leading retention, grown revenue 5x in the last 36 months, and expanded our reach across new channels and markets. With a robust clinical pipeline and continued expansion into new areas of microbiome health, we’re building for scale—with integrity, care, and curiosity.

Our work has been recognized by Fast Company (Most Innovative Companies, Brands That Matter, World Changing Ideas), TIME (Best Inventions), Forbes (America’s Best Startup Employers), and Inc. (Best in Business, Female Founder 100)—a reflection of the science behind our products and the stories we tell to bring them into the world.

We’re a galaxy-class team of researchers, clinicians, designers, engineers, storytellers, and builders—each aligned in our belief in the transformative potential of the microbiome. If you’re a kindred dot-connector looking to shape the future of health, join us.

  • • •

You

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you lead the frontend implementation of Seed's digital experience. You have a deep love for product, a keen eye for design, and the technical depth to turn ambitious designs into fast, accessible, pixel-perfect features on our React/Next.js platform. You work inside a design system owned by a Staff peer and contribute production-ready components back to it. You partner early with Design and Product, own quality on your squad's surfaces, and raise the frontend bar for the engineers around you through code review, pairing, and mentoring.

  • 6+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering.
  • A strong portfolio or GitHub that shows your frontend work and your eye for UI craft.
  • A track record of shipping production frontend features end-to-end, on schedule.
  • Experience working day to day with designers and product managers.

What You'll Do

Build and Ship

  • Lead the frontend implementation of new features, from Figma through production.
  • Translate designs into production-ready code with obsessive attention to spacing, typography, motion, and responsiveness.
  • Own the frontend architecture behind your features: state management, data fetching, rendering performance, and test coverage.
  • Build accessible, performant interfaces that hold up across browsers and devices.
  • Ship safely: feature flags, A/B tests, instrumentation, and clear rollback paths.
  • Partner early with Design and Product to assess feasibility and resolve ambiguity.

Contribute to the Design System

  • Build composable, reusable React components into our shared library, following its architecture, APIs, and documentation standards.
  • Use design tokens and theming consistently so that a component built once is available everywhere.
  • Document what you add via usage guidelines, code examples, and Storybook stories.

Raise the Bar

  • Conduct thoughtful code reviews that hold the squad to a high standard in component design, accessibility, and visual fidelity.
  • Mentor engineers on the team through pairing.
  • Champion consistent use of the shared component library across our web applications.

Skills You Bring

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level React and Next.js (TypeScript required).
  • Strong understanding of design systems, design tokens, and component API design.
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, data fetching, rendering performance (Core Web Vitals), and testing.
  • Comfortable working from Figma designs and specs.
  • Experience with Storybook and at least one of CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, or Tailwind CSS.
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG).

Collaboration

  • Clear communicator; able to articulate design and technical trade-offs to engineering, design, and product partners.
  • Comfortable building within an architecture someone else owns while still bringing an independent point of view.
  • Experience giving and receiving constructive feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience translating motion design concepts into production-ready animations (Framer Motion, GSAP).
  • Experience in high-growth DTC or e-commerce companies, ideally on a headless Shopify stack.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar).
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation methodologies.
  • Background in health, wellness, or science-focused consumer brands.
  • Experience at a consumer brand known for design craft and obsessive attention to detail.

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $160k-$180k + equity + benefits across all US locations (this position is 100% remote-US). Our pay ranges are guided by discipline, level and experience required. Within the range, individual pay may vary based on additional factors, including: your specific location, desired skills/ technical competency, relevant experience and advanced education/ training.

Benefits + Perks:

Health & Wellness: Choose from multiple medical, dental, and vision plans, with generous employer contributions and coverage options to meet your needs. Enjoy access to top-tier virtual care and a complimentary Aaptiv membership for fitness and mental wellness. We also provide an HSA with employer contributions, along with Fullscript discounts for supplements.

Mental Health Support: All employees and eligible dependents receive 12 free therapy sessions per year, plus coaching, meditation, and 24/7 access to Spring Health’s digital tools and care navigation.

Long Term Wealth Planning: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan through Betterment, featuring a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of contributions—fully vested from day one.

Supporting Families: Our Parental Leave Policy includes 18 weeks of fully paid leave, with the flexibility to phase your return. We also offer four weeks of paid transition time at 80% capacity or four days per week.

Time to Recharge: Seed offers 15 vacation days, 7 sick/safe days, 2 personal days, 10 Recharge Days (Summer + Winter), and 15 paid company holidays each year.

Work Flexibly: Thrive in a remote-first culture that prioritizes autonomy and clarity. You’ll also receive a $750 one-time remote work setup stipend and ongoing access to a $450 quarterly wellness and workplace stipends via JOON.

And More: Access pet insurance, life and disability coverage, learning & development, and a vibrant culture rooted in science and impact.

Seed is an equal opportunity employer. For us, diversity isn’t an HR metric—it is the result of billions of years of evolution; it’s our nature. To serve our community inclusively means to cultivate a relative abundance of perspectives, backgrounds, geographies, and experiences. Like in biology, each role and its function is key to the productivity, sustainability, and resilience of our ecosystem.

Seed Health does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or any employee of the Seed team. Seed Health is committed to a safe, transparent, and integrity-driven hiring process. As recruitment scams continue to evolve, we encourage all candidates to stay vigilant and keep the following in mind:

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Responsibilities

Peraton is looking for an Incident Manager to join our Team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with excellent time management and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. These qualities are essential to successfully managing and resolving high-priority incidents in a fast-paced environment.

Work Location: This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am – 5pm EST

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
  • Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.
  • Facilitate the global response and coordination of major incidents affecting mission-critical business applications and infrastructure services in a 24/7/365 environment.
  • Lead major incident communications by providing timely, accurate, and consistent updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership throughout the incident life-cycle.
  • Review and validate major incident notifications to ensure communications are complete, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.
  • Leverage incident and problem management tools to track incidents, maintain detailed incident logs, document resolutions, and prepare reports for management review.
  • Apply technical knowledge across infrastructure, applications, security, and performance management to support incident investigation and resolution.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, Service Desk personnel, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and drive incidents toward resolution.
  • Identify recurring incidents and potential trends, partnering with Problem Management teams to support root cause analysis and prevent future disruptions.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Incident Management life-cycle, including incident response procedures, escalation processes, and post-incident reviews.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operational procedures, and process guidelines for the Incident Management team.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to support critical incidents, including high-profile business events and time-sensitive operations.
  • Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations while managing competing priorities and coordinating multiple teams during critical incidents.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide incident management support outside of standard business hours, as needed, to ensure 24/7 service coverage.
  • Maintain flexibility in work schedule to support business needs and incident response requirements.

Problem Management

  • Engage with and assist the Problem Management team during Problem Investigations
  • Utilize problem management reports to validate if any open problem known errors when handling high-priority incidents.
  • Proactively and reactively, look for solutions to prevent problems from occurring in team/technology area.

Change Management/Implementation

  • Utilize change management reports during a high-priority incident to validate if incident could be caused by change.
  • Independently review, implement, and verify changes/solutions of high complexity and risk to meet customer and/or trade/IT infrastructure needs.
  • May participate in a Change Advisory Board.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

Teamwork

  • Work as part of a team, which may be virtual, global, and/or multi-functional.
  • Lead teams which address operational processes and policies in work area.
  • Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
  • Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
  • Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in Customer Service, Incident Management, or general project management
  • Familiarity and understanding of IT Service Management tools (Remedy, JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of the technology, applications, and infrastructure within areas of responsibility
  • Ability to effectively coordinate technical teams during incident investigation and resolution
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and coordination throughout the incident management life-cycle
  • Proficiency with MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications:

  • ITIL Foundations Certification
  • One or more of the following Incident Response related certifications: Threat Handling Foundations certificate, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA), OffSec Incident Responder (OSIR), or Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)

Target Salary Range

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in the US and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

jobs.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Quality Assurance Project Manager (QA PM). The Quality Assurance Project Manager (QA PM) is responsible for the full lifecycle supervision, coordination, and management of the BASIS Quality Assurance team. The QA PM leads all QA activities in strict compliance with DoDI 5000-87 and DevSecOps principles, encompassing functional and automated software testing, Section 508 accessibility compliance, weekend/scheduled maintenance window testing, and test case automation strategy. The QA PM serves as the primary interface between the QA team and Government stakeholders on all quality, compliance, and testing matters.

This position is 100% Remote.

1. QA Team Supervision & Management

  • Supervise, coordinate, and direct daily activities of the QA team, including testers, automation engineers, and Section 508 accessibility specialists
  • Assign QA testers to projects to manage workload across Agile sprint cycles, ensuring QA activities align with the DevSecOps pipeline and release schedules
  • Conduct performance evaluations, provide mentorship, and identify training needs for QA team personnel
  • Establish and enforce QA standards, workflows, and documentation practices consistent with program requirements and Government-approved methodologies
  • Facilitate QA team participation in sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
  • Maintain QA staffing levels and report personnel gaps or risks to the Program Manager

2. Software Functional Testing

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive functional testing strategy in alignment with DevSecOps principles
  • Develop standard procedures and oversee compliance for the following testing types performed by the QA team:
    • Integration and End-to-End Testing
    • QA Testing —
    • Verification & Validation (V&V) Testing
    • ProdSim / Stress Testing
    • Disaster Recovery Testing
  • Manage and deliver testing reports for each software package documenting the outcome of each test case and confirming full use case/requirements coverage
  • Measure, track, and report code coverage metrics for all developed code on a per-release basis

3. Section 508 Accessibility Compliance

  • Lead all Section 508 (29 U.S.C. §794d) accessibility testing activities in conformance with WCAG 2.0 Level AA and 36 C.F.R. Part 1194
  • Manage the QA team's execution of the following five compliance tasks:
  • Conduct Accessibility Testing — Ensure all deliverables are tested against Section 508 technical standards and functional performance criteria at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle
  • Correct Non-Conformance — Ensure all identified accessibility deficiencies are corrected prior to final delivery
  • Prepare Compliance Documentation — Track delivery of a completed Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT), test results report, and remediation report for each ICT deliverable
  • Generate Compliance Reports — Deliver monthly status reports detailing Section 508 compliance activities and the conformance status of all active projects
  • Produce Accessible User Documentation — Ensure all user manuals, training materials, and supporting documentation are delivered in 508-compliant format
  • Interface with Government representatives during Government-led 508 acceptance testing; coordinate timely remediation of any non-conforming deliverables
  • Maintain a 508 compliance tracking log and report compliance posture in the Monthly Status Report (MSR)

4. Weekend & Scheduled Maintenance Window Testing

  • Plan, coordinate, and supervise all QA activities conducted during scheduled maintenance windows and weekend operations
  • Manage QA team activities within the authorized production maintenance window (Saturday 9:00 p.m. – Sunday 6:00 a.m. EST), ensuring all maintenance and testing activities are completed within the approved window
  • Oversee daily monitoring activities, ensuring monitoring is performed at the start of each workday and prior to each weekend maintenance window to confirm environment stability
  • Coordinate UAT/Pre-UAT environment availability during Saturday hours (8:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. EST); ensure incident management processes are executed for any unscheduled outages during these hours
  • Submit notification reports to the Government for any extended or unplanned maintenance outages impacting Production availability
  • Manage QA resource scheduling to ensure adequate coverage during weekend testing windows without exceeding authorized maintenance hours

Environment Availability Standards Managed by the QA PM:

EnvironmentWeekday AvailabilitySaturday AvailabilitySundayProduction24×724×7 (maint. starts 9:00 p.m.)Maint. ends 6:00 a.m.; 24×7 afterUAT / Pre-UAT8:00 a.m. – 9:30 p.m. EST8:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. ESTNot required

5. Test Case Automation

  • Champion an "Automation First" culture across the QA team
  • Ensure all application testing is automated using Government-provided or Government-approved technologies, tools, and frameworks
  • Manage and enforce the following automation requirements:
    • Automated test cases must be executable by the end of each Agile sprint
    • Automated tests must be incorporated into the DevSecOps pipeline prior to any release authorization
    • Test-Driven Development (TDD) is performed for all functional capabilities
    • Legacy test cases are automated per the Government-approved schedule to improve regression coverage
  • Oversee delivery of the Automation Assessment Report (current state + completion estimate) and the Automation Project Plan for all non-automated backlog test cases
  • Manage any exception requests for non-automatable test cases, ensuring written justification reports are prepared and submitted to the Government; track Government disposition of all exception requests
  • Ensure continuous addition of all new sprint functionality into the automated testing suite across all option periods

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 6 years of experience, may have lead experience
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Able to obtain Public Trust clearance
  • Experience with QA testing environment
  • Experience with DevSecOps principles
  • Experience with creating test reports
  • Experience with Maintain a 508 compliance tracking log

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Certified Software Test Manager (CSTM) or equivalent QA certification
  • Experience with TRICARE, DMDC, or Defense Health Agency (DHA) systems
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
  • Experience with Test Case Management Systems (TCMS) used in a Government DevSecOps pipeline

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

You start the day with a new batch of content from Foundr's podcast, social media, or upcoming campaigns.

You might be creating Instagram carousels, podcast promotional graphics, YouTube thumbnails, email banners, or landing page visuals. Each design has a purpose: capture attention, communicate a message, and strengthen the brand.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Description

Orchid Security is the Identity Infrastructure Control Plane - the independent layer that connects what enterprises already own across IAM, PAM, IGA, and SaaS systems. We help security teams see inside applications, govern what actually happens at execution time, and close the gap between identity intent and identity reality.

We’re a 70-person seed-stage company moving fast in a $23B market. Our customers include Fortune 500 banks, global retailers, and complex enterprises where identity security is mission-critical.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Growth Marketing to own and scale the engine that turns market awareness into pipeline. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for a versatile B2B marketer who has built and run demand generation programs end to end, from intent signals to closed pipeline.

You’ll lead our demand generation, growth hacking, inbound marketing, SEO/SEM, social media, and marketing automation functions, building the infrastructure and programs that generate qualified pipeline at scale. This role reports directly to the VP Marketing.

You move fast, make data-driven decisions, and know how to build scalable programs.

In this role, success looks like: pipeline from marketing that is predictable, measurable, and growing quarter over quarter. Every campaign launches with proper tracking and attribution. SEO and inbound channels become compounding sources of qualified demand.

What You’ll Own

  • Own demand generation end to end: strategy, execution, and optimization across inbound and outbound programs that drive measurable pipeline contribution
  • Build and scale growth marketing initiatives: identify and exploit high-leverage channels, test aggressively, and double down on what works
  • Lead SEO and SEM strategy: own organic search performance and paid search programs, from keyword strategy to landing page optimization to ROI reporting
  • Drive inbound marketing: develop content-led demand programs including gated assets, webinars, and nurture sequences that capture and convert buyer intent
  • Own social media and community presence: build Orchid’s organic reach across LinkedIn and relevant security communities, turning followers into engaged prospects
  • Run marketing automation: design, implement, and optimize automated workflows, lead scoring, and nurture programs in HubSpot that accelerate leads through the funnel
  • Collaborate with Marketing Operations on attribution, funnel reporting, and pipeline dashboards so you always know what’s working and why
  • Partner with Product Marketing on campaign messaging and ensure story consistency across every channel and touchpoint

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience with at least 3 to 4 years in demand generation, growth marketing, or a directly comparable role, ideally in cybersecurity, identity, or technical SaaS
  • Proven track record of building scalable demand gen programs that drive measurable pipeline. You can show the numbers
  • Deep hands-on expertise across the growth marketing stack: SEO/SEM, paid social, email nurture, marketing automation, and inbound content programs
  • HubSpot power user: you’ve built complex workflows, lead scoring models, and nurture programs from scratch
  • Strong analytical instincts. You live in dashboards, know your funnel metrics cold, and can quickly diagnose what’s leaking
  • Growth hacker mindset: you run structured experiments, kill what doesn’t work, and scale what does
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs across marketing, sales, and product in a fast-moving startup
  • Comfortable with the enterprise B2B buyer journey. You understand long cycles, multi-stakeholder deals, and how to stay relevant across them

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing identity security, IAM, PAM, IGA, or adjacent enterprise security products
  • Background at an early-stage startup where you built the demand gen function from scratch
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) and intent data tools (ZoomInfo, 6sense, Bombora)
  • Experience hiring and managing a small growth marketing team

Why Orchid

  • Build the growth engine from scratch. This is a rare opportunity to own the demand function at a company with real enterprise traction
  • Your work directly impacts pipeline and revenue in a lean team where everyone’s contribution is visible
  • Early stage with enterprise proof: customers like Costco, Fortune 50 banks, and global insurance firms
  • A differentiated technical story worth telling, not another recycled cybersecurity positioning exercise
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a team that takes great work seriously

jobs.description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
