jobs.title: AI Engineer - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.description:
Ever wondered how it would be to revolutionise one of the least digitised industries in the market, alongside a growing and switched-on team? Read on!

___________________________________________________________________________________

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest – 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time – kind of like office 365 but for construction management. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech and watch this video about what we are doing)

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and mission).

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life:

- Connects us with meaningful relationships

- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans

- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions: 

1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation

2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

Laminar Projects is proud to be recognized as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Construction, Engineering & Property™ for 2024! Join a team where learning, collaboration, and growth are at the core of everything we do, and where solving big challenges is part of the fun.

___________________________________________________________________________________

The Role

Purpose of the role

We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines deep knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong software engineering skills and a pragmatic approach to product development. This person will help us design, build and deploy AI-powered features across Shape App and Channels, working closely with the Product and SRE Teams to define optimal solutions and ensure they run reliably in production.

You should be excited by the challenge of turning AI potential into real, useful features, for construction teams, and you should know when a small, lean approach is better than a large, complex one.

Team

You will join a team of product-minded software engineers, designers, and strategists focused on improving the way construction projects are delivered. You will work closely with Product Managers to shape AI features, and with our SRE Team to ensure production-readiness. You will be the go-to expert on AI/LLMs and play a key role in shaping our AI capability.

Your top 3 objectives

1. Design Lean, Fit-for-Purpose AI Solutions: Choose and implement the most appropriate AI/LLM approach for each use case, balancing quality, performance and cost.

2. Integrate AI-features into our Applications: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

3. Prepare for Production: Work with SREs to ensure AI features are reliable, scalable, observable, and secure in production.

Your top 5 responsibilities

1. Understand the Product Context: Work with product teams to translate user needs into clear AI opportunities and technical requirements.

2. Own the AI Feature Lifecycle: From exploration and prototyping to production deployment and iteration, using prompt engineering, model selection, fine-tuning and evaluation.

3. Build AI-Backed Features: Contribute production-grade code that integrates AI capabilities into our apps, working alongside other engineers.

4. Guide Production Set-Up: Collaborate with SREs to define what infrastructure, observability, and scaling is required for each AI feature.

5. Stay Pragmatic and Up-to-Date: Continuously explore new development in LLMs and generative AI but always apply them with a product-first mindset.

Your Capabilities

You are a software engineer who understands how to use LLMs effectively, not just how to train them. You work well with ambiguity and know how to test your ideas quickly. You're comfortable collaborating with product teams and setting up production-grade systems.

As a candidate, you should have:

- Strong experience in applying LLMs and generative AI to real-world problems.

- Solid foundation in Phyton and ML frameworks (e.g. LangChain, Transformers, OpenAI APIs, etc.).

- Experience with multi-model evaluation and feedback loops.

- Production experience with embeddings, vector dabatases (like Pinecone, Weaviate or FAISS), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.

- Familiarity with MLOps tooling and observability for inference pipelines.

- A bias for simplicity, clarity, and iterative delivery.

- The ability to communicate clearly with engineers, designers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining)

- Familiarity with production environments, APIs, and containerised systems (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Participation in AI communities, papers or OSS projects.

Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:

- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge

- You like to be the smartest person in the room

- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback

- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique expertise towards our collective success, so if you don't think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyways!

___________________________________________________________________________________

Salary and Benefits

Standard Stuff

- Competitive salary dependent on location and capability

- Paid Annual Leave (Number of days will depend on where you are based) + statutory Bank Holidays

- In-House Coaching Sessions

- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members.

The Life-Changing Stuff

- 4 Day Weeks: That’s right, 4 day weeks

- Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.

- Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Shape exists

- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Shape. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Shape, development is unbounded

- Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

________________________________________________________________________________________

Application

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

- Why do you want to join us?

- If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.

In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

Compensation

Additional Information

As a Client Partner, you’ll build and nurture high-value client relationships while ensuring the successful delivery of AI data projects. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, connecting client objectives to project execution and coordinating internal teams to deliver strong outcomes.

You’ll also help grow client accounts by identifying new opportunities, expanding project portfolios, and ensuring engagements are delivered profitably.

Your Impact

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for key client stakeholders throughout the engagement.
  • Define project approaches, deliverables, staffing needs, pricing considerations, and success criteria with internal teams.
  • Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and changes throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify opportunities to expand services and renew engagements in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Lead performance and post-project reviews to evaluate business impact and strengthen future engagements.

Success in this role means clients see us as a trusted partner, projects deliver against expectations, and relationships contribute to retention, NPS, and sustainable revenue growth.

What You Bring

  • Experience managing client relationships and projects in a professional AI, LLM, data, or related technology solutions environment.
  • Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience (min 2+ years).
  • Experience managing project scope, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical concepts in AI and data, and proactive about staying current on industry trends.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities and support profitable growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex information clearly.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and evolving client needs.
  • Experience in project management, account growth, or strategic consulting.
  • Comfort working with revenue/margin data and forecasting tools (e.g., Excel, pipeline systems) to produce and maintain accurate forecasts.
  • Willingness to adjust working hours to maintain meaningful overlap with clients and colleagues across regions.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

jobs.description:
About Us

Udacity is now an Accenture company, and exciting things are happening! 🚀 We are on a mission of forging futures in tech through radical talent transformation in digital technologies. We offer a unique and immersive online learning platform, powering corporate technical training in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Autonomous Systems, Cloud Computing and more. Our rapidly growing global organization is revolutionizing how the enterprise market bridges the talent shortage and skills gaps during their digital transformation journey.

Recognized for its innovative impact, Udacity part of Accenture continues to empower people with the skills they need to secure the jobs they want.

Our School of Artificial Intelligence is committed to providing high-quality upskilling opportunities in this rapidly evolving field. We regularly launch new projects and are seeking experienced mentors to join us as external contractors to support our programs and learners.

As new initiatives arise, we will reach out to qualified candidates within this talent pool to provide details on project scope, expected timelines, and compensation. If you are passionate about tackling meaningful challenges and making a difference we invite you to apply and explore this opportunity to collaborate with us.

You’ll be an excellent fit if you have:

  • Proven technical expertise with 5+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning
  • A passion for mentoring and helping others succeed in their learning
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. You enjoy building relationships, communicating effectively, and fostering a positive learning environment
  • A deep understanding of the tech industry and emerging trends in AI and related fields
  • The flexibility to work part-time as an external contractor alongside your current commitments

Mandatory Technical Skills – School of AI

  • Proficiency in Python and API integration
  • Strong understanding of core AI/ML concepts
  • Familiarity with LLMs and Generative AI tools
  • Experience with prompt engineering and model evaluation
  • Working knowledge of ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
  • Exposure to AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)
  • Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector databases
  • Ability to build or support AI-driven applications/workflows
  • Awareness of AI use cases, limitations, and ethics
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Hands-on end-to-end AI/ML or GenAI projects

Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities as a technical mentor will be divided into three major tasks.

  1. 1:1 video calls
  2. Virtual Technical Deep-Dive Sessions
  3. Group Q&A sessions

Personal 1:1 Session:

  • Provide personalized support by addressing learner questions related to course content and projects.
  • Prior to the call mentors are expected to review the students' previous project submission(s) - provided by the Mentor Success Team when available - and/or any specific areas of the Nanodegree content or project that the student has expressed confusion or difficulty with.

Technical Deep-Dive Session:

  • For concept deep-dives, mentors will come prepared with a slide presentation that reviews a Nanodegree concept in more detail, share different use-cases for the concept to broaden student perspectives and understanding, and hold a Q&A session with the learners.
  • For project walkthroughs, a mentor will come prepared with a slide presentation that outlines each element of the rubric to help learners understand expectations and typical problem areas they may encounter. This can include a mentor “grading” a sample submission to demonstrate what mentors are looking for when reviewing projects.

Group Q&A Session:

  • Host regular sessions (via Slack or video) to address learner queries related to projects and coursework. No prior preparation required.

Why should you apply?

  • Make an impact by mentoring and contributing to a vibrant, global learning community
  • Showcase your expertise and gain recognition for your technical knowledge
  • Learn and network with our global community of mentors while staying ahead of the curve on cutting-edge technologies
  • Earn additional income with the flexibility to work on your own schedule

Mentoring at Udacity offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of learners and to contribute to achieving our mission.

If you're passionate about learning, technology and want to make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply to become a mentor at Udacity part of Accenture.

Let's work together to shape the future of tech education!

jobs.title: Data Engineer - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

About the role

Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform.

We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly.

The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job.

Why this role, specifically

Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled.

You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems
  • Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust
  • Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape
  • Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks
  • Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews
  • Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own

What you bring

  • Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some
  • Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent
  • Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework
  • A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar
  • Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent)
  • Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves
  • A testing instinct for data, not only for code

Nice to have

  • Change-data-capture
  • SQL Server sources
  • Healthcare or another regulated data environment
  • Exposure to a BI or semantic layer

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $115,000–$140,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London / UK Remote | 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits ✨

⭐ Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ Product Designers, User Researchers, and Brand Designers led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. There’s significant opportunity to shape the product, influence the organisation, and leave a lasting mark on millions of customers.

🔎 About the role

We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead design across Payments, one of Monzo’s most important and fast-evolving multi-market business areas.

You’ll partner closely with senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape strategy, set direction, and drive exceptional execution across your area. You’ll play a key role in influencing the direction of both the product and the broader customer experience.

You’ll lead and grow a team of Product Designers, helping them do the best work of their careers while strengthening design thinking, collaboration, and craft across Monzo. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.
  • Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.
  • Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.
  • Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.
  • Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.
  • Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...

  • You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
  • You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.
  • You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.
  • You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.
  • You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.
  • You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.
  • You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design.

  • 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits
  • ✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK
  • ✅ We can sponsor your visa

jobs.title: Data Director, EU
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available

About our Data Discipline

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:

  • You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
  • You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:

  • You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
  • Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:

  • You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
  • You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:

  • You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
  • You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior PM/Principal PM - Host team

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization.

The Role

The Senior Product Manager (level flexible) in this role will own the host (supply) side of our marketplace - everything that helps hosts list, get activated, and run a thriving business on Peerspace. It's a wide-ranging remit spanning host onboarding and activation, listing quality, and the host tools that power day-to-day management (messaging, availability, scheduling).

We're looking for someone who has lived and breathed two-sided marketplaces and knows that great supply is what makes them work. You'll get to know our hosts firsthand - their businesses, their workflows, and what's frustrating them - then turn those pain points into solutions that keep them transacting on the platform.

As we expand the services and tools we offer hosts, you'll shape the long-term strategy for host success and, just as importantly, drive the execution that turns it into shipped, measurable impact. Our team is small but mighty - so you'll be able to make a ton of impact quickly, and help chart the future direction of the company.

What you'll do

  • Get close to our hosts: talk with them regularly, spend time in the data and in CX conversations, and build a deep understanding of their pain points, how our marketplace works today, competitors and market trends.

  • Translate what you learn into creative, well-scoped solutions - balancing host needs with guest experience and overall marketplace health.

  • Proactively engage the right stakeholders - including host-facing teams like CX and Supply Operations - to inform decisions and keep them aligned throughout development, not just at launch.

  • Own business outcomes end-to-end: define the metrics that matter, instrument them, and be accountable for moving them - not just for shipping features.

  • Present multiple options with a clear recommendation, hold your own with executives, and engage in constructive disagreement when it serves the customer and the business.

  • Drive execution and ensure your cross-functional teams deliver customer value and desired business outcomes effectively.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in a two-sided marketplace, ideally focused on the supply side. You understand marketplace dynamics and have shipped products that moved them.

  • Deeply customer-obsessed: you seek out conversations with users, get energized by understanding them, and have a track record of turning those insights into products they love.

  • Creative and entrepreneurial problem solver who can go from high-level opportunity to detailed plan to successful execution. You are great at energizing teams, building product roadmaps and collaborating with engineering, design, marketing and operations to make it happen.

  • Track record of owning measurable business outcomes - able to articulate the “so what” behind past launches and the impact they drove, not just the features shipped.

  • Confident presenting multiple options with a clear point of view, influencing executives and cross-functional partners, and giving and receiving direct feedback.

  • Inclusive, open-minded, self-aware and eager to continuously learn. You have a passion for product and are genuinely excited about Peerspace's mission.

Working At Peerspace

The annual salary range for this role is $155,000-$170,000 . The actual salary amount will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data.

Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including:

● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. All legitimate communication from Peerspace will come from an official @peerspace.com email address. We do not contact candidates through personal email accounts, third-party messaging apps such as WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams, or through the Peerspace platform's internal messaging system. All interviews are conducted only by phone or Zoom, and we will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information such as your Social Security number or bank details during the early stages of the hiring process. If you receive any message that seems suspicious or does not align with these practices, please contact us immediately at help@peerspace.com so we can investigate. We only post our job openings and process applications, through our official careers page at https://jobs.lever.co/peerspace.

jobs.title: Customer & Field Marketing Manager - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Opportunity

You own two things that are easy to under-invest in and expensive to ignore: the customers we already have, and the rooms where buyers gather. You run customer and expansion marketing in partnership with Customer Success, and you execute the field and event motion that the segment owners scope.

You also own the proof. References, case studies, and advocates are how we win deals and how an acquirer values us. That program is yours to build.

What You’ll Own

Sales enablement

  • Build custom sales decks and assets for client engagements, with a focus on enterprise deals.
  • Run broader enablement: operationalize the master pitch and battlecards PMM owns, onboard reps to the materials, and keep deal assets current.
  • Be the bridge between marketing’s narrative and what reps actually present in the room.

Field and event execution

  • Execute the events the segment owners scope and recommend: booth, on-site meetings, and follow-through.
  • Own on-site ROI and the pre- and post-event motion with sales and CS.

References, case studies, and advocacy

  • Own the reference and advocacy program; recruit advocates and turn outcomes into proof.
  • Partner with Content to produce and PMM for the outcome data.

Field enablement

  • Own field and event enablement materials in partnership with PMM’s core positioning.

What You Don’t Own

  • New-logo demand creation — the segment owners.
  • Which events we attend (the thesis) — segment owners decide; you execute.
  • Core positioning and battlecards — PMM.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Expansion pipeline influenced. Customer and expansion pipeline, with Customer Success.
  • Net revenue retention contribution. Marketing’s influence on retention and expansion.
  • Event execution ROI. Pipeline and qualified meetings per event, on budget.
  • Proof produced. References and case studies created — exit-critical.
  • Field contribution to acute pipeline. Field-influenced pipeline supporting the ABM motion.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years in customer marketing, field marketing, or events in B2B SaaS; healthcare IT preferred.
  • A program builder who can run events and customer motions at the same time without dropping either.
  • Comfort partnering closely with Customer Success and Sales.
  • A reference and advocacy track record.
  • An AI-first approach to scaling field and customer content.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% travel

Nice to Have

  • Experience building a customer advocacy or reference program from scratch.
  • Experience supporting diligence with customer proof points.

Why Join PerfectServe?
At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $75,000-$85,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.
The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.
We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Booking Integrations, Contract)
jobs.description:
Aescape is a New York-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes-driven practice.

Powered by real-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. 

Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. 

Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.

Aescape is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Booking Integrations, Contract) who can stand up and ship the services that connect Aescape to third-party booking platforms. jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities.

You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management.

What you'll do

Own our conference program

  • Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth

  • Own the events budget and decide where the money goes

  • Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more

  • Plan side events around conferences, such as happy hours, dinners, and meetups

  • Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities

Run field events with sales

  • Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, and regional events with our account executives

  • Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site

  • Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us

  • Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once

Grow our digital events and partnerships

  • Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up

  • Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space

  • Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team

Work across the team

  • Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events

  • Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content

  • Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up

What we're looking for

  • 3-4+ years in field marketing, events, or marketing programs at a B2B SaaS company

  • Events you've run that created pipeline, and numbers you can share from them

  • Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once

  • You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan

  • You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you

  • You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it

  • Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors

  • Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing to developers, DevOps, platform engineering, or security teams

  • Existing relationships with organizers of developer and security conferences

  • Experience planning custom booths at large conferences

  • Familiarity with open-source communities or developer meetups

  • Hands-on experience with webinar platforms

We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

jobs.title: Pain Consultant (Remote, Ireland)
jobs.description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options. For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short. We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for UK based patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

What you need:

  • Full valid GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Compensation (rate reflects weekly commitment)

    • 8 hours per week (2 sessions): €110 – €120 per hour

    • 28 hours per week (7 sessions): €120 – €150 per hour

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Indemnity coverage: Montu's insurance will cover you for prescribing medical cannabis

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Consultants based in Ireland who hold valid UK GMC Specialist Registration are eligible to prescribe remotely from Ireland for UK patients

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours

    • To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform

    • Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks. If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed. To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Project Manager to oversee the successful delivery of complex, high-risk projects, ranging from single-site to global deployments. You will ensure all projects meet strict time, cost, and quality standards by utilizing industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads planning and delivery of projects to time, cost, and quality measures, taking account of dependencies and resource requirements.
  • Owns, develops, and proactively monitors project plans.
  • Consolidates and documents the fundamental components of projects (scope, schedule, resource requirements, budgets, risks, opportunities, issues, and quality requirements)
  • Tightly controls project scope whilst meeting and managing customers broader expectations within the commercial model
  • Responsible for provision and control of project documentation as a primary reference point for tracking and audit purposes
  • Monitors project budget, forecast and actual costs, providing early warning of any deviation
  • Work with Senior Commercial Accountants to ensure timely Revenue booking, accurate cost forecasting and tracking across the project
  • Develops, implements, and updates project resource allocation plans (RBAs), working with Professional Services to confirm staff availability and scheduling
  • Engages and manages resources from all necessary departments, customer and third parties on a matrix management basis
  • Establishes and maintains governance arrangements for the delivery of projects, defining clear roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities, which align with organisational practice
  • Provides input into project health check reviews as required
  • Works with Delivery Support to suggest improvement areas for the project delivery methodology
  • Identifies, logs and monitors project risks (threats and opportunities), planning and implementing responses to them and responding to other issues that affect projects. Reports and escalates risks as required to appropriate level
  • Produces highlight reports and presentations to internal and external customers on project status to aid successful delivery of project
  • Develops, maintains, and applies quality management processes for project activities and outputs
  • Secures the provision of goods and services needed for projects from internal and/or external providers, monitoring compliance and managing variances
  • Works with Service Transition to ensure the timely transition of project outputs into live services
  • Manages changes to project scope, timeline, budget in a controlled, transparent manner with agreement of customer and relevant stakeholders
  • Able to clearly set direction and align expectations across all stakeholder cohorts.
  • Manages internal and external stakeholders, and taking account of their levels of influence and particular interests

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Minimum of 3 years’ Project Management Experience
  • Proven experience of delivering multiple concurrent & complex projects in a fast-paced MSP environment
  • Knowledge of and experience in delivering Microsoft technologies, solutions and services
  • Knowledge of using techniques for planning, monitoring and governance including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions management
  • A track record of managing delivery of large and complex change programmes/projects
  • Proven ability in stakeholder management including C-level executives

Benefits

  • Remote-first working with flexibility around client needs
  • Projects with global brands & public sector leaders, working on real-world impact.
  • Exclusive access to AWS & Databricks certifications, training, and partner tools.
  • A collaborative culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Competitive salary and long-term growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

Socket is looking for a Sales Engineer to support our enterprise customers. In this role you will be at the nexus between our customers and our engineering, product, and design teams. You'll work cross-functionally in order to provide technical education, guidance, and support in a pre-sales capacity.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discussions and product demonstrations to showcase capabilities; address customer challenges, respond to questions, and handle objections.

  • Craft technical content to guide customers in implementing specific use cases or extending our solution.

  • Collaborate with account teams to understand customer requirements and translate them to Socket capabilities, emphasizing business value.

  • Support Proof of Concepts (POCs) that align with customer requirements; provide technical expertise, troubleshooting, and guidance throughout the evaluation process.

  • Provide guidance on integrating solutions into the customer's existing infrastructure.

  • Distill and communicate customer needs and product feedback to Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success to drive post-sales revenue, ensure retention, and contribute to growth.

  • Execute cross-functional projects involving teams such as Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • 7 plus years of pre-sales experience in a Sales Engineering or Solutions Engineering role.

  • Hands-on experience working with enterprise customers in the security or technical SaaS space.

  • Ability to multitask and efficiently handle multiple competing priorities, delegating when necessary while being highly organized, detail oriented, and demonstrating excellent time management skills.

  • Empathetic mindset for the customer and a commitment to delving deep into the challenges they present or experience.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and contribute directly to Sales, Product and Engineering teams.

  • Ability and desire to learn new tools and technologies.

  • Familiarity with web APIs, SDKs, and other technical frameworks is a plus.

  • Experience with open source, vulnerability management / SCA

  • Must be able to read/write basic scripts in languages Python, JS, or Golang.

  • Knowledge of common source control managers such as gitlab or bitbucket.

Preferred:

  • CS degree or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands on experience working with medium to large customers up to 1000 employees.

  • Relevant security domain experience and familiarity with vulnerability management SCA tools.

  • Experience with AI and Large Language Models (LLM)

Our Interview Process

  1. Phone Screen with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager

  3. Virtual f2f with a few members of the team

  4. Presentation

  5. Final call with our Founder

  6. Debrief

  7. References

  8. Offer

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

Reporting to the Senior Digital Marketing Manager of DDN, this role owns offsite digital channels, including paid search, paid and organic social, engineering and component discovery sites, and eCommerce touchpoints. jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As an Onboarding Coach, we’re looking for someone who truly understands hospitality and can step into our clients’ shoes to demonstrate how our system makes their lives easier. You’ll care for our clients and their properties just as you would for a guest in a hotel—always going the extra mile. In this role, you’ll train clients on the system, tailoring it to fit their needs as a hospitality business. By asking the right questions, you’ll get to know your clients and ensure that, by the end of the onboarding process, they have a complete understanding of and confidence in using the system.

Our Customer Onboarding Team:

As part of our Customer Onboarding Team, you’ll play a vital role in bringing our motto *“more reservations, happier guests” to life. Our team is close-knit and collaborative, living this motto every day by working closely together to provide exceptional support and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for our customers.

If you’re ready to make a difference and be part of an exciting journey, we’d love to have you on board!

jobs.title: Engineering Director, EU
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits

Engineering at Monzo

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

What you’ll work on

  • Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
  • Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
  • Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
  • Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
  • Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
  • Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
  • Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
  • Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

You should apply if

  • You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
  • You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
  • You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
  • You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
  • You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
  • You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
  • You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
  • You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

The interview process

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)
  2. Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we’ll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you’re interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

What’s in it for you

💰Base salary £170k - £225k + Equity + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

⭐ About Data at Monzo

Data is at the heart of how we make decisions and build products at Monzo. Our Data teams bring together Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning, working closely with Product, Engineering and other teams across the business.

Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy.

As a Data Science Manager, you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders.

🔑 You'll play a key role by...

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products.

You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals.
  • Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work.
  • Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction.
  • Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities.
  • Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning.

  • Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work.
