Job Summary

Granicus serves more than 7,000 public-sector agencies and powers approximately 30 billion digital interactions annually. Within the Office of the CTO, we operate an AI-native software development lifecycle: a production engineering model in which autonomous agents perform high-confidence implementation work and senior engineers orchestrate, review, and own the outcome. The model is established and operating; we are scaling it across additional delivery teams.

This role joins one of those teams. Our engineering standards are calibrated to the practices used by leading software and AI organizations — generator-verifier architecture, eval-driven development, staged deployment, and high-volume autonomous pull-request pipelines — operated within a FedRAMP-authorized environment. We are hiring practitioners who will set and uphold these standards, not engineers who simply use AI tooling.

Operating constraints (non-negotiable): agents execute only within branches; all agent-generated code passes senior human review before merging to production; autonomous execution is a force multiplier and does not transfer accountability away from the responsible engineer. Compliance obligations — NIST 800-53 Rev 5, WCAG, SOC 2, and applicable FedRAMP authorizations — are treated as engineering requirements and a source of competitive advantage.

Conventional delivery distributes product management, design, and engineering leadership across separate individuals, introducing coordination overhead at each handoff. In an AI-native lifecycle, where implementation throughput is high, those handoffs become the primary constraint. This role consolidates the product, design, and delivery-leadership disciplines into a single accountable owner who synthesizes them rather than displacing the specialists who practice them. The role translates product intent into shipped, compliant software by directing the agent array and implementing front-end experiences directly. It combines the responsibilities of a staff product engineer, a design engineer, and an engineering manager, and requires demonstrated capability across all three.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Own the product outcome of the team end to end — from problem definition through accepted, in-production software. You hold the roadmap commitment and the quality bar.
  • Direct the agent array across three execution modes — Interactive (real-time pairing with an agent), Supervised (agents propose changes; you review and gate each pull request), and Fully Autonomous (agents execute a scoped workstream end to end; you review the output). You determine the appropriate mode for each workstream based on risk and measured agent reliability.
  • Implement production front-end code from the same repository as the engineering team, under engineering review. You deliver the user experience directly rather than specifying it for others to build.
  • Apply product and design rigor at every stage — discovery, user research, information architecture, interaction design, and prioritization — and ensure that increased build velocity does not compromise upstream rigor.
  • Author the prompts, evaluation criteria, and acceptance criteria that convert product intent into work an agent can execute and a verifier can validate.
  • Enforce the human review gate and accessibility standards in partnership with the lead engineer, ensuring no agent-generated code reaches production without senior human review and that WCAG conformance and compliance requirements are designed in from the outset.
  • Set and maintain the team’s delivery cadence and contribute improvements to the shared operating model that other delivery teams adopt.

  • OWNERSHIP FROM DAY ONE

    • Product outcome and roadmap commitment for one delivery team

    • Deliberate use of the three execution modes per workstream

    • Direct authorship of the team’s production front-end code

    • Acceptance criteria and evaluation suites for all team deliverables

  • SCOPE YOU WILL GROW INTO

    • Refinement of the cross-team product-and-design operating model

    • Higher autonomy ratios supported by measured agent reliability

    • A design system and component library that agents build against by default

    • Mentorship of additional product-and-design engineering leads as the model scales

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Required

  • End-to-end product delivery as a builder. You have owned a product surface end to end — making product decisions, designing the experience, and personally writing front-end code deployed to production users.
  • Production front-end engineering. Proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React (or an equivalent framework), strong CSS, and the ability to move fluently between design files and application code.
  • Design discipline. Demonstrated competence in information architecture, interaction design, and accessibility (WCAG), with the judgment to evaluate experience quality, not only functional completeness.
  • Direction of AI coding agents. Practical experience using coding agents on production work, including a working understanding of their failure modes and the controls required to use them as leverage without compromising quality or review.
  • A track record of defining how teams work. You have established a process, pattern, or standard that other practitioners adopted.
  • High autonomy under ambiguity. You produce structure and direction where none is provided.

Preferred

  • High-assurance or regulated delivery experience. Shipping within FedRAMP, FedRAMP High, defense, financial services, healthcare, or another NIST 800-53 / SOC 2 / HIPAA-bound environment, treating those constraints as design inputs.
  • Public-sector or govtech product experience, including an understanding of constituent- and caseworker-facing use cases.
  • Design-systems ownership. Experience building or maintaining a component library used across multiple teams.
  • Experience operating within an eval-driven or test-first engineering culture at a leading software organization.

Indicators of a strong fit

  • You are effective owning quality for software an agent implemented, and you treat that accountability as central to the role.
  • You can both define the product and implement its interface, and you prefer to do both rather than specialize in one.
  • You hold product positions firmly and revise them quickly in response to evidence.
  • You regard regulatory constraints as design parameters to engineer within, not obstacles to delivery.
  • You want to shape the operating model rather than inherit a fixed process.

Indicators this role is not a fit

  • You require a single, well-bounded discipline — product, or design, or engineering exclusively. This role spans all three.
  • You consider code review outside your responsibility. The review gate is a core part of this role.
  • You are uncomfortable being accountable for output you did not personally author. Autonomy in this model increases ownership, not the reverse.
  • You require fully specified requirements before beginning work. Resolving ambiguity is a central responsibility.
  • You view compliance as overhead to minimize rather than rigor to engineer.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester
jobs.description:
Description

Terra Security provides agentic AI-powered continuous penetration testing aligned to code changes and evolving attack surfaces, combining a swarm of trained AI agents with human supervision for safety and control. Fortune 500 organizations trust Terra to ensure every attack surface is covered across the web, AI, internal apps, APIs, mobile, networks, and the cloud.

Terra is on track to become the next breakout cybersecurity company with $38 million raised to date, including a $30 million Series A led by Felicis Ventures with participation from Dell Technologies Capital, Silicon Valley CISO Investments (SVCI), SYN Ventures, LAMA Partners, Underscore VC, and Capital One Ventures.

Summary

As a Penetration Tester, you will be a founding member of our new European penetration testing team. You will work at the intersection of traditional ethical hacking and cutting-edge AI, providing the "human-in-the-loop" expertise that ensures our autonomous agents remain accurate, creative, and devastatingly effective. This is an opportunity to move beyond standard "checkbox" pentesting and into the future of automated, exploit-driven security.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform deep-dive penetration tests on Web Applications and APIs, identifying complex vulnerabilities that automated tools often miss.
  • Work alongside our AI agent swarm, providing manual verification, oversight, and creative exploitation logic to enhance the platform’s performance.
  • Research and develop new exploitation techniques to keep our platform ahead of emerging threats and unique business logic risks.
  • Translate technical vulnerabilities into clear, high-quality security reports that provide actionable remediation guidance for our customers.
  • Contribute to the methodologies and workflows of our growing European hub, collaborating with global teams to maintain a "best-in-class" testing standard.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience specifically in Web Application and API Penetration Testing.
  • A strong understanding of common attack methodologies, exploitation techniques, and the OWASP Top 10.
  • Proficiency with networking protocols (TCP/HTTP) and a solid grasp of client-side and server-side languages.
  • Practical expertise with Burp Suite, Caido, and other industry-standard security testing utilities.
  • The ability to write clear, professional security reports that balance technical depth with remediation clarity.
  • High-level English proficiency (fluent in reading, writing, and speaking).

﻿Advantage

  • Experience with Python, Go, or Bash to automate repetitive testing tasks.
  • Holdings such as OSCP, OSWA, OSWE, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with testing in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
  • Interest in or experience with using AI/LLMs to enhance security workflows.

Please note that this position is for candidates based in Poland and is offered as an Independent Contractor (B2B) engagement.

About Us

**US Remote opportunity with a strong preference for candidates located in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to support required travel**

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

The Lead Electrical Engineer is responsible for overseeing the creation of technical design solutions and/or studies. The purpose of a Lead Professional Electrical Engineer is to provide technical authority and direction as the Engineer of Record (EOR) for the development of electrical engineering designs, studies and solutions and part of an integrated project team. The role shall also provide technical authority to the discipline for the creation, maintenance and approval of engineering standards, training and mentoring.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible to oversee and direct the electrical engineering of projects in accordance with engineering best practices, company standards and in compliance with the National Electrical Code.
  • Assist the Project Manager in establishing and preparing project budgets, project execution plans, construction cost estimates and project schedules.
  • Execute the electrical engineering aspects of a project within the budget, schedule and quality as agreed with the Project Manager.
  • Prepare engineering documents in the form of study reports, drawings and specifications that maybe stamped and signed, as required.
  • Prepare Addendums, Proposal Requests (PR) and Supplemental Instructions (SI) for projects.
  • Provide mentoring and technical direction to Electrical Engineers, Designers and BIM/CAD Technicians.
  • Attend meetings with clients and prepare meeting notes as appropriate.
  • Coordinate communications in relation to electrical engineering with project team members, clients and the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ).
  • Coordinate design solutions with other technical disciplines within the integrated project team.
  • Assist in quality assurance reviews for all project disciplines.
  • Attend site visits for the purposes of investigation, survey and record of existing conditions.
  • Develop, maintain and approve electrical engineering design standards, tools, process and procedures.
  • Provide the focal point and technical leadership for all electrical engineers and designers within the organization.
  • Provide mentoring and career development support to electrical engineers and designers within the organization.
  • Uphold and promote the Company brand by guaranteeing excellence in the execution of work and ensuring a positive client experience.
  • Any other duties as assigned by Company Leadership.

Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • Required to have a Baccalaureate Degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering.
  • Required to have a Professional Engineering (PE) license.
  • Ten years' experience post PE license award.
  • Required experience with the design of large commercial projects.
  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Ability to lead a team for the execution of complex electrical engineering design projects.
  • Required experience with the design of Healthcare projects.
  • Required experience with the design of Higher Education projects.
  • Required experience with the design of Central Energy Plant (CEP) electrical infrastructure projects.
  • Required experience in the design of medium voltage protection and power distribution systems.
  • Required experience in the design of paralleled generator systems at medium voltage and below.
  • Strong written and oral communication as well as presentation skills.
  • Clean Driving Record.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Detail oriented and willing to tackle various ongoing projects in a fast paced environment.
  • Well versed in the industry and the Company's competitors.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, with the ability to perform duties outside of scope of work when necessary.

Travel Requirements

  • 20-25% of time will be spent traveling to job site(s)/office location.

Physical/Work Environment Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Climbing stairs.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often kneeling, standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
  • Quiet environment.
  • Light work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 20 pounds.

Pay Range

USD $136,455.00 - USD $175,590.00 /Yr.

C1 Company Overview

C1: 1 Contact, 1 Connection, 1 Choice

C1 is the foremost, single-source provider of advanced communications and data technology for business. That means if it's digital, we connect our customers to it -- from phone systems and hardware to computer networks, application development, managed solutions and more. And we're 100% passionate with designing, implementing, managing and supporting our customers' every need from end to end, so that they can focus on what they do best.

So, when it comes to joining a team of IT and communications technology pros who are empowered to do what they do best, your best choice -- your #1 choice -- is C1.

Overview

Summary

The Senior Solutions Architect is a highly motivated, skilled resource who embraces an entrepreneur approach with a strong work ethic. This position primarily focuses on consulting with C1’s Enterprise Customers to develop solid strategies with Outcome Based solutions that deliver measurable results thru ROI and TCO models. The position is responsible for assessing customer needs and tailoring customized architectures that have strategic value and are complex in nature to fit business needs. The Senior Solutions Architect is well versed in all market offerings in their area of expertise and works closely with the account team to ensure full accuracy of the architecture and the value proposition. Additionally, this position is able to explain, position and justify costs related to C1’s solutions.

Ideal candidate will be located in Kansas City, MO, Colorado, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachussetts, or Indiana.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Serves as a technical subject matter expert for Data Center infrastructure, with primary focus on compute, storage, virtualization, data center networking, backup, disaster recovery, hybrid cloud, converged infrastructure, and hyperconverged infrastructure solutions.
  • Acts as a trusted technical advisor throughout the pre-sales lifecycle, including discovery, qualification, solution positioning, architecture development, customer presentations, and RFI/RFP support across commercial and public sector opportunities.
  • Leads customer discovery sessions to understand business goals, technical requirements, current-state environments, operational challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Designs and positions data center architectures aligned to customer requirements, C1 capabilities, manufacturer technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Provides pre-sales technical consulting for data center modernization, compute refresh, virtualization, storage transformation, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, hybrid cloud, and infrastructure lifecycle planning opportunities.
  • Develops solution architectures, diagrams, bills of material, technical recommendations, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and migration considerations.
  • Collaborates with specialists across enterprise networking, security, cloud, collaboration, customer experience, managed services, and professional services to develop complete customer solutions.
  • Supports solution assurance, delivery readiness, and services handoff activities to help ensure proposed architectures can be implemented successfully.
  • Maintains technical competency in data center and related infrastructure technologies.

Qualifications

Qualifications

jobs.description:
C1 Company Overview

C1: 1 Contact, 1 Connection, 1 Choice

C1 is the foremost, single-source provider of advanced communications and data technology for business. That means if it's digital, we connect our customers to it -- from phone systems and hardware to computer networks, application development, managed solutions and more. And we're 100% passionate with designing, implementing, managing and supporting our customers' every need from end to end, so that they can focus on what they do best.

So, when it comes to joining a team of IT and communications technology pros who are empowered to do what they do best, your best choice -- your #1 choice -- is C1.

Overview

Summary The Alliances Leader is responsible for leading C1's strategic relationships with Strategic partners and driving measurable business growth. This leader will own the development and execution of the joint business strategy, including executive relationships, revenue and pipeline growth, go-to-market execution, partner investment, sales alignment, enablement, and integration of partner capabilities into C1's portfolio of solutions, professional services, and managed services. The position requires a highly collaborative and commercially oriented leader who can operate across C1 Sales, Capabilities, Solutions Architecture, Services, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership while building strong relationships throughout the partner organizations.

Candidates are to bring deep experience and established relationships with leading customer experience and unified communication partners, such as Zoom and Genesys. Expertise across these partners is preferred. The successful candidate will be expected to develop strong strategic leadership across both partnerships.

Lumanity is dedicated to improving patient health by accelerating and optimizing access to medical advances. We partner with life sciences companies around the world to generate evidence to demonstrate the value of their product, translate the science and data into compelling product narratives, and enable commercial decisions that position these products for success in the market. • Regular contact and meetings with clients to maintain/grow current relationships.

jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - US Cold Calling
jobs.description:
About the role

Division 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients — companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings. As a US Cold Calling SDR, you sit on the phones every day calling into the US market on behalf of those clients. You learn each client's product, ideal customer, and pitch, then dial their target accounts, get past the brush-off, and book qualified meetings their closers actually show up for.

This is a phone-first role. You are not selling Division 50's own services — you represent our clients. The work changes as our client roster changes, so you ramp fast on new products and industries and keep your numbers steady through the switch. This is fully remote, working US business hours.

What you'll do

  • Make high-volume cold calls into the US market on behalf of Division 50 clients across different industries (B2B SaaS, professional services, home services, healthcare, finance, and more)
  • Learn each client's offer, ideal customer profile, and objection patterns quickly, and adapt your pitch to whoever you're calling that week
  • Open cold calls that start with a brush-off, hold the line, and turn them into booked, qualified meetings
  • Qualify prospects against each client's criteria before you book, so the meetings that land on a closer's calendar are real
  • Log every dial, conversation, and booked meeting in the CRM so the client and your manager can see the activity
  • Follow up on warm inbound leads for clients who run them — qualify, and book the meeting (this is a plus, not the core of the job)
  • Hit daily dial and weekly meeting-booked targets, and keep them steady even when you switch to a new client or industry

What we're looking for

  • Proven cold-calling experience dialing into the US market — you've spent your day on outbound phones and have the call volume to show for it
  • A track record of booking qualified B2B meetings from cold dials, with real numbers (dials per day, meetings per week)
  • You ramp fast on a new product or industry and can sound credible on the phone after a short briefing
  • You handle the early brush-off — "not interested," "send me an email," "we're all set" — and keep the conversation alive
  • Clear, confident spoken English and a natural phone manner US prospects respond to
  • Disciplined with CRM hygiene and daily activity targets
  • Comfortable with a smaller base + high uncapped commission tied to booked meetings

Nice to have

  • Experience qualifying warm inbound leads as well as cold outbound
  • Time spent in an agency, BPO, or outsourced-SDR setting where you carried multiple client accounts at once
  • Familiarity with dialers, sales engagement tools, and CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar)
  • Experience calling into more than one industry or buyer type

About us & how to apply

Division 50 is a B2B lead generation and marketing agency. We run appointment-setting and outbound SDR programs for clients across many industries, alongside paid ads, SEO, and social media management. This SDR role sits inside our client-fulfillment team — the people who actually pick up the phone and book the meetings our clients pay us for.

To apply, complete the short application and screening questions. Strong applicants move to a conversation with Raffi, our AI recruiter, where we'll go deep on your cold-calling background. We hire for outbound skill and consistency, not industry pedigree.

Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. You'll analyze a broad set of home and homeowner information to assess the risk profile of each application and make investment eligibility recommendations against the standards in our underwriting guidelines. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company’s growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. The Lead IR Analyst is a pivotal leader within DeepSeas’ cybersecurity operations. This role not only ensures the rapid detection, analysis, and resolution of security incidents, but also drives cross-functional coordination and continuous improvement. Responsibilities include triaging alerts, conducting forensic investigations, and implementing corrective actions to mitigate threats. The Lead IR Analyst elevates the function by leading strategic initiatives, mentoring junior team members, and shaping the development of incident response tools and playbooks, ensuring the organization remains resilient and proactive in the face of evolving cyber threats.

 

Key Responsibilities

The following are the major results needed for success in the role. Additional responsibilities, tasks, and duties will be assigned and required as needed.

  • Lead the IR Analyst team.
  • Serve as the point of contact and escalation point for all IR incidents.
  • Perform deep-dive and forensic analysis of logs, systems, and network traffic.
  • Document and lead incidents from detection through resolution.
  • Work with partners to ensure compliance and that proper processes are in place.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and procedures.
  • Lead investigations of complex security incidents and coordinate response efforts.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports and executive summaries.
  • Provide accurate, punctual reports as required or assigned.
  • Initiate communication and information sharing with internal team members, team leaders, and inter-company departments.
  • Open to candidates in the US and Costa Rica. 
  • Travel up to 5% of the time as required.

 

Experience, Education, and Skills Required

Below are the minimum skills, formalized training, practical experience, and/or education required to perform the general functions and duties of the role.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in incident response, security operations, or threat detection.
  • Experience with forensic analysis, malware investigation, and threat intelligence gathering.
  • Strong knowledge of SIEM tools, EDR, and forensic techniques.
  • Familiarity with malware analysis, log analysis, and network traffic inspection.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple incidents simultaneously.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Must be able to understand job duties and responsibilities, have the necessary skills and knowledge, and be willing and able to continue learning and growing within the field.
  • If a US candidate, must be a U.S. citizen residing in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CompTIA Security+.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation.

 

Information Security Responsibility

Information security is everyone’s responsibility:

  • Understanding and following DeepSeas’ information security policies and procedures.
  • Remaining vigilant and reporting any suspicious activity or possible weaknesses in DeepSeas’ information security.
  • Actively participating in DeepSeas’ efforts to maintain and improve information security.

 

Why DeepSeas?

  • Fully remote company with team members across the U.S.
  • Hands-on, mission-driven work protecting clients against real-world threats every day.
  • A collaborative team that shares knowledge and invests in your growth.
  • Opportunities to lead, mentor, and shape how our SOC responds to incidents.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, dental, vision, PTO, Sick Leave, Personal Choice Holidays, Life/Accident Insurance, 401(k) match, and Company Bonus.

jobs.title: Mortgage Servicing Analyst
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://www.elendtpo.com

🏡 About Us

At eLEND, we are committed to delivering an exceptional mortgage experience through innovation, technology, operational excellence, and client-focused partnership. Our Mortgage Servicing team plays a critical role in maintaining accurate loan records, supporting borrowers, managing servicing activities, and ensuring operational consistency throughout the servicing lifecycle.

The Mortgage Servicing Analyst is responsible for executing daily servicing activities, including loan boarding, servicing data maintenance, reconciliations, borrower inquiries, servicing transfers, operational reporting, and exception resolution.

This position works closely with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, internal departments, and third-party servicing partners to maintain accurate portfolio information, support regulatory compliance, and ensure servicing activities are completed efficiently and within established procedures.

✨ Why This Role Matters

As a Mortgage Servicing Analyst, you will help maintain the accuracy, integrity, and operational efficiency of eLEND's mortgage servicing portfolio.

While the AVP establishes priorities and monitors overall servicing performance, you will execute the core activities that keep our servicing operations running smoothly.

From boarding new loans and maintaining servicing platform data to researching borrower inquiries, reconciling accounts, and supporting servicing transfers, your work directly contributes to accurate records, timely borrower support, and operational consistency.

Success means maintaining reliable servicing data, resolving routine operational issues, meeting established deadlines, and supporting a compliant and efficient servicing environment.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities

🏡 New Loan Boarding & Data Validation

  • Execute new loan boarding activities within the servicing platform and interim servicing environment.

  • Validate loan boarding information against origination records to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Identify, research, and resolve loan boarding discrepancies and exceptions.

  • Maintain accurate loan-level information throughout the boarding process.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to address outstanding boarding requirements.

  • Escalate complex boarding issues or recurring discrepancies to senior servicing staff.

💻 Servicing Platform & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate servicing information within the Origination Platform, servicing systems, and interim servicing data feeds.

  • Review and update loan-level data to support accurate servicing records and portfolio reporting.

  • Monitor data consistency across origination and servicing environments.

  • Research discrepancies between servicing platforms and supporting documentation.

  • Complete assigned data maintenance activities within established procedures.

  • Support accurate portfolio analysis through timely and reliable servicing information.

📊 Accounting Reconciliations & Financial Accuracy

  • Research and clear routine corporate accounting reconciliation items related to mortgage servicing.

  • Review servicing invoices, escrow accounting records, and purchase advice discrepancies.

  • Identify and document reconciliation differences and supporting findings.

  • Coordinate with Finance and servicing partners to resolve routine discrepancies.

  • Escalate complex, unresolved, or aged reconciliation items to senior servicing staff.

  • Maintain organized documentation supporting reconciliation activities and resolutions.

🔄 Servicing Transfers & Portfolio Transitions

  • Support the preparation and execution of mortgage servicing transfers.

  • Prepare loan-level data files, borrower notices, transfer checklists, and supporting documentation.

  • Validate servicing transfer information for completeness and accuracy.

  • Complete assigned transfer responsibilities within established timelines.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to address transfer-related requirements.

  • Research and resolve routine servicing transfer exceptions.

  • Maintain accurate records supporting transfer activities and operational readiness.

📈 Servicing Reporting & Portfolio Analytics

  • Generate recurring mortgage servicing reports according to established schedules.

  • Validate servicing data used in operational reports and portfolio analysis.

  • Gather source information supporting the monthly Servicing Portfolio Report.

  • Support the preparation of servicing key performance indicators (KPIs) and subservicer scorecards.

  • Research reporting discrepancies and coordinate corrections when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate supporting documentation for recurring reporting activities.

  • Provide reliable servicing data to support leadership visibility into portfolio operations.

🔍 Subservicer Monitoring & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor daily subservicer and interim servicing activities for operational exceptions.

  • Review servicing activity for potential service-level concerns, discrepancies, and processing issues.

  • Investigate routine exceptions and document findings.

  • Track outstanding servicing issues and coordinate follow-up as appropriate.

  • Escalate recurring concerns, operational risks, or complex servicing matters requiring additional review.

  • Support consistent execution of servicing activities across internal and external servicing partners.

🏗️ Construction-to-Permanent Loan Monitoring

  • Monitor construction-to-permanent loan servicing activity.

  • Review loan-level information and complete required servicing updates.

  • Identify discrepancies, outstanding requirements, or items requiring corrective action.

  • Coordinate with appropriate departments or servicing partners to address routine issues.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of servicing updates and monitoring activities.

  • Escalate unresolved or complex matters to senior servicing staff.

💰 Interim Servicing & Transaction Processing

  • Process routine interim servicing transactions within documented procedures.

  • Research mortgage payment activity and related servicing discrepancies.

  • Support escrow administration and account maintenance activities.

  • Assist with payoff processing and related servicing updates.

  • Prepare and process borrower correspondence associated with servicing transactions.

  • Maintain accurate transaction records and supporting documentation.

  • Identify and escalate processing exceptions requiring additional review.

🤝 Borrower Inquiries & Customer Support

  • Research and respond to borrower inquiries involving mortgage payments, escrow accounts, payoff requests, servicing transfers, and other servicing activities.

  • Provide accurate, timely, and professional information to borrowers.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to research and resolve inquiries.

  • Identify and document borrower complaints according to established procedures.

  • Track outstanding borrower concerns and ensure appropriate follow-up.

  • Escalate complex inquiries, unresolved issues, or potential compliance concerns.

  • Support a consistent and positive borrower experience through clear communication and accurate servicing information.

🚨 Servicing Exception Management & Issue Resolution

  • Identify and investigate routine mortgage servicing exceptions.

  • Research discrepancies to determine root causes and appropriate corrective actions.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and servicing partners to resolve operational issues.

  • Maintain accurate records of exceptions, findings, corrective actions, and resolutions.

  • Monitor recurring exceptions and communicate trends to senior servicing staff.

  • Escalate complex issues, operational risks, or matters outside established procedures.

  • Support timely resolution while maintaining servicing accuracy and compliance.

⚖️ Audit, Investor & Regulatory Support

  • Gather and organize servicing documentation requested for audits, examinations, investor reviews, and regulatory inquiries.

  • Retrieve and validate loan-level servicing data and supporting records.

  • Review documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain requested servicing information.

  • Maintain organized records supporting audit and examination readiness.

  • Escalate discrepancies or potential compliance concerns identified during documentation reviews.

📚 Servicing Policies, Procedures & Documentation

  • Execute servicing responsibilities in accordance with documented procedures and internal controls.

  • Maintain accurate records of servicing activities, exceptions, and resolutions in designated systems.

  • Identify procedures that may no longer align with current operational practices.

  • Recommend updates that improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

  • Support the maintenance of organized and accessible servicing documentation.

  • Follow established escalation protocols when servicing activities require additional guidance.

  • Demonstrate accountability for completing assigned work accurately and on schedule.

⚙️ Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to improve servicing workflows and reduce recurring operational errors.

  • Recommend improvements to data accuracy, reconciliation processes, reporting, and exception management.

  • Support servicing process improvement initiatives and operational readiness activities.

  • Contribute to servicing system conversions and other assigned projects.

  • Assist with evaluating recurring servicing issues and potential process enhancements.

  • Support consistent execution of servicing activities across platforms and servicing partners.

  • Promote efficiency while maintaining established controls and servicing standards.

🤝 Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, and other internal departments.

  • Coordinate with subservicers and interim servicing partners to address operational needs.

  • Communicate servicing discrepancies, outstanding requirements, and resolution updates clearly.

  • Support Finance with reconciliation research and supporting documentation.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve borrower inquiries and servicing exceptions.

  • Contribute to servicing transfers, reporting activities, audits, and operational projects.

  • Maintain professional, responsive, and solutions-focused working relationships.

🔄 Cross-Training & Knowledge Sharing

  • Participate in cross-training activities to strengthen knowledge of mortgage servicing operations.

  • Share process knowledge, servicing findings, and operational best practices with team members.

  • Support operational continuity through accurate documentation and collaboration.

  • Remain informed about changes to servicing systems, workflows, and internal procedures.

  • Assist colleagues with servicing activities as business priorities require.

  • Perform additional duties aligned with business needs, competencies, and experience.

🌈 Team Culture & Accountability

  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned servicing responsibilities and operational deadlines.

  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.

  • Communicate servicing issues proactively and follow established escalation procedures.

  • Support collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

  • Remain adaptable as servicing priorities, portfolio needs, and business processes evolve.

  • Demonstrate eLEND's core values through daily actions and interactions.

🎯 What You Bring

🏠 Mortgage Servicing & Operations Experience

Must-Haves

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in residential mortgage servicing or mortgage operations.

  • Working knowledge of mortgage servicing processes and basic servicing regulations.

  • Experience researching and resolving borrower inquiries, operational issues, or servicing exceptions.

  • Understanding of routine mortgage servicing activities and operational workflows.

  • Ability to execute assigned servicing responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.

💻 Mortgage Systems & Data Management

  • Proficiency with mortgage-related software, including loan origination systems (LOS) or mortgage servicing platforms.

  • Ability to maintain accurate loan-level data across servicing systems.

  • Experience reviewing records, identifying discrepancies, and updating system information.

  • Comfort navigating servicing platforms and working with large volumes of mortgage data.

  • Strong attention to data integrity, accuracy, and documentation.

📊 Excel, Reconciliations & Financial Knowledge

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large data sets.

  • Basic understanding of accounting principles.

  • Ability to research data discrepancies and reconcile information across records.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to numerical accuracy.

  • Ability to organize and validate data supporting servicing operations.

🔍 Research & Problem Solving

  • Experience investigating borrower inquiries, servicing exceptions, or operational discrepancies.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, research potential causes, and coordinate routine resolutions.

  • Sound judgment in determining when additional guidance or escalation is necessary.

  • Resourceful and detail-oriented approach to operational challenges.

📆 Organization & Deadline Management

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to meet established deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple servicing responsibilities.

  • Ability to prioritize assigned work and maintain accurate records.

  • Comfort working independently within documented procedures and controls.

  • Consistent follow-through on outstanding servicing activities and operational issues.

🤝 Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate servicing information clearly to borrowers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating with internal departments or external servicing partners.

  • Professional and solutions-focused approach to borrower inquiries and issue resolution.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively while maintaining accountability for assigned responsibilities.

🔄 Adaptability & Continuous Learning

  • Ability to adapt to changing servicing priorities, systems, and operational needs.

  • Willingness to learn new servicing processes and expand mortgage operations knowledge.

  • Comfortable participating in servicing initiatives, system conversions, and process improvement efforts.

  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

🌈 Values & Professional Standards

  • Ability to demonstrate eLEND's core values through daily actions and decisions.

  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and integrity.

  • Commitment to accuracy, compliance, borrower service, and teamwork.

  • Professional judgment when handling borrower information and servicing records.

  • Ability to contribute positively to a collaborative and service-focused environment.

⭐ Nice-to-Haves

  • Associate or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

  • Experience with new loan boarding, servicing transfers, or interim servicing activities.

  • Experience supporting reconciliations, accounting activities, or operational reporting.

  • Prior mortgage call center or borrower-facing servicing experience.

🪑 Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to perform desk-based responsibilities involving prolonged sitting and intermittent standing and walking.

  • Ability to perform routine computer and administrative tasks, including typing and handling servicing documentation.

  • Visual acuity sufficient for computer-based work and normal hearing for routine workplace communication.

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 20 pounds.

  • Reasonable accommodations are available upon request with relevant documentation.

📆 A Day in the Life

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing newly originated loans scheduled for servicing boarding.

  • Validating loan boarding data against origination records and resolving discrepancies.

  • Updating servicing information within the Origination Platform and servicing systems.

  • Researching routine reconciliation items involving servicing invoices, escrow accounts, or purchase advice.

  • Preparing loan-level data files and documentation for upcoming servicing transfers.

  • Generating recurring servicing reports and validating portfolio information.

  • Gathering source data supporting monthly portfolio reporting, KPIs, and subservicer scorecards.

  • Monitoring daily subservicer activity and investigating operational exceptions.

  • Reviewing construction-to-permanent loan activity and completing required updates.

  • Processing interim servicing transactions involving payments, escrow administration, and payoff requests.

  • Responding to borrower inquiries and coordinating resolutions with servicing partners.

  • Identifying and documenting borrower complaints according to established procedures.

  • Researching servicing exceptions and escalating complex issues when necessary.

  • Gathering servicing documentation for audits, investor reviews, or regulatory examinations.

  • Collaborating with Finance, Operations, and Servicing leadership on outstanding items.

  • Updating servicing records, tracking tools, and supporting documentation.

  • Participating in servicing process improvement initiatives and operational projects.

  • Reinforcing a culture of accuracy, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

Annual Base Salary: $91,400 - $114,250 based on experience 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) plan with company participation

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Access to tools, technology, and resources that support servicing accuracy and operational success

  • Collaborative and growth-oriented team environment

💼 Worksite

Worksite Arrangement: Remote

  • Mortgage servicing operations role supporting eLEND's servicing portfolio and interim servicing activities.

  • Responsible for daily loan boarding, servicing data maintenance, reconciliations, reporting, and borrower support.

  • Works closely with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, and third-party servicing partners.

  • Provides hands-on support for servicing transfers, operational exceptions, audits, and portfolio reporting.

  • Requires consistent attention to servicing accuracy, operational deadlines, borrower experience, and documented procedures.

⭐ How You'll Elevate the Experience

This role lives at the intersection of Own It and Relentless Pursuit of Better.

Own It starts with the details. A loan that boards accurately, a reconciliation that balances, and a servicing record that is correct the first time all contribute to a better borrower experience. You will take accountability for the accuracy of your work, follow through on servicing exceptions, and ensure assigned responsibilities are completed within established procedures and timelines. Ownership means recognizing that even routine servicing activities have a meaningful impact on borrowers, operational performance, and the integrity of our portfolio.

Relentless Pursuit of Better means looking beyond simply completing the task. You will recognize opportunities to improve servicing accuracy, identify recurring issues, and speak up when existing procedures no longer reflect how the work is performed. Rather than working around inefficiencies, you will help identify practical improvements that strengthen consistency, reduce errors, and support operational excellence.

Ultimately, you will help create a servicing operation that is accurate, accountable, efficient, compliant, and committed to delivering a consistent borrower experience while supporting the continued success of eLEND.

🌈 Equal Opportunity for All

At eLEND, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all team members are respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and business needs, ensuring equitable opportunities for all individuals regardless of background or identity.

💬 Stay Connected

Join today to connect with our team, stay informed about upcoming roles, and explore how your mortgage servicing experience, analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to operational excellence can help elevate the servicing experience at eLEND.

jobs.title: Actuarial Associate, UK
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a technically savvy Actuarial Pricing Associate to join the UK team and support pricing adequacy, accuracy, and competitiveness of our European products. You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

In this role you’ll

  • Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

  • Turn trading data into action, digging into conversion, retention, risk mix and profitability to spot opportunities and explain what’s changing.

  • Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

  • Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

  • Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

  • Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

  • Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

  • Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements

What you’ll need

  • 3–5 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

  • A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

  • A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

  • Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

  • Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

  • Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

  • Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

  • Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.

Cross-Functional Leadership

StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. jobs.title: Manager, Developer Advocacy (EMEA)
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for someone to run Developer Advocacy in EMEA. You’ll get to shape how developers across the region first find Temporal, and you’ll also see it through to the other end, helping our biggest customers build serious systems on it.

You’ll manage a team of advocates, but this isn’t a desk job. You’ll still give talks, run workshops, write code, and sit down with customers yourself. If it’s been a while since you built a demo from scratch, this probably isn’t the right fit.

EMEA covers a lot of ground. The UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, and the Nordics have big developer communities and some of our largest customers.

You’ll spend a lot of time with our Marketing department on events and community, and with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Developer Success on customer accounts. Good relationships with all of them are your key to success.

What You'll Do

  • Hire, coach, and support a team of Developer Advocates spread across the region. Set priorities, then trust them to adapt to their own markets and audiences.

  • Decide how the team splits its time between community and customer work. Sort incoming customer requests by deal size, stage, and strategic value, and make the tough calls when there’s more demand than people, without letting community work get pushed aside.

  • Work with Marketing to plan where we show up in EMEA: which conferences to speak at and which meetups to start or support.

  • Create and localize content that developers in the region will use, like talks, tutorials, blog posts, videos, sample apps, and livestreams.

  • Find the people in local communities who care about the problems Temporal solves and help them lead, contribute to open source, and spread the word.

  • Track whether it’s working: are more developers signing up, trying Temporal, and sticking around?

  • Own DevDays, our onsite customer engagement program, in EMEA from start to finish. Work with the Global DevDays lead to tailor each one to the customer’s use cases.

  • Spot the engineers inside each account who could become champions, and make sure someone follows up with them.

  • Take what you hear from developers and customers back to Docs, Education, and Product, especially around language, data residency, and what different markets need.

What You Bring

  • Experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, developer education, or technical community work, ideally in a developer-first company.

  • People leadership experience or a clear readiness to step into it; you can coach senior individual contributors while still doing the work yourself.

  • Strong hands-on technical credibility: you can build, demo, and teach, and earn the respect of senior enterprise engineers.

  • An operational, execution-first mindset: you can run a repeatable program, manage intake and prioritization, and keep commitments against an SLA.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, SAs, Dev Success, Product, and Marketing, and translating technical engagement into commercial impact.

  • Experience operating across a linguistically and culturally diverse region and coordinating a distributed team across multiple time zones; additional European languages are a plus.

  • A genuine passion for empowering developers and creating authentic, high-trust community experiences, not sales pitches.

  • Familiarity with durable execution, workflow orchestration, or distributed systems (e.g., Temporal) is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Customer Platform (Poland, Remote, B2B)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We're building the next chapter: an agentic platform that understands operational context and takes action, with the ambition to make physical operations increasingly autonomous. External Platform EMEA owns critical capabilities behind that transition. Depending on the team, your work could include:

  • Reporting and intelligence. Own the reporting engine and products that turn the complexity of a fleet into answers customers can act on.
  • Enterprise administration. Build how customers configure and control Samsara at scale, from permissions and device metadata to AI-assisted onboarding.
  • Developer and agent platform. Build APIs, event systems, integrations, and tools that give applications and AI agents access to operational data and actions.
  • Business-critical infrastructure. Own billing, license assignment, and usage metering: systems central to how Samsara sells, delivers, and grows its products.

The long-term opportunity is rooted in the physical world. Deployed hardware, data generated at the edge, and years of operational expertise form a foundation that's hard to replicate. As AI advances, it expands what we can build on that foundation. This is a place to develop deep engineering expertise while helping shape a platform with years of ambitious work ahead.

AI is also central to how we build. We expect engineers to push tools like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor throughout design, implementation, testing, and production investigations, taking on more ambitious work while owning the quality of what they ship.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Poland.

In this role, you will:

  • Build foundational capabilities for Samsara’s agentic experiences, enabling AI agents to securely discover data, use tools, integrate with external systems, and execute reliable workflows at enterprise scale.
  • Design systems for high throughput, availability, observability, security, and maintainability.
  • Apply AI assistants, including Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor - across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.
  • Improve frameworks, tooling, and engineering practices that increase the effectiveness of teams across Samsara.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and improving production software.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a product, substantial feature, or subsystem through design, implementation, launch, and iteration.
  • Ability to take a clear customer or business challenge, independently choose a technical approach, and balance delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.
  • Experience driving delivery with engineers and product or design partners, and helping teammates improve through reviews, technical feedback, or mentoring.
  • Extensive practical use of AI across investigation, design, implementation, testing, and review, while owning the correctness and quality of the result.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating public-facing REST or GraphQL APIs.
  • High-throughput event-streaming platform.
  • Building extensible integration or application frameworks.
  • Distributed data-fetching, query execution, reporting, or analytical systems.
  • Experience in any one of these areas is a plus. Exposure should come from production work.
    • Reporting and data systems: Reporting products, analytics, query execution, data retrieval, or turning complex datasets into useful customer experiences.
    • Enterprise administration: Permissions and access control, entity metadata, configuration frameworks, or customer onboarding and setup automation.
    • Developer and agent platforms: Public APIs, event-driven systems, integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or tools that let AI agents access data and take action.
    • Billing and monetization: Billing systems, license assignment, product entitlements, or usage metering supporting how a business sells and delivers its products.
    • Full-stack product development: Building complete customer experiences across frontend interfaces, backend services, and data models.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. jobs.title: Senior Paid Search Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

You'll run Docplanner's paid search activities for patients across multiple markets, including Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Italy, Spain and Poland. You'll manage a large-scale Google Ads setup with 100+ accounts, tens of thousands of campaigns and millions of keywords, working with our in-house ads engine and AI agents.

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for doctor and clinic profiles across all markets, including campaign structure, bids, budgets, keywords, negatives, ads and ad scheduling.

  • Execute large-scale changes using Google Ads Editor, bulk uploads and scripts.

  • Work with AI agents and automation scripts: review AI-driven changes, handle edge cases and improve automated scripts.

  • Handle requests from country teams, including new activations, budget changes, campaign pauses and custom ads.

  • Monitor daily pacing, cost per booking and campaign health, and act on alerts when needed.

  • Ensure conversion tracking is accurate in collaboration with data and web teams.

  • Manage healthcare advertising policies, certifications and ad disapprovals.

  • Report on performance using SQL queries and dashboards.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, including managing large, multi-account setups across several markets.

  • Expert knowledge of Google Ads Editor and bulk campaign management.

  • Strong experience building Google Ads scripts and/or working with the Google Ads API, including reading data, modifying scripts and debugging automation.

  • SQL skills, with the ability to independently query a data warehouse (Redshift or similar).

  • Experience with healthcare advertising policies and certifications.

  • Comfortable working with automation and AI tools on a daily basis.

  • Fluent English.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Turkish or German.

  • Experience building and scaling large Google Ads accounts.

  • Experience with YouTube, Performance Max or Demand Gen.

  • Background in a marketplace, health tech or subscription-based business.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Practical assessment

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind-it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Additional/ Final Interview - A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
