jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Manager of Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational foundation enabling Marketing to execute, measure, and scale effectively. Reporting to the Revenue Operations leader, this role serves as a key operational partner to Marketing leadership, translating go-to-market strategy into the processes, systems, data, and insights that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue.

This role owns the day-to-day mechanics of marketing operations, including lead lifecycle management and routing, marketing automation, campaign operations, attribution execution, funnel analytics, marketing data quality, and the marketing technology stack. This role will work closely with Marketing and Sales Operations to create clear visibility across the buyer journey and ensure leads and accounts move between Marketing and Sales with speed, consistency, and the right context.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between systems, data, process, and business partnership. The right person will understand that great Marketing Operations is not simply about administering marketing technology or reporting campaign results. It is about building the operating infrastructure that allows Marketing to understand what is working, invest intelligently, and create measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

Key responsibilities

Funnel and lead lifecycle operations

  • Own the operational execution of the lead and account lifecycle from initial engagement through handoff to Sales.
  • Design lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, scoring models, and routing logic in partnership with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Sales, then implement and maintain them
  • Manage lead and account routing to ensure high-quality opportunities reach the appropriate BDR or seller quickly and accurately.
  • Monitor MQL-to-Sales acceptance, meeting conversion, opportunity creation, and other key funnel transitions to identify leakage and areas for improvement.
  • Maintain and monitor SLAs between Marketing, BDRs, and Sales, surfacing breakdowns and partnering with leaders to resolve them.
  • Ensure funnel definitions and system logic remain consistent across Marketing and Sales platforms.
  • Assess the cross-functional impact of marketing operations initiatives, ensuring alignment across systems, processes, and teams.

Marketing automation and campaign operations

  • Own the operational infrastructure required to execute scalable, measurable marketing campaigns.
  • Manage marketing automation workflows, segmentation, campaign structure, audience logic, and operational QA.
  • Partner with Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly configured, tracked, and measurable.
  • Establish campaign governance and naming conventions that create consistent and reliable reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve campaign execution speed and accuracy.

Marketing analytics and funnel performance

  • Collaborate with data analysts to create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into funnel performance, campaign contribution, pipeline generation, conversion, velocity, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Analyze performance across channels, campaigns, segments, products, personas, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Identify funnel leakage, conversion trends, engagement patterns, and opportunities to improve Marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue.
  • Move beyond reporting activity and volume to helping Marketing leadership understand what is driving business outcomes and where performance is changing.
  • Partner with Sales Operations to provide a connected view of the funnel from initial engagement through opportunity creation and revenue.

Attribution and measurement

  • Design and own the attribution framework: select models, define sourced vs. influenced logic, and recommend changes as the funnel and buying journey evolve
  • Ensure campaigns, contacts, accounts, and opportunities are structured appropriately to support reliable attribution and influence reporting.
  • Maintain data and process integrity across the systems used to measure marketing contribution.
  • Provide Marketing leadership with visibility into sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance.
  • Help distinguish between activity metrics and the measures that indicate meaningful progression toward pipeline and revenue.

Marketing technology and data

  • Manage the day-to-day effectiveness and administration of marketing-specific technology within the broader GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on technology evaluation, implementation, integration, consolidation, and governance.
  • Maintain integrations and data flows between marketing automation platforms, Salesforce, intent and account intelligence platforms, and other marketing systems.
  • Own the strategy for data quality, enrichment, duplication, consent, and other issues affecting the usability and reliability of marketing data.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to improve segmentation, routing, data enrichment, campaign execution, and insight generation.
  • Continually evaluate whether technology is creating meaningful leverage or unnecessary complexity.

Account-based and intent operations

  • Operationalize account segmentation, targeting, intent signals, and account-based programs in partnership with Marketing and Sales.
  • Ensure intent and engagement signals are surfaced to the appropriate Sales and BDR teams in a usable and actionable way.
  • Support workflows that connect target-account activity across Marketing and Sales.
  • Measure engagement and progression within priority accounts and help identify signals that warrant Sales action.
  • Partner with Sales Operations to ensure account ownership, routing, and marketing activity are aligned.

Planning and marketing performance

  • Support annual and quarterly Marketing planning with funnel analysis, historical conversion data, pipeline requirements, and scenario modeling.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Marketing leadership to translate revenue goals into measurable funnel requirements.
  • Track performance against Marketing pipeline and funnel objectives throughout the year.
  • Support Marketing leadership in understanding where investment is producing results and where assumptions may need to change.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to Marketing leadership and the broader Marketing organization.
  • Partner closely with Sales Operations to ensure clean handoffs, shared definitions, reliable data, and visibility across the entire Marketing-to-Sales funnel.
  • Work with Field Enablement to ensure sellers and BDRs understand how to interpret and act on marketing-generated signals, intent, campaigns, and programs.
  • Surface operational issues quickly and coordinate resolution across Marketing, Sales, BDR, Revenue Operations, Finance, Field Enablement, and other teams as needed.
  • Create repeatable processes that allow marketers to spend more time building effective programs and less time navigating systems, reconciling data, or troubleshooting operational issues.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Demand Operations, or a related B2B SaaS operations role.
  • Experience supporting complex B2B marketing and sales organizations with enterprise and/or multi-product go-to-market motions.
  • Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, Salesforce CRM, including lifecycle management, lead and account routing, campaign architecture, and data integration.
  • Demonstrated experience with funnel analytics, lead scoring, attribution, campaign measurement, and marketing performance reporting.
  • Experience with intent data, account-based marketing (ABM) platforms such as 6sense and Vector, enrichment tools such as Clay and ZoomInfo, and other GTM technologies.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with BI/reporting tools and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL conversion, Sales acceptance, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, velocity, and attribution.
  • Ability to work across Marketing and Sales and translate the needs of both functions into scalable processes.
  • Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance recurring operational responsibilities with larger improvement initiatives.
  • Bias toward simplification, automation, scalability, and high-quality data.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $100,000-120,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Services Architect is an advanced individual contributor within the Services Architecture team, contributing to the technical direction, quality, and delivery of content across the Professional Services Portfolio. Operating with a high degree of autonomy while aligning with the overarching portfolio strategy, this role leads the design and execution of net-new consulting service offerings, courses, and enablement programs, and helps establish standards for the broader team. In this position, the architect provides technical guidance across team projects, handles content and offering escalations, and actively mentors Associate Services Architects. Working in close collaboration with portfolio leadership, the role supports offering strategy and product roadmap alignment, while periodically teaching customer classes or delivering service engagements to ensure content remains grounded in real-world customer experience.

Your Opportunity:

Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Portfolio Direction: Shape the Professional Services Portfolio by identifying gaps and opportunities and proposing and prioritizing new offerings aligned with corporate strategy and product roadmaps.
  • Offering Ownership: Design, draft, and update consulting service offerings, enablement content, educational material, and technical presentations for webinars and events, and lead development of the most complex and strategic net-new offerings.
  • Standards & Quality: Maintain high technical, content, and lab quality standards across the portfolio, ensuring that project outputs and contributions, including work from Associate Services Architects, consistently adhere to established team standards and templates.
  • Roadmap Alignment: Stay informed about Tenable product changes, evaluate requirements for offering updates, and plan portfolio updates well ahead of product release.
  • Advisory: Advise the Senior Director, Services Portfolio, on offering strategy, resourcing, and delivery risk.

Content Development & Delivery

  • Requirements Review: Review user and technical requirements for completeness and clarity.
  • Collateral: Create collateral for new offerings and evaluate existing offerings and content for accuracy and relevance.
  • Pre-Production Training: Deliver pre-production training sessions to evaluate product suitability and gather early feedback.
  • Live Demonstrations: Create live demonstration recordings for the Tenable product suite.
  • Content Review: Perform content reviews with peers in Services, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Product Management to ensure quality and alignment with customer needs, and act as the final technical approver for release.
  • Customer Experience: Periodically teach customer classes or deliver service engagements to obtain intimate knowledge of the customer experience.

Strategic Engagement & Support

  • Field Perspective: Collaborate with Professional Services peers to understand the field perspective on service and training offering requirements.
  • Customer & Partner Engagement: Engage with customers and partners to analyze market trends and the competitive landscape, and translate findings into portfolio decisions.
  • Problem Solving: Provide solutions to a wide range of difficult problems while maintaining a positive attitude and positive working relationships, gathering information to support data-driven decisions.
  • Escalation Support: Act as the final escalation point for Customer Care, Services, and Product escalations relating to portfolio content that the Associate Services Architect cannot resolve.
  • Staying Current: Remain abreast of corporate direction and strategy, product roadmaps, messaging, and emerging trends in the security industry.

Project, People & Process

  • Delivery Oversight: Independently manage assigned projects and provide delivery oversight of team members’ projects to ensure delivery on schedule and on budget.
  • Mentoring: Mentor and develop Associate Services Architect colleagues, including setting expectations for the Associate role’s intake and review.
  • Process Improvement: Remain abreast of educational learning frameworks, content development approaches, and technologies that may reduce cost or shorten development timelines, and drive adoption where they do.
  • Other Duties: May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • Security Foundations: 5+ years of overall experience in Information Security.
  • Vulnerability Management & Cybersecurity: 1+ years of experience in vulnerability management and broader cybersecurity operations, ideally utilizing enterprise assessment tools such as the Tenable product suite.
  • Services Experience: 3+ years of professional services, technical support, or sales engineering experience.
  • Curriculum Design: Proven experience designing and delivering technical curricula, training, and customer enablement programs, as well as leading others to do so.

Knowledge and Education

  • Education: B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Technical Depth: In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems and of TCP/IP networking.
  • Emerging Domains: Working knowledge of web application security, container security, cloud environments (AWS/Azure), and ICS/SCADA systems, with in-depth expertise in at least one.
  • Security Tools: Familiarity with security assessment tools such as Nessus, Kali Linux, and Metasploit.

Other Requirements

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to senior internal and customer audiences.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including at a senior level.
  • Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both in a self-directed manner and as part of a geographically distributed team, setting direction for others without day-to-day supervision.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (East Minnesota)
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers. Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

This role covers the East region of Minnesota. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattlemans, Stockmans associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

  • In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

  • Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

  • Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

  • Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

  • Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

  • Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.

You'll be great if you exhibit

  • Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

  • Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

  • Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.

Bonus things you could bring along to the role

  • Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

  • Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

  • Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.

Our Benefits

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

  • 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

  • Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

  • Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

  • Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

  • Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

  • Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.title: Website & App Tester | Remote, freelancer
jobs.description:
About Testlio

Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

We're looking for people in Paraguay and Uruguay to help test online payments for an international payments technology company.

Requirements

  • Location: Currently living in Paraguay or Uruguay.

  • Payment methods: Access to at least one of the following:

    • Paraguay: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Infonet, USDC, USDT.

    • Uruguay: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club, OCA, Lider, Creditel, Mercado Pago Wallet/Connect, USDC, USDT.

  • Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English.

  • Frequency: Expected weekly opportunities, with occasional additional requests.

  • Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible.

You don't need access to every payment method. Having one is enough to apply!

What You'll Do

  • Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team.

  • Complete small, authorized test transactions using eligible payment methods.

  • Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear.

  • Share your results and report issues, including screenshots when needed.

Why do we need local testers?
Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another.
That's why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use.
Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find.
No previous software testing experience is required.

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports.

Interested in joining us?
Apply through our official Testlio Work Opportunities page. If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.
All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox!

jobs.description:

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.

jobs.title: Associate Business Development Alliances Manager
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

We are looking for an Associate Business Development Alliances Manager to run the day-to-day operations behind ExtraHop’s co-sell, marketplace, referral, and partner activation programs with our strategic cloud and technology partners. The initial focus is on expanding co-sell and marketplace activity in North America, with AWS and Google Cloud through co-sell and marketplace motions, and with CrowdStrikeand other strategic tech partners through joint selling and integration-led co-sell.

This role works closely with ExtraHop sales teams, Deal Ops, channel partners, technology partners, and internal cross-functional teams to keep shared opportunities moving, activate partners and sellers, and turn partner relationships into measurable pipeline and revenue. You will manage the operational mechanics of co-sell, referral, and marketplace programs, including opportunity registration and follow-up, handoffs to Deal Ops, partner activation, and performance reporting, so that field teams and partner sellers can sell together with minimal friction.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience running co-sell, marketplace, or referral programs and is comfortable working in Salesforce and partner tooling. Familiarity with the cybersecurity landscape is valuable, and you will build deep knowledge of ExtraHop’s Network Detection and Response platform and its role within the broader security ecosystem. This is a highly collaborative role that requires building working relationships with partner field organizations while coordinating effectively across Sales, Deal Ops, Marketing, Product, and Alliances.

Key Responsibilities

As a member of the Alliances organization, you will work with technology and channel partners to develop and execute joint go-to-market strategies. Your day-to-day responsibilities could include any of the following:

Co-Sell

  • Execute co-sell programs with strategic cloud and technology partners (AWS, Google, CrowdStrike, others), supporting the strategy set by Alliances leadership.
  • Manage co-sell opportunity workflows in AWS Partner Central/ACE and the Google partner portal, including submission, acceptance, and follow-up, so shared opportunities keep moving.
  • Facilitate joint account mapping and opportunity progression between ExtraHop account teams and partner field counterparts.
  • Maintain working relationships with partner field, channel, solutions engineering, and alliance teams to support joint customer meetings and co-sell execution.

Marketplace

  • Identify and track marketplace-eligible opportunities, and work with account teams and partner reps to move them toward marketplace transactions.
  • Serve as the Alliances point of contact for Deal Ops, handing off deal details and following up so marketplace deals close smoothly. Deal Ops creates and enters the Marketplace offers.
  • Educate sellers and partners on the marketplace motion, including cloud commitment drawdown and how to position marketplace purchasing with customers.

Referrals and Programs

  • Operationalize referral programs
  • Build and document repeatable playbooks and processes for co-sell, referral, and marketplace motions that increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

Partner Activation and Enablement

  • Run partner activation, including onboarding checklists, first-deal playbooks, and time-to-first-opportunity tracking.
  • Coordinate partner and seller enablement (sales presentations, use cases, competitive positioning, and joint solution messaging) with Marketing and Partner Solutions Architecture.
  • Support joint webinars, events, executive briefings, and customer workshops.

Reporting and Cross-Functional Work

  • Track and report partnership performance, including joint opportunities, pipeline, sourced and influenced revenue, marketplace-transacted bookings, and customer activity. Maintain pipeline hygiene and dashboards, and report regularly to leadership.
  • Prepare data and materials for partner business reviews led by Alliances leadership.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Sales Ops/RevOps, Deal Ops, Marketing, and Partner Solutions Architecture to remove friction from partner-led deals.
  • Build working knowledge of ExtraHop’s Network Detection and Response platform and the partner platforms it complements.
  • Identify and fix process gaps to make our partner programs more scalable and efficient.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in alliances, partner operations, channel, or business development, including hands-on work with a cloud marketplace (AWS or Google), co-sell, or referral program..
  • Proven experience developing relationships with partner field organizations and translating those relationships into measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience working with cybersecurity technology vendors, channel partners, resellers, or systems integrators.
  • Understanding of enterprise cybersecurity technologies and the security operations market.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute joint go-to-market and co-selling strategies.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand pipeline, revenue, and sales performance metrics.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with Sales, Deal Ops, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with how AWS and Google Cloud marketplace transactions work, including private offers, CPPOs, and commitment drawdown.
  • Experience working with leading cybersecurity technology platforms, and familiarity with Endpoint, SIEM, NDR, XDR, SOAR, cloud security, and security operations technologies.
  • Existing relationships with cybersecurity channel partners, resellers, and systems integrators.
  • Experience developing referral, co-sell, marketplace, or other partner-led commercial programs.
  • Experience with Cloud 3PI (e.g., Tackle.io), account-mapping (e.g., Crossbeam), or other ecosystem-led growth and partner management tools.
  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets, pivot tables, and business reporting.

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $75,000 – $85,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Services Portfolio Production
jobs.description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

Lead the Portfolio Enablement & Creative team to turn technical concepts into clear, on-brand, field-ready content for the Professional Services Portfolio, including service briefs, FAQs, presentations, courseware and digital assets. The role is accountable for the narrative, creative direction and brand quality of that content, and for launching the portfolio's offerings to the field.

The role carries a dual mandate: lead a small, AI-enabled creative studio, and launch the portfolio's offerings on behalf of Portfolio. That means getting GTM assets into Prime, enabling sellers, and finding new ways to market and promote the portfolio. SAMs deliver their own theatre enablement and SAM Academy is the portfolio's route to sellers, but no role currently owns or showcases the portfolio's offerings. This role fills that gap, co-delivering with technical representation from Services Architects and SMEs and in partnership with SAM Academy. Launch communications are coordinated with the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead. The ideal candidate has led creative or editorial teams, writes well, presents credibly to senior stakeholders and the field, and works with minimal supervision. Working familiarity with security and the Tenable portfolio is needed to partner with Services Architects and SMEs, who remain accountable for technical accuracy.

Organization Structure:

  • Reports to: Senior Director, Services Portfolio
  • Direct reports: Creative Production Developer and Creative eLearning Developer (a two-person, AI-enabled studio)

Your Opportunity:

Portfolio Enablement & Go-to-Market

  • Launch Portfolio Offerings: Launch new and updated offerings on behalf of Portfolio, from positioning through to presenting to the field, including monthly Prime enablement launches and partner-facing content. A launch is only complete once the GTM assets are in Prime and sellers have been enabled to use them. Other members of the team may front a launch where it makes sense.
  • GTM Assets & Seller Enablement: Get the GTM assets for each offering into Prime, keep them current, and enable sellers to use them, through Prime enablement sessions, Prime Weekly and content built for the field.
  • SAM Academy Partnership: Work with SAM Academy, who are the portfolio's route to sellers, to get offerings in front of sales. SAMs currently deliver their own theatre enablement and no one owns portfolio sales enablement, so this role fills that gap, co-delivering with technical representation from Services Architects and SMEs.
  • Launch Coordination: Work with the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead, who manages communications across all Portfolio teams, so that launch plans, milestones, dependencies and messages are joined up.
  • Marketing & Promotion Innovation: Look for new ways to market and promote the portfolio, testing formats, channels and AI-enabled approaches, and keep what works.
  • Face and Voice of the Portfolio: Serve as the portfolio's presenter on Prime Weekly TV and in webinars, presenting service solution frameworks and customer training offerings, supported by the Senior Director and a Services Architect.
  • Creative Direction & Brand: Set creative direction and Professional Services house style across One Tenable and Prime assets, and keep the Tier 1/2 brand consistent as new content is produced. Use outsourcing where it is the better option.

Content Production & Editorial

  • Technical Writing & Editorial: Make sure technical writing is covered for the portfolio. For now it is shared across the team, Services Architects and SMEs. This role sets editorial standards, coordinates the shared capability and signs off narrative and editorial quality on service briefs, FAQs, collateral and launch content.
  • Briefs, FAQs & Collateral: Create and maintain service briefs, FAQs and sales collateral, and own the Professional Services collateral library and house assets.
  • Storytelling, Presentations & Digital Content: Develop presentations, storytelling, webinars, and Articulate and digital content that make technical offerings easy for sellers and customers to understand.
  • Language & Localization: Manage translation and localization of portfolio content for the global field.
  • AI-Enabled Production: Run a governed, AI-enabled workflow in place of ad hoc production: SME source, AI draft, production by the Creative Production Developer, narrative and creative judgement applied by this role, SME validation, publish.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with Services Architects, SAM Academy, Education Governance, the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead and Domain Specialists. Curricula, education standards and review gates sit with Architecture & Education and Education Governance; the Creative eLearning Developer handles SCORM and LMS publication.

People Leadership & Performance

  • Team Leadership: Lead a two-person creative studio: set priorities, coach, and unblock the team so that output is consistent and on time.
  • Production & Adoption Metrics: Track throughput, cycle time and use of launch and enablement content, using the portfolio health dashboard, and act on what it shows.
  • Talent Development: Foster a high-performance culture capable of adapting to rapid shifts in corporate direction, messaging and strategy, and develop the team's use of AI-enabled tools.

Quality & Stakeholder Management

  • Content Standards: Own the narrative, editorial and brand quality of all portfolio content before release. Technical accuracy is validated by SMEs and Services Architects.
  • Stakeholder Interface: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders (Sales, SAM Academy, Product Marketing, Theatre leadership) regarding content and launch enablement requests and timelines.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Identify production bottlenecks and launch dependencies early, and escalate to the Program Offering Manager & Communications Lead where they put launch dates at risk.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • Related Experience: 8+ years of related experience producing content, managing people and projects, and working across functions, ideally in a professional-services, training or technical-content environment.
  • Creative Leadership: Hands-on creative or editorial leadership of a small team, with demonstrable work in writing, storytelling or content production. Technical writing experience is a strong advantage while that capability is shared.
  • Launch & Sales Enablement Experience: Experience launching or enabling service or training offerings to a sales audience, and working with a sales-enablement function. A record of trying new approaches to promotion is valued.
  • Delivery Lifecycle: Exposure to the full content delivery lifecycle: requirements, design, production, review and launch.

Knowledge and Education

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Communications, Instructional Design, Computer Science or a related field preferred.
  • Technical Familiarity: Working familiarity with network security and vulnerability management, enough to partner with Services Architects and SMEs. Familiarity with Tenable products is preferred.
  • Tools & Platforms: Experience with Articulate (Storyline or Rise), AI-assisted content tools and managing a content or collateral library.
  • Data Fluency: Comfortable reading dashboards (e.g., Tableau) to follow portfolio health and production metrics.

And Ideally:

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting live and on camera to the field and senior stakeholders.
  • Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both self-directed and as part of a geographically distributed team.
  • Agility: Ability to manage multiple concurrent launches and content requests in an agile, frequently shifting environment.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-MM1

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

Overview:
Join a dynamic, values-driven engineering and architecture firm dedicated to delivering exceptional service to clients and communities. Our client emphasizes respect, professional growth, collaboration, and results. Team members are encouraged to explore innovative solutions, contribute to meaningful projects, and help turn clients’ visions into reality. With competitive benefits, training, and mentorship, this role offers a pathway to a rewarding career beyond just a job.

Position Summary:
This is a leadership opportunity for an entrepreneurial structural or forensic engineering professional who can combine technical expertise, client development, team leadership, and business growth. The Director will oversee complex forensic investigations, develop client relationships, mentor engineering staff, and help shape the long-term strategy for the Florida market.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader who is ready to build a regional practice while remaining actively engaged in technical work and client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical & Project Leadership

    • Lead forensic engineering investigations involving structural damage, failures, deterioration, and construction defects

    • Oversee facility condition assessments and building evaluations

    • Investigate structural failures and building performance issues

    • Review technical findings and ensure delivery of high-quality engineering reports

    • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering staff

    • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients

    Business Development & Practice Growth

    • Develop and execute a strategic business development plan for the Florida market

    • Build and maintain relationships with new and existing clients

    • Identify opportunities for new projects and market expansion

    • Lead client presentations, interviews, and proposal development

    • Represent the firm within the engineering and construction community

    • Drive client satisfaction and long-term partnerships

    • Help establish and execute the long-term strategy for the Florida Investigative practice

    Team Leadership

    • Mentor, coach, and develop engineering staff

    • Recruit, hire, and retain top engineering talent

    • Delegate work effectively and support employee development

    • Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement

    • Lead quality assurance and quality control initiatives

    • Build a positive, engaged, and high-performing team culture

    Business & Operational Management

    • Manage project profitability and financial performance

    • Monitor project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation

    • Support staffing forecasts and workload planning

    • Identify operational improvements that increase efficiency and client value

    • Contribute to strategic planning for the Florida practice

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift or move objects weighing up to 50 pounds

  • Ability and willingness to climb ladders and scaffolding, work from elevated locations, walk roofs, access crawl spaces, and inspect areas with limited accessibility

  • Ability to safely perform field investigations in a variety of environmental conditions

  • Ability to travel to project sites throughout Texas and occasionally to surrounding states.

  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle safely and drive extended distances as required to support client and project needs.

  • Prolonged sitting at a computer workstation.

  • Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing.

  • Close vision for computer and document review.

  • Occasional walking, standing, or reaching as necessary.

  • Ability to lift up to 15 pounds.

  • Consistent, reliable attendance and punctuality.

Qualifications:

  • Required

    • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited university

    • Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in Florida or ability to obtain Florida licensure

    • 10+ years of progressively increasing responsibility in structural or forensic engineering

    • Demonstrated experience leading engineering projects, mentoring technical staff, and managing client relationships

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, concise technical reports

    • Strong business development skills with the ability to cultivate new and existing client partnerships

    • Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record and reliable transportation for travel to client sites

    • Ability to travel locally with occasional regional travel

    Preferred

    • Experience performing forensic engineering investigations and structural failure analyses

    • Structural building repair design experience across commercial, industrial, municipal, or residential facilities

    • Experience conducting facility condition assessments and building envelope evaluations

    • AutoCAD and/or Revit experience

    • Experience developing and executing business growth strategies

    • Previous experience leading or growing an engineering practice, office, or business unit

Why Apply:
This role offers the opportunity to be the technical leader for the Texas Investigative team. You'll oversee a diverse portfolio of forensic engineering and structural investigation projects involving commercial, industrial, municipal, and residential facilities. If you have a passion for forensic investigations and structural problem-solving, and want to contribute to meaningful projects, this position is for you.

  • U.S. work authorization is required. Visa sponsorship is not currently available.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Clover R&D
jobs.description:
At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring a Director of Product to build and lead a product function in Clover's new R&D function. Reporting directly to the CTO, the scope of you and your team will span health-plan, care services, and corporate technology.

This is a player-coach role. You will personally work through difficult product questions while developing a small, flat team of product managers and embedded product operations staff. Most PM assignments will pursue one or two defined outcomes through repeated research and experiments. A small number of senior assignments will require judgment across ambiguous problem spaces to identify and shape the next project worth doing.

You will lead product craft across R&D from the outset, while drawing on the product expertise of Counterpart, our separate technology subsidiary. The surface area is large, and Product missions and capacity will evolve with the business needs and evidence.

You’ll work with empowered teams and individuals: our engineers work directly with users, exercise product judgment, and own technical execution. Many operational needs are clear and practical technical solutions are available; the harder work is resolving details, ownership, and adoption. Our bias is to build the simplest useful system and iterate quickly. You will recognize when engineers and operating owners can advance directly, where a PM can improve a defined outcome, and where substantial product or design discovery is needed.

As a Director of Product, you will:

  • Build and develop the product team. Hire for the work, give direct feedback, coach research and measurement, and grow people’s judgment while keeping the structure proportionate to the team.
  • Build a culture within product and engineering that values incremental progress toward measurable outcomes, clear stakeholder communication, and aggressive AI-forward productivity.
  • Understand the member journey across plan and clinical operations. Observe the work, review interactions and data, and connect apparent technology problems to the underlying needs of members and staff.
  • Choose focused product missions with business and engineering partners. Decide where dedicated product attention will help and match the assignment to the uncertainty: a defined improvement mission or senior discovery across a broader problem space. Establish useful baselines, define success, test assumptions, and change course when the evidence warrants it.
  • Personally investigate ambiguous opportunities. Turn them into a clear problem, evidence of value, a plausible approach, and a useful first delivery or learning milestone.
  • Develop an embedded Product Operations function that connects frontline observation, testing, training, and adoption to product and engineering decisions.
  • Partner closely with product leaders in other organizations, Special Project Leads, clinical leaders, and operating owners. Make ownership clear across shared journeys and capabilities.
  • Use AI directly to investigate ideas, build and test prototypes, and run bounded experiments. Check the outputs and use what you learn to choose the next step. Work with engineering and operating owners to take promising experiments into production; engineering retains technical delivery and readiness, and operating owners accept the resulting workflow.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: You understand the initial member and operational journeys, have selected focused product missions with engineering and operating partners, and can explain where teams can advance directly. You are personally advancing a difficult product question, coaching the initial PM work, and establishing credible evidence from an improvement or experiment.
  • First six months: PMs exercise stronger judgment and independently advance their assigned missions. Senior discovery produces focused projects and well-supported decisions to defer or stop. Shipped changes are being used, and product decisions connect to measurable improvements in member experience, operational effectiveness, or unit economics.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have led and developed product managers while remaining personally involved in discovery, prioritization, and difficult product decisions.
  • You have built or substantially shaped a product function and are comfortable starting with a small team and an evolving remit.
  • You have improved products used in real operational workflows and can connect software, human work, business economics, and adoption.
  • You use AI heavily in your own work and have a practical view of its capabilities and limitations, and strong hypotheses about its future.
  • You are technically fluent in systems, APIs, data, and AI behavior. You can independently investigate an idea, build and test a prototype, and run a bounded experiment using AI. You can understand the architectural implications of the products you help design.
  • You use research, data, and experiments to make decisions, and can distinguish a promising observation from evidence strong enough to act on.
  • You work effectively with engineers who exercise broad judgment and with operating leaders who own their businesses. You build trust through direct relationships and clear decisions.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

#LI-Remote

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is:

$207,000—$270,000 USD
