jobs.title: KYB Operations Lead, UK
jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is scaling fast in the UK. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards UK and EU businesses across Ramp’s own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We’re a small team of specialists that runs on frontier AI tooling. Everyone builds and maintains their own automations and apps, and we’ve taken daily processes from hours to minutes. We’re hiring a senior UK KYB expert to raise the bar on how we onboard UK businesses. You’ll work the hardest cases and make the final first-line call, own escalations with our partners, keep the UK queue moving, and build the fixes that stop the same problems coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather redesign a broken requirement than work around it, and who is as comfortable in a difficult ownership structure as in the data on why cases get stuck.

What You'll Do

  • Work the hardest UK onboarding cases yourself and make the final first-line (1LoD) call: complex ownership structures, EDD, PEP and adverse-media outcomes, and anything that needs judgement rather than a checklist

  • Keep the UK queue moving: spot what’s stuck, decide what matters most, and pick up cases yourself through leave and spikes in volume

  • Be the senior expert the UK team leans on: share your reasoning on hard cases, raise the bar on decisions, and help everyone get better at building as well as reviewing

  • Own escalations with our card-issuing and payments partners, including recurring failures, disputed or unnecessary requirements, and turning each fix into a repeatable playbook

  • Set the standard for customer-facing onboarding communications: clear requests, fast follow-ups, no avoidable back-and-forth

  • Build fixes, not workarounds: automate your own work with AI, and work with Product and Engineering to remove requirements customers shouldn’t have to meet twice

  • Define and track operational metrics (caseload by provider, time to close, handling time) and use them to decide what to fix next

  • Write consistent, evidenced 1LoD decision standards that hold up to partner sample reviews and second-line scrutiny

What You Need

  • 5+ years in KYB / onboarding / financial-crime operations at a UK fintech, EMI, PI or bank

  • Practical working knowledge of the UK regulatory framework for EMIs/PIs: MLRs 2017, JMLSG guidance, and FCA expectations for customer due diligence

  • Strong judgement on complex business customers: multi-layer ownership, overseas parents, trusts, PEPs, and knowing when to escalate

  • Clear written communication, both with customers and in documented case decisions

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in your day-to-day work to go faster or do better work, with concrete examples

  • A bias to fix the process rather than just work the queue

Nice-to-Haves

  • Line management of operators or analysts (strongly preferred)

  • Experience working with card-issuing, BaaS or payments partners on onboarding (e.g. partner due-diligence requests, sample reviews)

  • Safeguarding / client-money reconciliation experience

  • Writing requirements for Product and Engineering teams

  • EU onboarding experience or a second European language

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

United Kingdom

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Other notices

jobs.title: In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II
jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine, Oncology and Rare Disease is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high retention rates compared to industry averages. We are now recruiting In-house CRA I/ In-house CRA II to join our team in Poland.

Position summary

The In-house CRA (IHCRA) provides centralized, non-site-facing support to CRAs and clinical project teams across the study lifecycle. The role supports consistent site oversight by maintaining study documentation and systems, reviewing and reconciling site-level data, preparing operational metrics, and completing agreed administrative follow-up activities. The IHCRA works in close collaboration with assigned CRAs and under the oversight of the CTM, escalating issues that require site-facing follow-up or clinical judgment.

This is a regional support role. Direct communication with investigator sites and travel to site visits are not part of the core scope. The role may support studies across European countries and therefore does not require a local language for each supported country.

Essential functions

  • Provide non-site-facing operational and administrative support to assigned CRAs and clinical project teams throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Prepare and maintain Investigator Site Files, including document distribution and coordination with shipping vendors where required. Route site communication and follow-up to the assigned CRA.
  • Where an electronic Investigator Site File is implemented, review it remotely for completeness and identify documents requiring CRA follow-up or filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Review documents received from CRAs and CTMs for legibility, completeness, correct orientation and filing readiness, and file documents in the eTMF in accordance with applicable processes.
  • Review the eTMF for missing or expiring site documents and provide clear follow-up lists to the assigned CRA.
  • Perform scheduled reconciliations between the Delegation of Authority Log, CTMS, eTMF and system-access records; create placeholders or update records as required by the agreed process.
  • Set up and maintain assigned site-level data, milestones and activities in CTMS and other study-specific systems based on information provided by the CRA and/or CTM.
  • Run available reports and provide assigned CRAs with agreed site metrics, including data-cleaning, enrollment and approval-status information where applicable.
  • Support sample tracking and other vendor or study reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and provide findings to the CRA for site-facing follow-up.
  • Complete agreed non-site-facing administrative actions arising from CRA site contacts or monitoring visits, such as coordinating supply orders, tracking completion and escalating delays.
  • Provide documentation and tracking support for audit and inspection readiness under CRA or CTM direction.
  • Support study tracking and reporting, maintain accurate activity status, and escalate risks, delays or data inconsistencies to the appropriate study team member.
  • Perform all activities in accordance with ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, company and sponsor SOPs, project plans and study-specific procedures.

Qualifications

Minimum required

  • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent, preferably in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Initial experience in clinical research, clinical trial administration or study coordination within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
  • Practical experience using CTMS, eTMF and other clinical trial systems or tools.
  • Familiarity with ICH-GCP principles and clinical trial documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Skills and competencies

  • Strong organization, prioritization and follow-through across multiple studies, sites and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to perform accurate document and data review for extended periods.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies, communicate findings clearly and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with CRAs, CTMs and cross-functional partners.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Self-motivation, flexibility, teamwork and commitment to delivering on agreed responsibilities.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting multiple studies or countries in a centralized or regional clinical operations model.
  • Experience with Veeva Clinical applications.

Please, apply in English.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Wayflyer

Businesses come to Wayflyer to get the capital they need to grow. When they apply, connect their data or upload documents, every screen, word and transition either builds their trust or loses it. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with exceptional craft, strong product instincts and a builder mentality to shape how they access and manage capital.

You will take financial workflows and information-rich experiences from first idea to shipped product, and make them feel intuitive and trustworthy.

As part of our fully remote team of 15 designers across Product, Brand, Motion, and Design. Systems, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, share a common design system, and challenge each other’s work through open critiques, always pushing the quality of our craft forward.

How we think about craft

  • Craft is for the customer. Design should improve experiences, not just appearances.

  • Execution matters. From pixels to micro-interactions, nothing should feel accidental.

  • Trust is built through details. Especially when making decisions about their money.

  • Quality is a choice we make every day. It is not a final polish step or a handoff.

  • Speed and quality go together. We ship early, learn from real use and keep improving.

  • You can't write quality into a spec. It comes from people who care and who build.

Who Thrives Here

  • You don't wait for perfect requirements. You define the problem first.

  • You balance customer needs, business goals and technical limits.

  • You believe simplifying is one of the hardest and most valuable design skills.

  • You care deeply about craft and know that details matter.

  • You know that trust in financial products is built through hundreds of small interactions.

  • You push back when it matters, for the customer and for quality.

  • You use AI to explore, prototype and improve your work.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving team.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Own complex financial problems from discovery to delivery, and turn dense data into clear, scalable experiences.

  • Prototype early and often, with AI tools or code, to test ideas before they cost engineering time.

  • Build on our design system and help it evolve, with the design system designers.

  • Work with engineers until what ships matches the design.

  • Share your work in critiques and give feedback that raises everyone's work.

How You Think and Work

  • You have experience designing digital products, ideally in fintech, banking, lending, payments or other data-heavy domains.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

As the Engagement Manager, you will manage several projects/programs concurrently spanning 1 or more Large Enterprise customers. Engagement managers will have a targeted utilization rate, be responsible for the development of best practices, and will manage business processes.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Customer Integration Engineer

Department: Product Delivery

About the Role: The Senior Customer Integration Engineer combines hands-on integration engineering with customer-facing technical leadership in multi-organization healthcare environments, working with state agencies, HIEs, EHR vendors, and implementation partners to determine how systems interact and exchange data. The position supports integration delivery across customer projects, including enterprise initiatives involving multiple systems, organizations, and technical stakeholders. The engineer is expected to understand how individual integrations fit within broader customer initiatives, identify technical dependencies, and provide technical guidance. For designated customers, the role may involve sustained technical engagement across multiple initiatives while continuing to support other integration projects.

What You'll Do:

  • Apply systems thinking to understand how applications, data flows, and technical dependencies interact across customer environments, and recommend feasible integration approaches using existing platform capabilities and standards.
  • Configure, implement, test, and troubleshoot healthcare integrations involving REST APIs, FHIR, authentication protocols, database-backed configurations, and secure data exchange.
  • Provide ongoing technical consultation for designated customers, maintaining continuity across integration initiatives and evolving requirements.
  • Lead and participate in technical discussions with customer IT teams, enterprise architects, technology vendors, and implementation partners to understand the broader technical environment and guide integration decisions.
  • Analyze internal and external technical specifications, API documentation, FHIR Implementation Guides, payloads, and application logs to validate integration approaches and resolve issues.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and implementation teams to investigate technical issues, address integration requirements, and identify product dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including integration configurations, data flows, and implementation decisions.
  • Develop scripts, reusable utilities, and automation to improve integration testing, troubleshooting, and delivery efficiency.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare integration engineering, interoperability, systems integration, or related technical implementation roles.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, implementing, testing, and troubleshooting healthcare integrations, rather than solely designing solutions or coordinating technical teams.
  • Experience independently leading or actively contributing to technical discussions with customer IT teams, architects, vendors, and implementation partners to evaluate integration approaches, identify dependencies, and explain technical options and limitations.
  • Practical experience implementing and troubleshooting integrations involving REST APIs, HL7v2, FHIR, or similar healthcare data exchange technologies.
  • Experience using SQL and relational databases for integration configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with FHIR R4, US Core, FHIR Implementation Guides, REST APIs.
  • Experience with EHR integrations, Python or JavaScript scripting, cloud technologies, and multi-organization interoperability initiatives is preferred.
  • Strong systems thinking, including the ability to understand a customer's broader technical environment, recognize how individual integrations fit together, and recommend feasible implementation approaches.
  • Experience working with AWS services or similar cloud technologies to configure and troubleshoot integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent education and experience.

Our Mission:

Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

jobs.title: Contract Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

  • Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.
  • Confirm the signed order form is complete: both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.
  • Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.
  • Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.
  • Verify approvals and required data: discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.
  • Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.
  • Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

  • Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.
  • Follow corrections through to completion: track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.
  • Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.
  • Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

  • Bring questions to the right person with full context: the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.
  • Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.
  • Track every open question until it's resolved, keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.
  • Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.
  • Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.
  • Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

  • Attention to detail: you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.
  • Process discipline: comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.
  • Clear, proactive communication: you ask questions early, write concise notes, and are comfortable working in Slack with a distributed team.
  • Collaborative and tactful: comfortable telling a sales rep or customer success manager their paperwork needs a fix, clearly and kindly, and working with them to get it right.
  • Follow-through: you keep track of open items and nudge politely until they're resolved.
  • Sound judgment about your limits: you recognize when something is unusual and escalate rather than guess.
  • Eagerness to learn: open to feedback and quick to pick up new systems and terminology.
  • Comfort with AI tools: willing to use AI-assisted tools as part of daily work and to verify their output.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM.
  • Familiarity with contracts, order forms, invoicing, or billing.
  • Prior experience in an operations, finance, or administrative role, or in a SaaS environment.
  • Coursework or interest in business, finance, accounting, or operations.
  • No prior Salesforce or revenue operations experience is required; we'll train you on our systems and procedures.

Engagement Details

  • Type: Contract
  • Hours: Part-time
  • Location: Remote
  • Reports to: Senior Director, Technical operations with day-to-day direction from the team's AI Operations Specialist
  • Compensation: $30/hr

Why This Role Matters

Contract reviews are the last checkpoint before a customer's billing and onboarding begin. By keeping this work accurate and on time, you protect the customer experience, reduce downstream cleanup for finance and customer success, and free up our specialists to build the automation and documentation that will make this process faster for everyone. That lets our teams spend more energy on what matters most: helping clinicians deliver excellent care.

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

Job Title: Senior Community Strategy Manager - New Hampshire

About the Role: The Senior Community Strategy Manager turns community strategy expertise into approaches, systems, and enablement that make multiple customers and teams more successful. You'll design frameworks and playbooks that other CSMs and cross-functional partners use to engage community partners, resolve escalations, and drive adoption across multiple customers, geographies, or campaigns, while coaching others and demonstrating the effectiveness of engagement efforts with data.

What You'll Do:

Internal Enablement & Consultative Partnership

  • Serve as a consultative partner to Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams, providing guidance, tools, and coaching that improve execution consistency, and build enablement frameworks that improve how these teams engage customers and partners.
  • Lead cross-functional training or working sessions on escalation, adoption, and community strategy practices, and measure whether enablement improves team execution and outcomes.

Community Strategy & Network Engagement

  • Execute community engagement and network strategies for priority customers and design scalable network engagement strategies across customer segments, geographies, or campaigns.
  • Build strong relationships with community partners, anticipate adoption risks and align internal teams on response plans, and coach CSMs on tailoring engagement plans to customer and partner context.

Escalation Management & Triage

  • Manage and co-facilitate escalation processes, ensuring issues are triaged, tracked, and resolved, and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to drive accountability and timely resolution.
  • Design escalation campaigns and playbooks that address recurring adoption or partner engagement barriers, and use escalation data to prioritize interventions and prevent repeat issues.

Operational Process, SOPs & Playbooks

  • Maintain SOPs, playbooks, and triage processes for consistent handling of community escalations, and design and implement scalable workflows and operating approaches across customers, geographies, and campaign types.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and lead improvements that reduce manual work or unclear ownership, connecting SOPs to measurement, accountability, and enablement.

Analytics, Insights & Measurement

  • Track and report escalation campaign metrics in Salesforce, monitor adoption, engagement, and network health, and design measurement frameworks for escalation campaigns, adoption efforts, surveys, and engagement initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate data and activity tracking in Salesforce and related systems, and lead improvements to Salesforce workflows and reporting structures for escalation campaigns, engagement plans, and satisfaction tracking.
  • Define system requirements that balance user experience, data quality, and reporting needs, and audit data quality to drive corrective action across teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence

  • Align stakeholders around engagement priorities, escalation plans, and customer outcomes, and lead cross-functional initiatives that require coordination, shared operating rhythms, and accountability within defined community strategy priorities.
  • Influence teams without direct authority by using evidence, customer context, and clear recommendations, and resolve misalignment before it affects customer or community outcomes.

Communication, Facilitation & Executive Presence

  • Facilitate customer, partner, and internal discussions with confidence and clarity, and lead complex or sensitive conversations involving escalation themes, adoption challenges, or cross-functional tradeoffs.
  • Create executive-ready narratives that combine data, context, risk, and recommendations, and coach others on concise, outcome-oriented communication.

Problem Solving, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Diagnose adoption, engagement, and operational challenges, and lead experimentation with new models for engagement, escalation campaigns, or adoption improvement.
  • Balance innovation with process discipline, measurement, and scalability, and share learnings through playbooks, enablement, and cross-functional recommendations.

Customer & Community Impact

  • Keep customer goals, partner experience, and community outcomes at the center of decision-making, and connect community engagement work to customer value, adoption, retention, and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify cross-customer themes that affect community partners and help teams prioritize work based on customer and community impact.

  • Experience working with state or local government agencies, community-based organizations (CBOs), nonprofits, healthcare organizations, or other organizations serving vulnerable populations.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: Enterprise Implementation Manager

Department: Product Delivery

About the Role: The Enterprise Implementation Manager will primarily support our remote implementation model. This role will also occasionally support our Enterprise Services Delivery model, which focuses on temporarily embedding Unite Us team members in the early stages of partnership with customers who have significant business impact to provide expedited delivery and early ROI. The Implementation Manager will work with key stakeholders, both internally and externally, to proactively assess customer workflows and system adoption and consult with the customer to celebrate successes. This role includes a willingness to travel occasionally for customer needs, proven experience in managing customer relationships, and an ability to proactively identify risks and respond appropriately to rapidly changing situations. Implementation Managers are strong collaborators and work across departments and teams to ensure a seamless delivery of our solutions. The Implementation Manager is a detail-oriented or execution-focused individual with strong project management, customer management, and communication skills. They must have the ability to think on their feet and demonstrate expertise in executing a best-in-class implementation process. This role requires a process- and solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to drive operational efficiencies and decrease time to value for our customers.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead small- to large-scale implementations from end-to-end, acting as both the project manager and the customer point of contact during the implementation, including leading customer meetings, conducting workflow assessments, planning and executing configurations, and overseeing go-live support
  • Manage the successful delivery of all contracted solutions, ensuring cross-team dependencies are identified and completed in a timely manner, confirming that internal specialized teams have the information needed to complete assigned deliverables 
  • Manage and scope customer collateral needs such as training plans, client-specific workflow documentation, and marketing collateral
  • Guide customers through project plan development and execution of a Coordinated Care Network
  • Develop relationships with program or day-to-day stakeholders, community partners, service providers, and other stakeholders in the health and human services space to launch coordinated care networks
  • Plan, manage, and monitor projects for customers with varying complexities 
  • Lead standard technical implementations, such as SAML SSO
  • Maintain accuracy of all internal systems to warrant effective management of project pipeline and project resources 

You’re a great fit for this role if:

  • Proven implementation and project management skills
  • 3+ years of experience in a business, technology, consulting, public health, or social services environment
  • Experience building strong relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be consultative and manage multiple customers and projects at once. You show your resourcefulness by finding creative ways to execute, even when there’s not a predetermined path to follow.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills – you’re an active listener who can break down complex ideas and tailor a message to a specific audience
  • Demonstrated ability to be both organized and agile – you are able to keep projects running smoothly and efficiently, but you know how to pivot when things don’t go as planned
  • Experience analyzing data to pull out insights, tell a story, and drive action
  • Experience learning new tools and software; preferred experience with Jira, Salesforce, and Google Suite

Our Mission:

Unite Us’ mission is to unlock the potential of every community. Our co-founders started Unite Us in 2013 to serve the people they served with. They witnessed firsthand the barriers and inefficiencies in trying to navigate health and social services, and set out to improve that experience for veterans and their families. Unite Us quickly expanded to serving all people who need connections to care across our country. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities. We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. If you want to do well and do good, join Unite Us.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • This position is remote, U.S. based.
  • This position may require 20% travel
  • The target pay range for this role is: $100,000-$125,000. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies, as well as location.
  • All team members will be required to pass a background check which includes criminal, employment, and education verification

We offer insurance to team members and eligible partners and dependents, including unlimited virtual mental health and acute medical visits.

Mental health benefits, such as the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and wellness platform subscription, are available to all team members.

Take what you need, including volunteer days and mental health days. We also offer 14 paid, company-wide holidays.

Enjoy matching, immediate vesting and financial wellness resources

jobs.title: District Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What you’ll do:

As a District Onboarding Manager on the Success and Implementation team, your goal is to deliver projects on time, error-free, and in alignment with our district partners’ vision. As district partners sign on to work with ClassDojo, you’ll be the first point of contact with district leaders to help them bring ClassDojo at scale across all of their schools.

As an onboarding manager you understand how to take high level district goals, time frames, and distinct needs and translate them into project timelines, professional development recommendations, and communication plans to support mid-size and large districts. You track progress utilizing a combination of timelines and data to determine next steps and intervention plans to ensure a smooth roll-out and set the stage for high levels of product adoption. You are reliable, highly detail oriented, an excellent communicator, and know how to keep the trains running on schedule across teams.

You’ll work with our district partners looking to roll out ClassDojo district-wide. You’re comfortable managing a portfolio of ~30 projects at a time.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and project manage the district onboarding process

  • Ensure district projects are on track by collaborating cross-functionally with other stakeholders such as our technical implementation leads, training team, account executives, product, and support.

  • Facilitate kickoff calls with new and returning district partners to deeply understand their goals, timelines, and stakeholders.

  • Create an internal and external project plan that aligns to customer goals

  • Create a professional development plan and roll-out strategy that will drive towards high adoption and implementation milestones.

  • Own all external and internal communication: project status updates, proactively identifying risks and issues, escalating early and often with all project team members and executive stakeholders as needed

  • Understand ClassDojo’s products and services and strategically educate and guide customers to get the most out of their experience with ClassDojo

  • Work with the broader success and implementation team to continuously build and iterate on efficient systems and processes.

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of project management experience in a SaaS environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage a high volume of projects on tight deadlines with a high level of organization and accuracy

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • High empathy and emotional intelligence: ability to understand customer goals and find workable solutions to their needs.

  • Experience working on cross functional projects with multiple internal stakeholders

  • Experience in edtech, working with K-12 schools and districts, and/or working on products for kids or educators

  • Ability to learn new technology and products quickly

  • Familiarity with using organization tools such as: Asana, Smartsheet, Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, Notion

Bonus:

  • Project management certifications (e.g., Six Sigma/Lean, PMP, PPM, CSPO, CSM, SAFe)

  • Experience in high growth organizations

  • Experience working in a customer-facing capacity with K-12 district leaders and/or working directly in a district setting

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - Majors (Central)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.
  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

$149,000—$198,000 USD

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: Associate Media Relations Director
jobs.description:

As an agency, we exist to accelerate growth — for our clients, our people and the B2B industry. We partner with B2B technology and services companies, from high-growth Silicon Valley businesses to global Fortune 500 brands, to drive meaningful business results.

We’re looking for an experienced national media relations leader who knows what it takes to secure meaningful coverage for complex B2B companies. You’ll bring established relationships with national business and technology journalists, a proven track record of securing Tier 1 media opportunities, and the ability to turn challenging client narratives into compelling stories.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll personally drive high-impact media opportunities, develop and execute proactive earned media strategies, and manage and coach Media Relations Managers. You’ll also serve as a strategic partner to our PR account teams, contribute to new business opportunities, and help strengthen our national media relations capabilities as the media landscape continues to evolve.

National Media Relations

Team Leadership

New Business + Practice Development

jobs.title: Financial Systems Lead
jobs.description:
About Teamshares

Teamshares is a technology-enabled acquirer of small and midsize businesses. We buy companies with $0.5 million to $5 million in EBITDA, integrate them with our platform, and help employees become owners. Founded in 2019, we operate 90+ subsidiaries with approximately $490 million in consolidated revenue across 40+ industries and 30 states.

The Role

We're looking for a Financial Systems Lead to own the financial-systems strategy and execution across our network of companies. You'll design and implement ERP solutions, evaluate financial-systems tools and platforms, advise leadership on technology investments, and ensure each company has the systems and processes to manage its own finances effectively.

This is an individual contributor role focused on strategy, design, and hands-on execution. You'll work directly with company finance teams and implementation partners, troubleshoot technical problems, establish best practices, and build the financial-systems foundation that enables our companies to operate independently.

You'll have significant influence over how we approach financial systems across the network. As we grow, you'll build and lead a small team. We're looking for someone who can handle the immediate hands-on work while growing into broader leadership of this function.

About two-thirds of our network uses QuickBooks Online. We have several companies on NetSuite and others on industry-specific platforms. You'll think strategically about the entire financial-systems landscape, not just one platform. You'll evaluate payment processors, sales tax software, accounting automation, and specialized tools as the need arises.

Responsibilities

Financial-Systems Strategy & Platform Selection: Help leadership evaluate and decide which financial platforms are right for which companies. Make recommendations on QuickBooks Online vs. NetSuite vs. industry-specific ERPs. Build a long-term vision for standardization across the network. Evaluate new tools and technologies as opportunities arise.

Implementation Leadership & Design: Work with implementation partners and company finance teams to design and execute ERP transitions. Make recommendations on configuration vs. customization vs. process change. Ensure implementations deliver real business value and companies can operate independently.

Financial-Systems Standards & Governance: Establish best practices and standards for financial systems across the network. Define how we handle common financial scenarios: multi-subsidiary accounting, intercompany transactions, reporting structures, tax compliance. Document these approaches so they scale.

Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work as a peer with implementation consultants and technology vendors. Evaluate their recommendations and proposals. Challenge over-engineered or unnecessary solutions. Support leadership with technical assessment of partners and vendors.

Problem-Solving & Technical Leadership: When companies encounter financial-systems challenges, you're the escalation point. Diagnose problems, work with partners and vendors to find solutions, and make recommendations. Roll up your sleeves on troubleshooting and hands-on work as needed.

What We're Looking For

7-12 years of experience in ERP implementations, financial-systems leadership, enterprise accounting, or related fields.

Deep hands-on knowledge of Netsuite and practical experience with other financial-systems tools.

Strong judgment about financial-systems architecture. You can evaluate trade-offs between different platforms, vendors, and approaches. You make decisions based on what the business actually needs.

Experience evaluating and advising on technology vendors and solutions. You can assess whether a vendor's proposal is sound and spot over-engineering.

Comfortable working with ambiguity and in growing organizations. You're not constrained by perfect upfront planning and can adapt as circumstances change.

Able to communicate clearly with different audiences: finance teams, implementation partners, technology leaders, and business executives.

Willing to be hands-on. You're an individual contributor who troubleshoots problems, reviews implementation details, and supports execution directly.

Nice to Have

You have led ERP implementations or modernization initiatives for companies with multiple subsidiaries or complex financial needs.

You have experience as a financial-systems consultant, solution architect, or in-house finance technology leader.

You have evaluated and managed multiple financial-systems platforms and tools.

You have a background in financial operations, corporate accounting, or finance technology.

You have hands-on expertise in NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar cloud platforms.

Compensation

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Analyst (Mid-Level)

HYBRID (No Visa Transfers or Sponsorships Available)

Role Summary

The Data Analyst is an individual contributor who has moved beyond supervised execution and is developing the independence, analytical depth, and stakeholder skills needed to progress to Senior level. They own smaller analytical domains end-to-end, contribute meaningfully to team standards, and begin to proactively surface insights rather than waiting to be directed.

What You'll Do

Analytics & Insight Delivery

  • Deliver analytical work end-to-end for assigned business areas — from scoping and analysis through to presentation and stakeholder follow-through — with minimal re-direction

  • Support ad-hoc analysis for internal stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, and Account Management, providing interpretive framing alongside data outputs rather than data retrieval alone

  • Begin to proactively surface trends, anomalies, and data-driven observations to stakeholders, developing the instinct to flag what matters without being asked

  • Support A/B test experiments under the guidance of the Senior DA — including data preparation, metric tracking, and results summaries — building toward independent experimental design at Senior level

Google Analytics & Data Collection

  • Support the Senior DA in GA4 reporting, tracking plan validation, and custom dimension and metric implementation

  • Develop working knowledge of GA-to-warehouse integration and tagging practices in preparation for owning this domain at Senior level

BI Development & Semantic Layer

  • Design, build, and maintain Looker dashboards and Explores for assigned business areas, owning deliverables with limited rework

  • Develop LookML including dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations — ensuring all work is documented and consistent with team standards

  • Contribute to the shared semantic layer by flagging metric definition inconsistencies and proposing resolutions in collaboration with the Senior DA and Analytics Engineering team

  • Expand self-service analytics for non-technical stakeholders, enabling them to answer their own questions and reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team

  • Maintain accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures evolve

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

  • Take ownership of data accuracy for assigned dashboards and analytical outputs — proactively investigating discrepancies and escalating upstream issues to Data Engineering with clear root-cause evidence

  • Write performant SQL including window functions and CTEs; collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation and derived table design

  • Develop a working understanding of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficient to diagnose freshness and quality issues and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders

  • Begin collaborating with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer requirements for owned areas

Standards & Collaboration

  • Follow and actively contribute to coding standards, SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes

  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive and consistent feedback that builds quality across the team

  • Support Junior Analysts through paired working and direct feedback, under the guidance of the Senior DA

  • Partner closely with Senior Analysts, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders; ask clarifying questions early and communicate proactively on blockers and timelines

AI-Augmented Analytics

  • Apply AI and LLM tools hands-on to accelerate day-to-day analytics workflows — including SQL generation, LookML authoring, documentation, and exploratory analysis

  • Begin experimenting with AI-assisted insight narration and anomaly detection, sharing learnings with the team

  • Develop familiarity with self-serve analytics agent concepts (Cortex Analyst or equivalent) in preparation for owning this capability at Senior level

Continuous Learning

  • Actively develop skills across advanced SQL, Python, statistical analysis, and cloud data platforms

  • Build toward independent ownership of experimentation, GA4, and stakeholder advisory at Senior level

About You

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Engineering — or equivalent practical experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in a data analytics or BI role

  • Strong SQL skills including window functions and CTEs

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Looker and LookML development

  • Experience with AWS or Google Cloud data warehouses (Redshift or BigQuery)

  • Demonstrable experience building dashboards and Explores for non-technical business users

  • Working knowledge of software development best practices: Git, PR reviews, code style guides

  • Working knowledge of agile development processes

  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical tasks with growing independence

  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication with business stakeholders

Preferred

  • Exposure to A/B testing concepts and basic experimental design

  • Foundational Python skills for data manipulation or automation

  • Familiarity with GA4 reporting and tracking fundamentals

  • Experience with AI or LLM tools applied to analytics workflows

  • Experience with Linux/OSX command line and Git

  • Understanding of ELT pipeline concepts and cloud data infrastructure

  • Prior experience mentoring or supporting more junior colleagues

Thriving at Tillster
As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values:
· Put Customers First: Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals.
· Collaborate: Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals.

Additional health benefits include Healthcare and Dependent Care reimbursement programs, Employee Assistance Program (“EAP”) and Optum Care 24-hour confidential medical counseling services.

Making a Difference in the Tillster Way
